verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने द्युभिस्त्वमाशुशुक्षणिस्त्वमद्भ्यस्त्वमश्मनस्परि ।
त्वं वनेभ्यस्त्वमोषधीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नृपते जायसे शुचिः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, shining in thy glory through the days, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone: From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground, thou, Sovran Lord of men art generatad [sic] pure.

verses.sa:
तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः ।
तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे॥
verses.tr: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame
verses.en: Thine is the Herald's task and Cleanser's duly timed; Leader art thou, and Kindler for the pious man. Thou art Director, thou the ministering Priest: thou art the Brahman, Lord and Master in our home.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न इन्द्रो वृषभः सतामसि त्वं विष्णुरुरुगायो नमस्यः ।
त्वं ब्रह्मा रयिविद् ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वं विधर्तः  सचसे पुरंध्या॥
verses.tr: tvamagna indro vṛṣabhaḥ satāmasi tvaṃ viṣṇururugāyo namasyaḥ tvaṃ brahmā rayivid brahmaṇaspate tvaṃ vidhartaḥ sacase puraṃdhyā
verses.en: Hero of Heroes, Agni! Thou art Indra, thou art Visnu of the Mighty Stride, adorable: Thou, Brahmanaspati, the Brahman finding wealth: thou, O Sustainer, with thy wisdom tendest us.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने राजा वरुणो धृतव्रतस्त्वं मित्रो भवसि दस्म ईड्यः ।
त्वमर्यमा सत्पतिर्यस्य संभुजं त्वमंशो विदथे देव भाजयुः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne rājā varuṇo dhṛtavratastvaṃ mitro bhavasi dasma īḍyaḥ tvamaryamā satpatiryasya saṃbhujaṃ tvamaṃśo vidathe deva bhājayuḥ
verses.en: Agni, thou art King Varuna whose laws stand fast; as Mitra, Wonder-Worker, thou must be implored. Aryaman, heroes' Lord, art thou, enrich ing all, and liberal Amsa in the synod, O thou God.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने त्वष्टा विधते सुवीर्यं तव ग्नावो मित्रमहः सजात्यम् ।
त्वमाशुहेमा ररिषे स्वश्व्यं त्वं नरां शर्धो असि पुरूवसुः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne tvaṣṭā vidhate suvīryaṃ tava gnāvo mitramahaḥ sajātyam tvamāśuhemā rariṣe svaśvyaṃ tvaṃ narāṃ śardho asi purūvasuḥ
verses.en: Thou givest strength, as Tvastar, to the worshipper: thou wielding Mitra's power hast kinship with the Dames. Thou, urging thy fleet coursers, givest noble steeds: a host of heroes art thou with great store of wealth.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने रुद्रो असुरो महो दिवस्त्वं शर्धो मारुतं पृक्ष ईशिषे ।
त्वं वातैररुणैर्यासि शंगयस्त्वं पूषा विधतः पासि नु त्मना॥
verses.tr: tvamagne rudro asuro maho divastvaṃ śardho mārutaṃ pṛkṣa īśiṣe tvaṃ vātairaruṇairyāsi śaṃgayastvaṃ pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā
verses.en: Rudra art thou, the Asura of mighty heaven: thou art the Maruts' host, thou art the Lord of food, Thou goest with red winds: bliss hast thou in thine home. As Pusan thou thyself protectest worshippers.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने द्रविणोदा अरंकृते त्वं देवः सविता रत्नधा असि ।
त्वं भगो नृपते वस्व ईशिषे त्वं पायुर्दमे यस्तेऽविधत्॥
verses.tr: tvamagne draviṇodā araṃkṛte tvaṃ devaḥ savitā ratnadhā asi tvaṃ bhago nṛpate vasva īśiṣe tvaṃ pāyurdame yaste'vidhat
verses.en: Giver of wealth art thou to him who honours thee; thou art God Savitar, granter of precious things. As Bhaga, Lord of men! thou rulest over wealth, and guardest in his house him who hath served thee well.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने दम आ विश्पतिं विशस्त्वां राजानं सुविदत्रमृञ्जते ।
त्वं विश्वानि स्वनीक पत्यसे त्वं सहस्राणि शता दश प्रति॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne dama ā viśpatiṃ viśastvāṃ rājānaṃ suvidatramṛñjate tvaṃ viśvāni svanīka patyase tvaṃ sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati
verses.en: To thee, the people's Lord within the house, the folk press forward to their King most graciously inclined. Lord of the lovely look, all things belong to thee: ten, hundred, yea, a thousand are outweighed by thee.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने पितरमिष्टिभिर्नरस्त्वां भ्रात्राय शम्या तनूरुचम् ।
त्वं पुत्रो भवसि यस्तेऽविधत्त्वं सखा सुशेवः पास्याधृषः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne pitaramiṣṭibhirnarastvāṃ bhrātrāya śamyā tanūrucam tvaṃ putro bhavasi yaste'vidhattvaṃ sakhā suśevaḥ pāsyādhṛṣaḥ
verses.en: Agni, men seek thee as a Father with their prayers, win thee, bright-formed, to brotherhood with holy act. Thou art a Son to him who duly worships thee, and as a trusty Friend thou guardest from attack.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न ऋभुराके नमस्य१स्त्वं वाजस्य क्षुमतो राय ईशिषे ।
त्वं वि भास्यनु दक्षि दावने त्वं विशिक्षुरसि यज्ञमातनिः॥
verses.tr: tvamagna ṛbhurāke namasya1stvaṃ vājasya kṣumato rāya īśiṣe tvaṃ vi bhāsyanu dakṣi dāvane tvaṃ viśikṣurasi yajñamātaniḥ
verses.en: A Rbhu art thou, Agni, near to be adored thou art the Sovran Lord of foodful spoil and wealth. Thou shinest brightly forth, thou burnest to bestow: pervading sacrifice, thou lendest us thine help.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने अदितिर्देव दाशुषे त्वं होत्रा भारती वर्धसे गिरा ।
त्वमिळा शतहिमासि दक्षसे त्वं वृत्रहा वसुपते सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: tvamagne aditirdeva dāśuṣe tvaṃ hotrā bhāratī vardhase girā tvamiḻā śatahimāsi dakṣase tvaṃ vṛtrahā vasupate sarasvatī
verses.en: Thou, God, art Aditi to him who offers gifts: thou, Hotri, Bharati, art strengthened by the song. Thou art the hundred-wintered Ila to give strength, Lord of Wealth! Vrtra-slayer and Sarasvati.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सुभृत उत्तमं वयस्तव स्पार्हे वर्ण आ संदृशि श्रियः ।
त्वं वाजः प्रतरणो बृहन्नसि त्वं रयिर्बहुलो विश्वतस्पृथुः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne subhṛta uttamaṃ vayastava spārhe varṇa ā saṃdṛśi śriyaḥ tvaṃ vājaḥ prataraṇo bṛhannasi tvaṃ rayirbahulo viśvataspṛthuḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, cherished well, art highest vital power; in thy delightful hue are glories visible. Thou art the lofty might that furthers each design: thou art wealth manifold, diffused on every side.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्न आदित्यास आस्यं१ त्वां जिह्वां शुचयश्चक्रिरे कवे ।
त्वां रातिषाचो अध्वरेषु सश्चिरे त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम्॥
verses.tr: tvāmagna ādityāsa āsyaṃ1 tvāṃ jihvāṃ śucayaścakrire kave tvāṃ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire tve devā haviradantyāhutam
verses.en: Thee, Agni, have the Adityas taken as their mouth; the Bright Ones have made thee, O Sage, to be their tongue. They who love offerings cling to thee at solemn rites: by thee the Gods devour the duly offered food.

verses.sa:
त्वे अग्ने विश्वे अमृतासो अद्रुह आसा देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् ।
त्वया मर्तासः स्वदन्त आसुतिं त्वं गर्भो वीरुधां जज्ञिषे शुचिः॥
verses.tr: tve agne viśve amṛtāso adruha āsā devā haviradantyāhutam tvayā martāsaḥ svadanta āsutiṃ tvaṃ garbho vīrudhāṃ jajñiṣe śuciḥ
verses.en: By thee, O Agni, all the Immortal guileless Gods eat with thy mouth the oblation that is offered them. By thee do mortal men give sweetness to their drink. Bright art thou born, the embryo of the plants of earth.

verses.sa:
त्वं तान् त्सं च प्रति चासि मज्मना ऽग्ने सुजात प्र च देव रिच्यसे ।
पृक्षो यदत्र महिना वि ते भुवदनु द्यावापृथिवी रोदसी उभे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tān tsaṃ ca prati cāsi majmanā 'gne sujāta pra ca deva ricyase pṛkṣo yadatra mahinā vi te bhuvadanu dyāvāpṛthivī rodasī ubhe
verses.en: With these thou art united, Agni; yea thou, God of noble birth, surpassest them in majesty, Which, through the power of good, here spreads abroad from thee, diffused through both the worlds, throughout the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
ये स्तोतृभ्यो गोअग्रामश्वपेशसमग्ने रातिमुपसृजन्ति सूरयः ।
अस्माञ्च तांश्च प्र हि नेषि वस्य आ बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ asmāñca tāṃśca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: The princely worshippers who send to those who sing thy praise, O Agni, guerdon graced with kine and steeds,- Lead thou both these and us forward to higher bliss. With brave men in the assembly may we speak aloud.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन वर्धत जातवेदसमग्निं यजध्वं हविषा तना गिरा ।
समिधानं सुप्रयसं स्वर्णरं द्युक्षं होतारं वृजनेषु धूर्षदम्॥
verses.tr: yajñena vardhata jātavedasamagniṃ yajadhvaṃ haviṣā tanā girā samidhānaṃ suprayasaṃ svarṇaraṃ dyukṣaṃ hotāraṃ vṛjaneṣu dhūrṣadam
verses.en: With sacrifice exalt Agni who knows all life; worship him 'with oblation and the song of praise, Well kindled, nobly fed; heaven's Lord, Celestial Priest, who labours at the pole where deeds of might are done.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा नक्तीरुषसो ववाशिरे ऽग्ने वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनवः ।
दिव इवेदरतिर्मानुषा युगा क्षपो भासि पुरुवार संयतः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā naktīruṣaso vavāśire 'gne vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ diva ivedaratirmānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṃyataḥ
verses.en: At night and morning, Agni, have they called to thee, like milch-kine in their stalls lowing to meet their young. As messenger of heaven thou lightest all night long the families of men. Thou Lord of precious boons.

verses.sa:
तं देवा बुध्ने रजसः सुदंससं दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिं न्येरिरे ।
रथमिव वेद्यं शुक्रशोचिषमग्निं मित्रं न क्षितिषु प्रशंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ devā budhne rajasaḥ sudaṃsasaṃ divaspṛthivyoraratiṃ nyerire rathamiva vedyaṃ śukraśociṣamagniṃ mitraṃ na kṣitiṣu praśaṃsyam
verses.en: Him have the Gods established at the region's base, doer of wondrous deeds, Herald of heaven and earth; Like a most famous car, Agni the purely bright, like Mitra. to be glorified among the folk.

verses.sa:
तमुक्षमाणं रजसि स्व आ दमे चन्द्रमिव सुरुचं ह्वार आ दधुः ।
पृश्न्याः पतरं चितयन्तमक्षभिः पाथो न पायुं जनसी उभे अनु॥
verses.tr: tamukṣamāṇaṃ rajasi sva ā dame candramiva surucaṃ hvāra ā dadhuḥ pṛśnyāḥ pataraṃ citayantamakṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṃ janasī ubhe anu
verses.en: Him have they set in his own dwelling, in the vault, like the Moon waxing, fulgent, in the realm of air. Bird of the firmament, observant with his eyes, guard of the place as 'twere, looking to Gods and men.

verses.sa:
स होता विश्वं परि भूत्वध्वरं तमु हव्यैर्मनुष ऋञ्जते गिरा ।
हिरिशिप्रो वृधसानासु जर्भुरद् द्यौर्न स्तृभिश्चितयद् रोदसी अनु॥
verses.tr: sa hotā viśvaṃ pari bhūtvadhvaraṃ tamu havyairmanuṣa ṛñjate girā hiriśipro vṛdhasānāsu jarbhurad dyaurna stṛbhiścitayad rodasī anu
verses.en: May he as Priest encompass all the sacrifice. men throng to him with offerings and with hymns of praise. Raging with jaws of gold among the growing plants, like heaven with all the stars, he quickens earth and sky.

verses.sa:
स नो रेवत् समिधानः स्वस्तये संददस्वान् रयिमस्मासु दीदिहि ।
आ नः कृणुष्व सुविताय रोदसी अग्ने हव्या मनुषो देव वीतये॥
verses.tr: sa no revat samidhānaḥ svastaye saṃdadasvān rayimasmāsu dīdihi ā naḥ kṛṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī agne havyā manuṣo deva vītaye
verses.en: Such as thou art, brilliantly kindled for our weal, a liberal giver, send us riches in thy shine, For our advantage, Agni, God, bring Heaven and Earth hither that they may taste oblation brought by man.

verses.sa:
दा नो अग्ने बृहतो दाः सहस्रिणो दुरो न वाजं श्रुत्या अपा वृधि ।
प्राची द्यावापृथिवी ब्रह्मणा कृधि स्व१र्ण शुक्रमुषसो वि दिद्युतः॥
verses.tr: dā no agne bṛhato dāḥ sahasriṇo duro na vājaṃ śrutyā apā vṛdhi prācī dyāvāpṛthivī brahmaṇā kṛdhi sva1rṇa śukramuṣaso vi didyutaḥ
verses.en: Agni, give us great wealth, give riches thousandfold. unclose to us, like doors, strength that shall bring renown. Make Heaven and Earth propitious through the power of prayer, and like the sky's bright sheen let mornings beam on us.

verses.sa:
स इधान उषसो राम्या अनु स्व१र्ण दीदेदरुषेण भानुना ।
होत्राभिरग्निर्मनुषः स्वध्वरो राजा विशामतिथिश्चारुरायवे॥
verses.tr: sa idhāna uṣaso rāmyā anu sva1rṇa dīdedaruṣeṇa bhānunā hotrābhiragnirmanuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśāmatithiścārurāyave
verses.en: Enkindled night by night at every morning's dawn, may he shine forth with red flame like the realm of light,- Agni adored in beauteous rites with lauds of men, fair guest of living man and King of all our folk.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने अमृतेषु पूर्व्य धीष्पीपाय बृहद् दिवेषु मानुषा ।
दुहाना धेनुर्वृजनेषु कारवे त्मना शतिनं पुरुरूपमिषणि॥
verses.tr: evā no agne amṛteṣu pūrvya dhīṣpīpāya bṛhad diveṣu mānuṣā duhānā dhenurvṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinaṃ pururūpamiṣaṇi
verses.en: Song chanted by us men, O Agni, Ancient One, has swelled unto the deathless Gods in lofty heaven- A milch-cow yielding to the singer in the rites wealth manifold, in hundreds, even as he wills.

verses.sa:
वयमग्ने अर्वता वा सुवीर्यं ब्रह्मणा वा चितयेमा जनाँ अति ।
अस्माकं द्युम्नमधि पञ्च कृष्टिषूच्चा स्व१र्ण शुशुचीत दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: vayamagne arvatā vā suvīryaṃ brahmaṇā vā citayemā janāṃ ati asmākaṃ dyumnamadhi pañca kṛṣṭiṣūccā sva1rṇa śuśucīta duṣṭaram
verses.en: Agni, may we show forth our valour with the steed or with the power of prayer beyond all other men; And over the Five Races let our glory shine high like the realm of light and unsurpassable.

verses.sa:
स नो बोधि सहस्य प्रशंस्यो यस्मिन् त्सुजाता इषयन्त सूरयः ।
यमग्ने यज्ञमुपयन्ति वाजिनो नित्ये तोके दीदिवांसं स्वे दमे॥
verses.tr: sa no bodhi sahasya praśaṃsyo yasmin tsujātā iṣayanta sūrayaḥ yamagne yajñamupayanti vājino nitye toke dīdivāṃsaṃ sve dame
verses.en: Such, Conqueror! be to us, be worthy of our praise, thou for whom princes nobly born exert themselves; Whose sacrifice the strong seek, Agni, when it shines for never-failing offspring in thine own abode.

verses.sa:
उभयासो जातवेदः स्याम ते स्तोतारो अग्ने सूरयश्च शर्मणि ।
वस्वो रायः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य भूयसः प्रजावतः स्वपत्यस्य शग्धि नः॥
verses.tr: ubhayāso jātavedaḥ syāma te stotāro agne sūrayaśca śarmaṇi vasvo rāyaḥ puruścandrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ svapatyasya śagdhi naḥ
verses.en: Knower of all that lives, O Agni may we both, singers of praise and chiefs, be in thy keeping still. Help us to wealth exceeding good and glorious, abundant, rich in children and their progeny.

verses.sa:
ये स्तोतृभ्यो गोअग्रामश्वपेशसमग्ने रातिमुपसृजन्ति सूरयः ।
अस्माञ्च तांश्च प्र हि नेषि वस्य आ बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ asmāñca tāṃśca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: The princely worshippers who send to those who sing thy praise, O Agni, guerdon, graced with kine and steeds,- Lead thou both these and us forward to higher bliss. With brave men in the assembly may we speak aloud.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्निर्निहितः पृथिव्यां प्रत्यङ् विश्वानि भुवनान्यस्थात् ।
होता पावकः प्रदिवः सुमेधा देवो देवान् यजत्वग्निरर्हन्॥
verses.tr: samiddho agnirnihitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pratyaṅ viśvāni bhuvanānyasthāt hotā pāvakaḥ pradivaḥ sumedhā devo devān yajatvagnirarhan
verses.en: Agni is set upon the earth well kindled; he standeth in the presence of all beings. Wise, ancient, God, the Priest and Purifier, let Agni serve the Gods for he is worthy.

verses.sa:
नराशंसः प्रति धामान्यञ्जन् तिस्रो दिवः प्रति मह्ना स्वर्चिः ।
घृतप्रुषा मनसा हव्यमुन्दन् मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य समनक्तु देवान्॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsaḥ prati dhāmānyañjan tisro divaḥ prati mahnā svarciḥ ghṛtapruṣā manasā havyamundan mūrdhanyajñasya samanaktu devān
verses.en: May Narasamsa lighting up the chambers, bright in his majesty through threefold heaven, Steeping the gift with oil diffusing purpose, bedew the Gods at chiefest time of worship.

verses.sa:
ईळितो अग्ने मनसा नो अर्हन् देवान् यक्षि मानुषात्पूर्वो अद्य ।
स आ वह मरुतां शर्धो अच्युतमिन्द्रं नरो बर्हिषदं यजध्वम्॥
verses.tr: īḻito agne manasā no arhan devān yakṣi mānuṣātpūrvo adya sa ā vaha marutāṃ śardho acyutamindraṃ naro barhiṣadaṃ yajadhvam
verses.en: Adored in heart, as is thy right, O Agni, serve the Gods first to-day before the mortal. Bring thou the Marut host. Ye men do worship to Indra seated on the grass, eternal.

verses.sa:
देव बर्हिर्वर्धमानं सुवीरं स्तीर्णं राये सुभरं वेद्यस्याम् ।
घृतेनाक्तं वसवः सीदतेदं विश्वे देवा आदित्या यज्ञियासः॥
verses.tr: deva barhirvardhamānaṃ suvīraṃ stīrṇaṃ rāye subharaṃ vedyasyām ghṛtenāktaṃ vasavaḥ sīdatedaṃ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsaḥ
verses.en: O Grass divine, increasing, rich in heroes, strewn for wealth' sake, well laid upon this altar,- On this bedewed with oil sit ye, O Vasus, sit all ye Gods, ye Holy, ye Adityas.

verses.sa:
वि श्रयन्तामुर्विया हूयमाना द्वारो देवीः सुप्रायणा नमोभिः ।
व्यचस्वतीर्वि प्रथन्तामजुर्या वर्णं पुनाना यशसं सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: vi śrayantāmurviyā hūyamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā namobhiḥ vyacasvatīrvi prathantāmajuryā varṇaṃ punānā yaśasaṃ suvīram
verses.en: Wide be the Doors, the Goddesses, thrown open, easy to pass, invoked, through adorations, Let them unfold, expansive, everlasting, that sanctify the class famed, rich in heroes.

verses.sa:
साध्वपांसि सनता न उक्षिते उषासानक्ता वय्येव रण्विते ।
तन्तुं ततं संवयन्ती समीची यज्ञस्य पेशः सुदुघे पयस्वती॥
verses.tr: sādhvapāṃsi sanatā na ukṣite uṣāsānaktā vayyeva raṇvite tantuṃ tataṃ saṃvayantī samīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe payasvatī
verses.en: Good work for us, the glorious Night and Morning, like female weavers, waxen from aforetime, Yielders of rich milk, interweave in concert the long-extended thread, the web of worship.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा विदुष्टर ऋजु यक्षतः समृचा वपुष्टरा ।
देवान् यजन्तावृतुथा समञ्जतो नाभा पृथिव्या अधि सानुषु त्रिषु॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā viduṣṭara ṛju yakṣataḥ samṛcā vapuṣṭarā devān yajantāvṛtuthā samañjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu
verses.en: Let the two heavenly Heralds, first, most wise, most fair, present oblation duly with the sacred verse, Worshipping God at ordered seasons decking them at three high places at the centre of the earth.

verses.sa:
सरस्वती साधयन्ती धियं न इळा देवी भारती विश्वतूर्तिः ।
तिस्रो देवीः स्वधया बर्हिरेदमच्छिद्रं पान्तु शरणं निषद्य॥
verses.tr: sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyaṃ na iḻā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhiredamacchidraṃ pāntu śaraṇaṃ niṣadya
verses.en: Sarasvati who perfects our devotion, Ila divine, Bharati all surpassing,- Three Goddesses, with power inherent, seated, protect this holy Grass, our flawless refuge!

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गरूपः सुभरो वयोधाः श्रुष्टी वीरो जायते देवकामः ।
प्रजां त्वष्टा वि ष्यतु नाभिमस्मे अथा देवानामप्येतु पाथः॥
verses.tr: piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ śruṣṭī vīro jāyate devakāmaḥ prajāṃ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhimasme athā devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ
verses.en: Born is the pious hero swift of hearing, like gold in hue, well formed, and full of vigour. May Tvastar lengthen our line and kindred, and may they reach the place which Gods inhabit.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतिरवसृजन्नुप स्थादग्निर्हविः सूदयाति प्र धीभिः ।
त्रिधा समक्तं नयतु प्रजानन् देवेभ्यो दैव्यः शमितोप हव्यम्॥
verses.tr: vanaspatiravasṛjannupa sthādagnirhaviḥ sūdayāti pra dhībhiḥ tridhā samaktaṃ nayatu prajānan devebhyo daivyaḥ śamitopa havyam
verses.en: Vanaspati shall stand anear and start us, and Agni with his arts prepare oblation. Let the skilled heavenly Immolator forward unto the Gods the offering thrice anointed.

verses.sa:
घृतं मिमिक्षे घृतमस्य योनिर्घृते श्रितो घृतम्वस्य धाम ।
अनुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व स्वाहाकृतं वृषभ वक्षि हव्यम्॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtamvasya dhāma anuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam
verses.en: Oil has been mixt: oil is his habitation. In oil he rests: oil is his proper province. Come as thy wont is: O thou Steer, rejoice thee; bear off the oblation duly consecrated.

verses.sa:
हुवे वः सुद्योत्मानं सुवृक्तिं विशामग्निमतिथिं सुप्रयसम् ।
मित्र इव यो दिधिषाय्यो भूद् देव आदेवे जने जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: huve vaḥ sudyotmānaṃ suvṛktiṃ viśāmagnimatithiṃ suprayasam mitra iva yo didhiṣāyyo bhūd deva ādeve jane jātavedāḥ
verses.en: For you I call the glorious refulgent Agni, the guest of men, rich in oblations Whom all must strive to win even as a lover, God among godly people, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे द्वितादधुर्भृगवो विक्ष्वा३योः ।
एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु भूमा देवानामग्निररतिर्जीराश्वः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe dvitādadhurbhṛgavo vikṣvā3yoḥ eṣa viśvānyabhyastu bhūmā devānāmagniraratirjīrāśvaḥ
verses.en: Bhrgus who served him in the home of waters set him of old in houses of the living. Over all worlds let Agni be the Sovran, the messenger of Gods with rapid coursers.

verses.sa:
अग्निं देवासो मानुषीषु विक्षु प्रियं धुः क्षेष्यन्तो न मित्रम् ।
स दीदयदुशतीरूर्म्या आ दक्षाय्यो यो दास्वते दम आ॥
verses.tr: agniṃ devāso mānuṣīṣu vikṣu priyaṃ dhuḥ kṣeṣyanto na mitram sa dīdayaduśatīrūrmyā ā dakṣāyyo yo dāsvate dama ā
verses.en: Among the tribes of men the Gods placed Agni as a dear Friend when they would dwell among them. Against the longing nights may he shine brightly, and show the offerer in the house his vigour.

verses.sa:
अस्य रण्वा स्वस्येव पुष्टिः संदृष्टिरस्य हियानस्य दक्षोः ।
वि यो भरिभ्रदोषधीषु जिह्वामत्यो न रथ्यो दोधवीति वारान्॥
verses.tr: asya raṇvā svasyeva puṣṭiḥ saṃdṛṣṭirasya hiyānasya dakṣoḥ vi yo bharibhradoṣadhīṣu jihvāmatyo na rathyo dodhavīti vārān
verses.en: Sweet is his growth as of one's own possessions; his look when rushing fain to burn is lovely. He darts his tongue forth, like a harnessed courser who shakes his flowing tail, among the bushes.

verses.sa:
आ यन्मे अभ्वं वनदः पनन्तोशिग्भ्यो नामिमीत वर्णम् ।
स चित्रेण चिकिते रंसु भासा जुजुर्वाँ यो मुहुरा युवा भूत्॥
verses.tr: ā yanme abhvaṃ vanadaḥ panantośigbhyo nāmimīta varṇam sa citreṇa cikite raṃsu bhāsā jujurvāṃ yo muhurā yuvā bhūt
verses.en: Since they who honour me have praised my greatness,-he gave, as 'twere, his hue to those who love him. Known is he by his bright delightful splendour, and waxing old renews his youth for ever.

verses.sa:
आ यो वना तातृषाणो न भाति वार्ण पथा रथ्येव स्वानीत् ।
कृष्णाध्वा तपू रण्वश्चिकेत द्यौरिव स्मयमानो नभोभिः॥
verses.tr: ā yo vanā tātṛṣāṇo na bhāti vārṇa pathā rathyeva svānīt kṛṣṇādhvā tapū raṇvaściketa dyauriva smayamāno nabhobhiḥ
verses.en: Like one athirst, he lighteth up the forests; like water down the chariot ways he roareth. On his black path he shines in burning beauty, marked as it were the heaven that smiles through vapour.

verses.sa:
स यो व्यस्थादभि दक्षदुर्वीं पशुर्नैति स्वयुरगोपाः ।
अग्निः शोचिष्माँ अतसान्युष्णन् कृष्णव्यथिरस्वदयन्न भूम॥
verses.tr: sa yo vyasthādabhi dakṣadurvīṃ paśurnaiti svayuragopāḥ agniḥ śociṣmāṃ atasānyuṣṇan kṛṣṇavyathirasvadayanna bhūma
verses.en: Around, consuming the broad earth, he wanders, free roaming like an ox without a herdsman,- Agni refulgent, burning up the bushes, with blackened lines, as though the earth he seasoned.

verses.sa:
नू ते पूर्वस्यावसो अधीतौ तृतीये विदथे मन्म शंसि ।
अस्मे अग्ने संयद्वीरं बृहन्तं क्षुमन्तं वाजं स्वपत्यं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: nū te pūrvasyāvaso adhītau tṛtīye vidathe manma śaṃsi asme agne saṃyadvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ svapatyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: I, in remembrance of thine ancient favour have sung my hymn in this our third assembly. O Agni, give us wealth with store of heroes and mighty strength in food and noble offspring.

verses.sa:
त्वया यथा गृत्समदासो अग्ने गुहा वन्वन्त उपराँ अभि ष्युः ।
सुवीरासो अभिमातिषाहः स्मत् सूरिभ्यो गृणते तद् वयो धाः॥
verses.tr: tvayā yathā gṛtsamadāso agne guhā vanvanta uparāṃ abhi ṣyuḥ suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smat sūribhyo gṛṇate tad vayo dhāḥ
verses.en: May the Grtsamadas, serving in secret, through thee, O Agni, overcome their neighbours, Rich in good heroes and subduing foemen. That vital power give thou to chiefs and singers.

verses.sa:
होताजनिष्ट चेतनः पिता पितृभ्य ऊतये ।
प्रयक्षञ्जेन्यं वसु शकेम वाजिनो यमम्॥
verses.tr: hotājaniṣṭa cetanaḥ pitā pitṛbhya ūtaye prayakṣañjenyaṃ vasu śakema vājino yamam
verses.en: Herald and teacher was he born, a guardian for our patrons' help, Earner by rites of noble wealth. That Strong One may we grasp and guide;

verses.sa:
आ यस्मिन् त्सप्त रश्मयस्तता यज्ञस्य नेतरि ।
मनुष्वद् दैव्यमष्टमं पोता विश्वं तदिन्वति॥
verses.tr: ā yasmin tsapta raśmayastatā yajñasya netari manuṣvad daivyamaṣṭamaṃ potā viśvaṃ tadinvati
verses.en: In whom, Leader of sacrifice, the seven reins, far extended, meet; Who furthers, man-like, eighth in place, as Cleanser, all the work divine.

verses.sa:
दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद् ब्रह्माणि वेरु तत् ।
परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभवत्॥
verses.tr: dadhanve vā yadīmanu vocad brahmāṇi veru tat pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābhavat
verses.en: When swift he follows this behest, bird-like he chants the holy prayers. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.

verses.sa:
साकं हि शुचिना शुचिः प्रशास्ता क्रतुनाजनि ।
विद्वाँ अस्य व्रता ध्रुवा वया इवानु रोहते॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ hi śucinā śuciḥ praśāstā kratunājani vidvāṃ asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate
verses.en: Together with pure mental power, pure, as Director, was he born. Skilled in his own unchanging laws he waxes like the growing boughs.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य वर्णमायुवो नेष्टुः सचन्त धेनवः ।
कुवित् तिसृभ्य आ वरं स्वसारो या इदं ययुः॥
verses.tr: tā asya varṇamāyuvo neṣṭuḥ sacanta dhenavaḥ kuvit tisṛbhya ā varaṃ svasāro yā idaṃ yayuḥ
verses.en: Clothing them in his hues, the kine of him the Leader wait on him. Is he not better than the Three, the Sisters who have come to us?

verses.sa:
यदी मातुरुप स्वसा घृतं भरन्त्यस्थित ।
तासामध्वर्युरागतौ यवो वृष्टीव मोदते॥
verses.tr: yadī māturupa svasā ghṛtaṃ bharantyasthita tāsāmadhvaryurāgatau yavo vṛṣṭīva modate
verses.en: When, laden with the holy oil, the Sister [sic] by the Mother stands, The Priest delights in their approach, as corn at coming of the rain.

verses.sa:
स्वः स्वाय धायसे कृणुतामृत्विगृत्विजम् ।
स्तोमं यज्ञं चादरं वनेमा ररिमा वयम्॥
verses.tr: svaḥ svāya dhāyase kṛṇutāmṛtvigṛtvijam stomaṃ yajñaṃ cādaraṃ vanemā rarimā vayam
verses.en: For his support let him perform as ministrant his priestly task; Yea, song of praise and sacrifice: we have bestowed, let us obtain.

verses.sa:
यथा विद्वाँ अरं करद् विश्वेभ्यो यजतेभ्यः ।
अयमग्ने त्वे अपि यं यज्ञं चकृमा वयम्॥
verses.tr: yathā vidvāṃ araṃ karad viśvebhyo yajatebhyaḥ ayamagne tve api yaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛmā vayam
verses.en: That so this man well skilled, may pay worship to all the Holy Ones. And, Agni, this our sacrifice which we have here prepared, to thee.

verses.sa: इमां मे अग्ने समिधमिमामुपसदं वनेः । इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः॥
verses.tr: imāṃ me agne samidhamimāmupasadaṃ vaneḥ imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ
verses.en: Agni, accept this flaming brand, this waiting with my prayer on thee: Hear graciously these songs of praise.

verses.sa: अया ते अग्ने विधेमोर्जो नपादश्वमिष्टे । एना सूक्तेन सुजात॥
verses.tr: ayā te agne vidhemorjo napādaśvamiṣṭe enā sūktena sujāta
verses.en: With this hymn let us honour thee, seeker of horses, Son of Strength, With this fair hymn, thou nobly born.

verses.sa: तं त्वा गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसं द्रविणस्युं द्रविणोदः । सपर्येम सपर्यवः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā gīrbhirgirvaṇasaṃ draviṇasyuṃ draviṇodaḥ saparyema saparyavaḥ
verses.en: As such, lover of song, with songs, wealth-lover, giver of our wealth! With reverence let us worship thee.

verses.sa: स बोधि सूरिर्मघवा वसुपते वसुदावन् । युयोध्य१स्मद् द्वेषांसि॥
verses.tr: sa bodhi sūrirmaghavā vasupate vasudāvan yuyodhya1smad dveṣāṃsi
verses.en: Be thou for us a liberal Prince, giver and Lord of precious things. Drive those who hate us far away.

verses.sa: स नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि स नो वाजमनर्वाणम् । स नः सहस्रिणीरिषः॥
verses.tr: sa no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari sa no vājamanarvāṇam sa naḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Such as thou art, give rain from heaven, give strength which no man may resist: Give food exceeding plentiful.

verses.sa: ईळानायावस्यवे यविष्ठ दूत नो गिरा । यजिष्ठ होतरा गहि॥
verses.tr: īḻānāyāvasyave yaviṣṭha dūta no girā yajiṣṭha hotarā gahi
verses.en: To him who lauds thee, craving help, most youthful envoy! through our song, Most holy Herald! come thou nigh.

verses.sa: अन्तर्ह्यग्न ईयसे विद्वान् जन्मोभया कवे । दूतो जन्येव मित्र्यः॥
verses.tr: antarhyagna īyase vidvān janmobhayā kave dūto janyeva mitryaḥ
verses.en: Between both races, Agni, Sage, well skilled thou passest to and fro, As envoy friendly to mankind.

verses.sa: स विद्वाँ आ च पिप्रयो यक्षि चिकित्व आनुषक् । आ चास्मिन् त्सत्सि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: sa vidvāṃ ā ca piprayo yakṣi cikitva ānuṣak ā cāsmin tsatsi barhiṣi
verses.en: Befriend us thou as knowing all. Sage, duly worship thou the Gods, And seat thee on this sacred grass.

verses.sa: श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठ भारताऽग्ने द्युमन्तमा भर । वसो पुरुस्पृहं रयिम्॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratā'gne dyumantamā bhara vaso puruspṛhaṃ rayim
verses.en: Vasu, thou most youthful God, Bharata, Agni, bring us wealth, Excellent, splendid, much-desired.

verses.sa: मा नो अरातिरीशत देवस्य मर्त्यस्य च । पर्षि तस्या उत द्विषः॥
verses.tr: mā no arātirīśata devasya martyasya ca parṣi tasyā uta dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Let no malignity prevail against us, either God's or man's. Save us from this and enmity.

verses.sa: विश्वा उत त्वया वयं धारा उदन्या इव । अति गाहेमहि द्विषः॥
verses.tr: viśvā uta tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ
verses.en: So through thy favour may we force through all our enemies a way, As 'twere through streaming water-floods.

verses.sa: शुचिः पावक वन्द्यो ऽग्ने बृहद् वि रोचसे । त्वं घृतेभिराहुतः॥
verses.tr: śuciḥ pāvaka vandyo 'gne bṛhad vi rocase tvaṃ ghṛtebhirāhutaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Purifier Agni, high shinest forth, bright, adorable, When worshipped with the sacred oil.

verses.sa: त्वं नो असि भारताऽग्ने वशाभिरुक्षभिः । अष्टापदीभिराहुतः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no asi bhāratā'gne vaśābhirukṣabhiḥ aṣṭāpadībhirāhutaḥ
verses.en: Ours art thou, Agni, Bharata, honoured by us with barren cows, With bullocks and with kine in calf

verses.sa: द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिः प्रत्नो होता वरेण्यः । सहसस्पुत्रो अद्भुतः॥
verses.tr: drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ sahasasputro adbhutaḥ
verses.en: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.

verses.sa: वाजयन्निव नू रथान् योगाँ अग्नेरुप स्तुहि । यशस्तमस्य मीळहुषः॥
verses.tr: vājayanniva nū rathān yogāṃ agnerupa stuhi yaśastamasya mīḻahuṣaḥ
verses.en: Now praise, as one who strives for strength, the harnessing of Agni's car, The liberal, the most splendid One;

verses.sa: यः सुनीथो ददाशुषे ऽजुर्यो जरयन्नरिम् । चारुप्रतीक आहुतः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sunītho dadāśuṣe 'juryo jarayannarim cārupratīka āhutaḥ
verses.en: Who, guiding worshippers aright, withers, untouched by age, the foe: When worshipped fair to look upon;

verses.sa: य उ श्रिया दमेष्वा दोषोषसि प्रशस्यते । यस्य व्रतं न मीयते॥
verses.tr: ya u śriyā dameṣvā doṣoṣasi praśasyate yasya vrataṃ na mīyate
verses.en: Who for his glory is extolled at eve and morning in our homes, Whose statute is inviolate;

verses.sa: आ यः स्व१र्ण भानुना चित्रो विभात्यर्चिषा । अञ्जानो अजरैरभि॥
verses.tr: ā yaḥ sva1rṇa bhānunā citro vibhātyarciṣā añjāno ajarairabhi
verses.en: Who shines refulgent like the Sun, with brilliance and with fiery flame, Decked with imperishable sheen.

verses.sa: अत्रिमनु स्वराज्यमग्निमुक्थानि वावृधुः । विश्वा अधि श्रियो दधे॥
verses.tr: atrimanu svarājyamagnimukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ viśvā adhi śriyo dadhe
verses.en: Him Atri, Agni, have our songs Strengthened according to his sway: All glories hath he made his own.

verses.sa: अग्नेरिन्द्रस्य सोमस्य देवानामूतिभिर्वयम् । अरिष्यन्तः सचेमह्यभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: agnerindrasya somasya devānāmūtibhirvayam ariṣyantaḥ sacemahyabhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: May we with Agni's, Indra's help, with Soma's, yea, of all the Gods, Uninjured dwell together still, and conquer those who fight with us.

verses.sa:
नि होता होतृषदने विदानस्त्वेषो दीदिवाँ असदत् सुदक्षः ।
अदब्धव्रतप्रमतिर्वसिष्ठः सहस्रम्भरः शुचिजिह्वो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivāṃ asadat sudakṣaḥ adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ
verses.en: Accustomed to the Herald's place, the Herald hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.

verses.sa:
त्वं दूतस्त्वमु नः परस्पास्त्वं वस्य आ वृषभ प्रणेता ।
अग्ने तोकस्य नस्तने तनूनामप्रयुच्छन् दीद्यद् बोधि गोपाः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dūtastvamu naḥ paraspāstvaṃ vasya ā vṛṣabha praṇetā agne tokasya nastane tanūnāmaprayucchan dīdyad bodhi gopāḥ
verses.en: Envoy art thou, protector from the foeman, strong God, thou leadest us to higher blessings. Refulgent, be an ever-heedful keeper, Agni, for us and for our seed offspring.

verses.sa:
विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्ने विधेम स्तोमैरवरे सधस्थे ।
यस्माद् योनेरुदारिथा यजे तं प्र त्वे हवींषि जुहुरे समिद्धे॥
verses.tr: vidhema te parame janmannagne vidhema stomairavare sadhasthe yasmād yonerudārithā yaje taṃ pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe
verses.en: May we adore thee in thy loftiest birthplace, and, with our praises, in thy lower station. The place whence thou issued forth I worship: to thee well kindled have they paid oblations.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यजस्व हविषा यजीयाञ्छ्रुष्टी देष्णमभि गृणीहि राधः ।
त्वं ह्यसि रयिपती रयीणां त्वं शुक्रस्य वचसो मनोता॥
verses.tr: agne yajasva haviṣā yajīyāñchruṣṭī deṣṇamabhi gṛṇīhi rādhaḥ tvaṃ hyasi rayipatī rayīṇāṃ tvaṃ śukrasya vacaso manotā
verses.en: Agni, best Priest, pay worship with oblation; quickly commend the gift to be presented; For thou art Lord of gathered wealth and treasure. of the bright song of praise thou art inventor.

verses.sa:
उभयं ते न क्षीयते वसव्यं दिवेदिवे जायमानस्य दस्म ।
कृधि क्षुमन्तं जरितारमग्ने कृधि पतिं स्वपत्यस्य रायः॥
verses.tr: ubhayaṃ te na kṣīyate vasavyaṃ divedive jāyamānasya dasma kṛdhi kṣumantaṃ jaritāramagne kṛdhi patiṃ svapatyasya rāyaḥ
verses.en: The twofold opulence, O Wonder-Worker, of thee new-born each day never decreases. Enrich with food the man who lauds thee, Agni: make him the lord of wealth with noble offspring.

verses.sa:
सैनानीकेन सुविदत्रो अस्मे यष्टा देवाँ आयजिष्ठः स्वस्ति ।
अदब्धो गोपा उत नः परस्पा अग्ने द्युमदुत रेवद् दिदीहि॥
verses.tr: sainānīkena suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devāṃ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumaduta revad didīhi
verses.en: May he, benevolent with this fair aspect, best sacrificer, bring the Gods to bless us. Sure guardian, our protector from the foemen, shine, Agni, with thine affluence and splendour.

verses.sa:
जोहूत्रो अग्निः प्रथमः पितेवेळस्पदे मनुषा यत् समिद्धः ।
श्रियं वसानो अमृतो विचेता मर्मृजेन्यः श्रवस्य१ः स वाजी॥
verses.tr: johūtro agniḥ prathamaḥ piteveḻaspade manuṣā yat samiddhaḥ śriyaṃ vasāno amṛto vicetā marmṛjenyaḥ śravasya1ḥ sa vājī
verses.en: 1.AGNI, first, loudly calling, like a Father, kindled by man upon the seat of worship. Clothed in his glory, deathless, keen of insight, must be adorned by all, the Strong, the Famous.

verses.sa:
श्रूया अग्निश्चित्रभानुर्हवं मे विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरमृतो विचेताः ।
श्यावा रथं वहतो रोहिता वोतारुषाह चक्रे विभृत्रः॥
verses.tr: śrūyā agniścitrabhānurhavaṃ me viśvābhirgīrbhiramṛto vicetāḥ śyāvā rathaṃ vahato rohitā votāruṣāha cakre vibhṛtraḥ
verses.en: May Agni the resplendent hear my calling through all my songs, Immortal, keen of insight. Dark steeds or ruddy draw his car, or carried in sundry ways he makes them red of colour.

verses.sa:
उत्तानायामजनयन् त्सूषूतं भुवदग्निः पुरुपेशासु गर्भः ।
शिरिणायां चिदक्तुना महोभिरपरीवृतो वसति प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: uttānāyāmajanayan tsūṣūtaṃ bhuvadagniḥ purupeśāsu garbhaḥ śiriṇāyāṃ cidaktunā mahobhiraparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ
verses.en: On wood supine they got the well-formed Infant: a germ in various-fashioned plants was Agni; And in the night, not compassed round by darkness, he dwells exceeding wise, with rays of splendour.

verses.sa:
जिघर्म्यग्निं हविषा घृतेन प्रतिक्षियन्तं भुवनानि विश्वा ।
पृथुं तिरश्चा वयसा बृहन्तं व्यचिष्ठमन्नै रभसं दृशानम्॥
verses.tr: jigharmyagniṃ haviṣā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam
verses.en: With oil and sacred gifts I sprinkle Agni who makes his home in front of all things living, Broad, vast, through vital power o'er all expanded, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds him.

verses.sa:
आ विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चं जिघर्म्यरक्षसा मनसा तज्जुषेत ।
मर्यश्रीः स्पृहयद्वर्णो अग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्वा३ जर्भुराणः॥
verses.tr: ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta maryaśrīḥ spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā3 jarbhurāṇaḥ
verses.en: I pour to him who looks in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's grace and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.

verses.sa:
ज्ञेया भागं सहसानो वरेण त्वादूतासो मनुवद्वदेम ।
अनूनमग्निं जुह्वा वचस्या मधुपृचं धनसा जोहवीमि॥
verses.tr: jñeyā bhāgaṃ sahasāno vareṇa tvādūtāso manuvadvadema anūnamagniṃ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṃ dhanasā johavīmi
verses.en: By choice victorious, recognize thy portion: with thee for envoy may we speak like Manu. Obtaining wealth, I call on perfect Agni who with an eloquent tongue dispenses sweetness.

sections.label: To Indra
sections.name: Hymn 11
intro: The Sanskrit of this hymn in our source is divided differently, so only the English is given.

verses.en: Hear thou my call, O Indra; be not heedless: thine may we be for thee to give us treasures; For these presented viands, seeking riches, increase thy strength like streams of water flowing.
Floods great and many, compassed by the Dragon, thou badest swell and settest free, O Hero. Strengthened by songs of praise thou rentest piecemeal the Dasa, him who deemed himself immortal.
For, Hero, in the lauds wherein thou joyedst, in hymns of praise, O Indra, songs of Rudras, These streams in which is thy delight approach thee, even as the brilliant ones draw near to Vayu.
We who add strength to thine own splendid vigour, laying within thine arms the splendid thunder- With us mayst thou, O Indra, waxen splendid, with Surya overcome the Dasa races.
Hero, thou slewest in thy valour Ahi concealed in depths, mysterious, great enchanter, Dwelling enveloped deep within the waters, him who checked heaven and stayed the floods from flowing.
Indra, we laud thy great deeds wrought aforetime, we laud thine exploits later of achievement; We laud the bolt that in thine arms lies eager; we laud thy two Bay Steeds, heralds of Surya.
Indra, thy Bay Steeds showing forth their vigour have sent a loud cry out that droppeth fatness. The earth hath spread herself in all her fulness: the cloud that was about to move hath rested.
Down, never ceasing, hath the rain-cloud settled: bellowing, it hath wandered with the Mothers. Swelling the roar in the far distant limits, they have spread wide the blast sent forth by Indra.
Indra hath hurled down the magician Vrtra who lay beleaguering the mighty river. Then both the heaven and earth trembled in terror at the strong Hero's thunder when he bellowed.
Loud roared the mighty Hero's bolt of thunder, when he, the Friend of man, burnt up the monster, And, having drunk his fill of flowing Soma, baffled the guileful Danava's devices.
Drink thou, O Hero Indra, drink the Soma; let the joy-giving juices make thee joyful. They, filling both thy flanks, shall swell thy vigour. The juice that satisfies hath helped Indra.
Singers have we become with thee, O Indra: may we serve duly and prepare devotion. Seeking thy help we meditate thy praises: may we at once enjoy thy gift of riches.
May we be thine, such by thy help, O Indra, as swell thy vigour while they seek thy favour. Give us, thou God, the riches that we long for, most powerful, with stare of noble children.
Give us a friend, give us an habitation; Indra, give us the company of Maruts, And those whose minds accord with theirs, the Vayus, who drink the first libation of the Soma.
Let those enjoy in whom thou art delighted. Indra, drink Soma for thy strength and gladness. Thou hast exalted us to heaven, Preserver, in battles, through the lofty hymns that praise thee.
Great, verily, are they, O thou Protector, who by their songs of praise have won the blessing. They who strew sacred grass to be thy dwelling, helped by thee have got them strength, O Indra.
Upon the great Trikadruka days, Hero, rejoicing thee, O Indra, drink the Soma. Come with Bay Steeds to drink of libation, shaking the drops from out thy beard, contented.
Hero, assume the might wherewith thou clavest Vrtra piecemeal, the Danava Aurnavabha. Thou hast disclosed the light to light the Arya: on thy left hand, O Indra, sank the Dasyu.
May we gain wealth, subduing with thy succour and with the Arya, all our foes, the Dasyus. Our gain was that to Trta of our party thou gavest up Tvastar's son Visvarupa.
He cast down Arbuda what time his vigour was strengthened by libations poured by Trta. Indra sent forth his whirling wheel like Surya, and aided by the Angirases rent Vala.
Now let that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, yield in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with brave men, in the assembly.

verses.sa:
यो जात एव प्रथमो मनस्वान् देवो देवान् क्रतुना पर्यभूषत् ।
यस्य शुष्माद् रोदसी अभ्यसेतां नृम्णस्य मह्ना स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān devo devān kratunā paryabhūṣat yasya śuṣmād rodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who, just born, chief God of lofty spirit by power and might became the Gods' protector, Before whose breath through greatness of his valour the two worlds trembled, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः पृथिवीं व्यथमानामदृंहद् यः पर्वतान् प्रकुपिताँ अरम्णात् ।
यो अन्तरिक्षं विममे वरीयो यो द्यामस्तभ्नात् स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmadṛṃhad yaḥ parvatān prakupitāṃ aramṇāt yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyāmastabhnāt sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out the air's wide middle region and gave the heaven support, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यो हत्वाहिमरिणात् सप्त सिन्धून् यो गा उदाजदपधा वलस्य ।
यो अश्मनोरन्तरग्निं जजान संवृक् समत्सु स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo hatvāhimariṇāt sapta sindhūn yo gā udājadapadhā valasya yo aśmanorantaragniṃ jajāna saṃvṛk samatsu sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between two stones, the spoiler in warriors' battle, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
येनेमा विश्वा च्यवना कृतानि यो दासं वर्णमधरं गुहाकः ।
श्वघ्नीव यो जिगीवाँ लक्षमाददर्यः पुष्टानि स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yenemā viśvā cyavanā kṛtāni yo dāsaṃ varṇamadharaṃ guhākaḥ śvaghnīva yo jigīvāṃ lakṣamādadaryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: By whom this universe was made to tremble, who chased away the humbled brood of demons, Who, like a gambler gathering his winnings seized the foe's riches, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यं स्मा पृच्छन्ति कुह सेति घोरमुतेमाहुर्नैषो अस्तीत्येनम् ।
सो अर्यः पुष्टीर्विज इवा मिनाति श्रदस्मै धत्त स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ smā pṛcchanti kuha seti ghoramutemāhurnaiṣo astītyenam so aryaḥ puṣṭīrvija ivā mināti śradasmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Of whom, the Terrible, they ask, Where is He? or verily they say of him, He is not. He sweeps away, like birds, the foe's possessions. Have faith in him, for He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यो रध्रस्य चोदिता यः कृशस्य यो ब्रह्मणो नाधमानस्य कीरेः ।
युक्तग्राव्णो योऽविता सुशिप्रः सुतसोमस्य स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo radhrasya coditā yaḥ kṛśasya yo brahmaṇo nādhamānasya kīreḥ yuktagrāvṇo yo'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Stirrer to action of the poor and lowly, of priest, of suppliant who sings his praises; Who, fair-faced, favours him who presses Soma with stones made ready, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यस्याश्वासः प्रदिशि यस्य गावो यस्य ग्रामा यस्य विश्वे रथासः ।
यः सूर्यं य उषसं जजान यो अपां नेता स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yasyāśvāsaḥ pradiśi yasya gāvo yasya grāmā yasya viśve rathāsaḥ yaḥ sūryaṃ ya uṣasaṃ jajāna yo apāṃ netā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He under whose supreme control are horses, all chariots, and the villages, and cattle; He who gave being to the Sun and Morning, who leads the waters, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी संयती विह्वयेते परेऽवर उभया अमित्राः ।
समानं चिद् रथमातस्थिवांसा नाना हवेते स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ krandasī saṃyatī vihvayete pare'vara ubhayā amitrāḥ samānaṃ cid rathamātasthivāṃsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: To whom two armies cry in close encounter, both enemies, the stronger and the weaker; Whom two invoke upon one chariot mounted, each for himself, He, O ye men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यस्मान्न ऋते विजयन्ते जनासो यं युध्यमाना अवसे हवन्ते ।
यो विश्वस्य प्रतिमानं बभूव यो अच्युतच्युत् स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yasmānna ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante yo viśvasya pratimānaṃ babhūva yo acyutacyut sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Without whose help our people never conquer; whom, battling, they invoke to give them succour; He of whom all this world is but the copy, who shakes things moveless, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः शश्वतो मह्येनो दधानानमन्यमानाञ्छर्वा जघान ।
यः शर्धते नानुददाति शृध्यां यो दस्योर्हन्ता स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śaśvato mahyeno dadhānānamanyamānāñcharvā jaghāna yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṃ yo dasyorhantā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who hath smitten, ere they knew their danger, with his hurled weapon many grievous sinners; Who pardons not his boldness who provokes him, who slays the Dasyti, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः शम्बरं पर्वतेषु क्षियन्तं चत्वारिंश्यां शरद्यन्वविन्दत् ।
ओजायमानं यो अहिं जघान दानुं शयानं स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvavindat ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who discovered in the fortieth autumn Sambara as he dwelt among the mountains; Who slew the Dragon putting forth his vigour, the demon lying there, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सप्तरश्मिर्वृषभस्तुविष्मानवासृजत् सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् ।
यो रौहिणमस्फुरद् वज्रबाहुर्द्यामारोहन्तं स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ saptaraśmirvṛṣabhastuviṣmānavāsṛjat sartave sapta sindhūn yo rauhiṇamasphurad vajrabāhurdyāmārohantaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who with seven guiding reins, the Bull, the Mighty, set free the Seven great Floods to flow at pleasure; Who, thunder-armed, rent Rauhina in pieces when scaling heaven, He, O ye men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
द्यावा चिदस्मै पृथिवी नमेते शुष्माच्चिदस्य पर्वता भयन्ते ।
यः सोमपा निचितो वज्रबाहुर्यो वज्रहस्तः स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī namete śuṣmāccidasya parvatā bhayante yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhuryo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Even the Heaven and Earth bow down before him, before his very breath the mountains tremble. Known as the Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, who wields the bolt, He, O ye men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सुन्वन्तमवति यः पचन्तं यः शंसन्तं यः शशमानमूती ।
यस्य ब्रह्म वर्धनं यस्य सोमो यस्येदं राधः स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sunvantamavati yaḥ pacantaṃ yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī yasya brahma vardhanaṃ yasya somo yasyedaṃ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who aids with favour him who pours the Soma and him who brews it, sacrificer, singer. Whom prayer exalts, and pouring forth of Soma, and this our gift, He, O ye men, Is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सुन्वते पचते दुध्र आ चिद् वाजं दर्दर्षि स किलासि सत्यः ।
वयं त इन्द्र विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhra ā cid vājaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi satyaḥ vayaṃ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: Thou verily art fierce and true who sendest strength to the man who brews and pours libation. So may we evermore, thy friends, O Indra, speak loudly to the synod with our heroes.

verses.sa:
ऋतुर्जनित्री तस्या अपस्परि मक्षू जात आविशद् यासु वर्धते ।
तदाहना अभवत् पिप्युषी पयों ऽशोः पीयूषं प्रथमं तदुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: ṛturjanitrī tasyā apaspari makṣū jāta āviśad yāsu vardhate tadāhanā abhavat pipyuṣī payoṃ 'śoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamaṃ tadukthyam
verses.en: The Season was the parent, and when born therefrom it entered rapidly the floods wherein it grows. Thence was it full of sap, streaming with milky juice: the milk of the plant's stalk is chief and meet for lauds.

verses.sa:
सध्रीमा यन्ति परि बिभ्रतीः पयो विश्वप्स्न्याय प्र भरन्त भोजनम् ।
समानो अध्वा प्रवतामनुष्यदे यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: sadhrīmā yanti pari bibhratīḥ payo viśvapsnyāya pra bharanta bhojanam samāno adhvā pravatāmanuṣyade yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: They come trooping together bearing milk to him, and bring him sustenance who gives support to all. The way is common for the downward streams to flow. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds.

verses.sa:
अन्वेको वदति यद् ददाति तद् रूपा मिनन्तदपा एक ईयते ।
विश्वा एकस्य विनुदस्तितिक्षते यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: anveko vadati yad dadāti tad rūpā minantadapā eka īyate viśvā ekasya vinudastitikṣate yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: One priest announces what the institutor gives: one, altering the forms, zealously plies his task, The third corrects the imperfections left by each. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds.

verses.sa:
प्रजाभ्यः पुष्टिं विभजन्त आसते रयिमिव पृष्ठं प्रभवन्तमायते ।
असिन्वन् दंष्ट्रैः पितुरत्ति भोजनं यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: prajābhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ vibhajanta āsate rayimiva pṛṣṭhaṃ prabhavantamāyate asinvan daṃṣṭraiḥ pituratti bhojanaṃ yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Dealing out food unto their people there they sit, like wealth to him who comes, more than the back can bear. Greedily with his teeth he eats the master's food. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds.

verses.sa:
अधाकृणोः पृथिवीं संदृशे दिवे यो धौतीनामहिहन्नारिणक् पथः ।
तं त्वा स्तोमेभिरुदभिर्न वाजिनं देवं देवा अजनन् त्सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: adhākṛṇoḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃdṛśe dive yo dhautīnāmahihannāriṇak pathaḥ taṃ tvā stomebhirudabhirna vājinaṃ devaṃ devā ajanan tsāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Thou hast created earth to look upon the sky: thou, slaying Ahi, settest free the river's paths. Thee, such, a God, the Gods have quickened with their lauds, even as a steed with waters: meet for praise art thou.

verses.sa:
यो भोजनं च दयसे च वर्धनमार्द्रादा शुष्कं मधुमद् दुदोहिथ ।
स शेवधिं नि दधिषे विवस्वति विश्वस्यैक ईशिषे सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: yo bhojanaṃ ca dayase ca vardhanamārdrādā śuṣkaṃ madhumad dudohitha sa śevadhiṃ ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaika īśiṣe sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Thou givest increase, thou dealest to us our food: thou milkest from the moist the dry, the rich in sweets. Thou by the worshipper layest thy precious store: thou art sole Lord of all. Meet for our praise art thou.

verses.sa:
यः पुष्पिणीश्च प्रस्वश्च धर्मणा ऽधि दाने व्य१वनीरधारयः ।
यश्चासमा अजनो दिद्युतो दिव उरुरूर्वाँ अभितः सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ puṣpiṇīśca prasvaśca dharmaṇā 'dhi dāne vya1vanīradhārayaḥ yaścāsamā ajano didyuto diva ururūrvāṃ abhitaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Thou who hast spread abroad the streams by stablished law, and in the field the plants that blossom and bear seed; Thou who hast made the matchless lightnings of the sky,-vast, compassing vast realms, meet for our praise art thou.

verses.sa:
यो नार्मरं सहवसुं निहन्तवे पृक्षाय च दासवेशाय चावहः ।
ऊर्जयन्त्या अपरिविष्टमास्यमुतैवाद्य पुरुकृत् सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: yo nārmaraṃ sahavasuṃ nihantave pṛkṣāya ca dāsaveśāya cāvahaḥ ūrjayantyā apariviṣṭamāsyamutaivādya purukṛt sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Who broughtest Narmara with all his wealth, for sake of food, to slay him that the fiends might be destroyed, Broughtest the face unclouded of the strengthening one, performing much even now, worthy art thou of praise.

verses.sa:
शतं वा यस्य दश साकमाद्य एकस्य श्रुष्टौ यद्ध चोदमाविथ ।
अरज्जौ दस्यून् त्समुनब्दभीतये सुप्राव्यो अभवः सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vā yasya daśa sākamādya ekasya śruṣṭau yaddha codamāvitha arajjau dasyūn tsamunabdabhītaye suprāvyo abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Thou boundest up the Dasa's hundred friends and ten, when, at one's hearing, thou belpest thy worshipper. Thou for Dabhiti boundest Dasyus not with cords; Thou wast a mighty help. Worthy of lauds art thou.

verses.sa:
विश्वेदनु रोधना अस्य पौंस्यं ददुरस्मै दधिरे कृत्नवे धनम् ।
षळस्तभ्ना विष्टिरः पञ्च संदृशः परि परो अभवः सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: viśvedanu rodhanā asya pauṃsyaṃ dadurasmai dadhire kṛtnave dhanam ṣaḻastabhnā viṣṭiraḥ pañca saṃdṛśaḥ pari paro abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: All banks of rivers yielded to his manly might; to him they gave, to him, the Strong, gave up their wealth. The six directions hast thou fixed, a five-fold view: thy victories reached afar. Worthy of lauds art thou.

verses.sa:
सुप्रवाचनं तव वीर वीर्यं१ यदेकेन क्रतुना विन्दसे वसु ।
जातूष्ठिरस्य प्र वयः सहस्वतो या चकर्थ सेन्द्र विश्वास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: supravācanaṃ tava vīra vīryaṃ1 yadekena kratunā vindase vasu jātūṣṭhirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvato yā cakartha sendra viśvāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Meet for high praise, O Hero, is thy power, that with thy single wisdom thou obtainest wealth, The life-support of conquering Jatusthira. Indra, for all thy deeds, worthy of lauds art thou.

verses.sa:
अरमयः सरपसस्तराय कं तुर्वीतये च वय्याय च स्रुतिम् ।
नीचा सन्तमुदनयः परावृजं प्रान्धं श्रोणं श्रवयन् त्सास्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: aramayaḥ sarapasastarāya kaṃ turvītaye ca vayyāya ca srutim nīcā santamudanayaḥ parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ śravayan tsāsyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Thou for Turviti heldest still the flowing floods, the river-stream for Vayya easily to pass Didst raise the outcast from the depths, and gavest fame unto the halt and blind. Worthy of lauds art thou.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं तद् वसो दानाय राधः समर्थयस्व बहु ते वसव्यम् ।
इन्द्र यच्चित्रं श्रवस्या अनु द्यून् बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ tad vaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūn bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Prepare thyself to grant us that great bounty, O Vasu, for abundant is thy treasure. Snatch up the wonderful, O Indra, daily. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो भरतेन्द्राय सोममामत्रेभिः सिञ्चता मद्यमन्धः ।
कामी हि वीरः सदमस्य पीतिं जुहोत वृष्णे तदिदेष वष्टि॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somamāmatrebhiḥ siñcatā madyamandhaḥ kāmī hi vīraḥ sadamasya pītiṃ juhota vṛṣṇe tadideṣa vaṣṭi
verses.en: Ministers, bring the Soma juice for Indra, pour forth the gladdening liquor with the beakers. To drink of this the Hero longeth ever; offer it to the Bull, for this he willeth.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यो अपो वव्रिवांसं वृत्रं जघानाशन्येव वृक्षम् ।
तस्मा एतं भरत तद्वशायँ एष इन्द्रो अर्हति पीतिमस्य॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yo apo vavrivāṃsaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghānāśanyeva vṛkṣam tasmā etaṃ bharata tadvaśāyaṃ eṣa indro arhati pītimasya
verses.en: Ye ministers, to him who with the lightning smote, like a tree, the rain-withholding Vṛitra— Bring it to him, him who is fain to taste it, a draught of this which Indra here deserveth.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यो दृभीकं जघान यो गा उदाजदप हि वलं वः ।
तस्मा एतमन्तरिक्षे न वातमिन्द्रं सोमैरोर्णुत जूर्न वस्त्रैः॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yo dṛbhīkaṃ jaghāna yo gā udājadapa hi valaṃ vaḥ tasmā etamantarikṣe na vātamindraṃ somairorṇuta jūrna vastraiḥ
verses.en: Ye ministers, to him who smote Dṛibhîka, who drove the kine forth, and discovered Vala, Offer this draught, like Vâta in the region: clothe him with Soma even as steeds with trappings.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो य उरणं जघान नव चख्वांसं नवतिं च बाहून् ।
यो अर्बुदमव नीचा बबाधे तमिन्द्रं सोमस्य भृथे हिनोत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo ya uraṇaṃ jaghāna nava cakhvāṃsaṃ navatiṃ ca bāhūn yo arbudamava nīcā babādhe tamindraṃ somasya bhṛthe hinota
verses.en: Him who did Uraṇa to death, Adhvaryus! though showing arms ninety-and-nine in number; Who cast down headlong Arbuda and slew him,—speed ye that Indra to our offered Soma.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यः स्वश्नं जघान यः शुष्णमशुषं यो व्यंसम् ।
यः पिप्रुं नमुचिं यो रुधिक्रां तस्मा इन्द्रायान्धसो जुहोत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yaḥ svaśnaṃ jaghāna yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ yo vyaṃsam yaḥ pipruṃ namuciṃ yo rudhikrāṃ tasmā indrāyāndhaso juhota
verses.en: Ye ministers, to him who struck down Svaṣna, and did to death Vyansa and greedy Ṣushṇa, And Rudhikrâs and Namuchi and Pipru,—to him, to Indra, pour ye forth libation.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यः शतं शम्बरस्य पुरो बिभेदाश्मनेव पूर्वीः ।
यो वर्चिनः शतमिन्द्रः सहस्रमपावपद् भरता सोममस्मै॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yaḥ śataṃ śambarasya puro bibhedāśmaneva pūrvīḥ yo varcinaḥ śatamindraḥ sahasramapāvapad bharatā somamasmai
verses.en: Ye ministers, to him who, as with thunder, demolished Ṣambara's hundred ancient castles; Who cast down Varchin's sons, a hundred thousand,—to him, to Indra, offer ye the Soma.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यः शतमा सहस्रं भूम्या उपस्थेऽवपज्जघन्वान् ।
कुत्सस्यायोरतिथिग्वस्य वीरान् न्यावृणग् भरता सोममस्मै॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yaḥ śatamā sahasraṃ bhūmyā upasthe'vapajjaghanvān kutsasyāyoratithigvasya vīrān nyāvṛṇag bharatā somamasmai
verses.en: Ye ministers, to him who slew a hundred thousand, and cast them down upon earth's bosom; Who quelled the valiant men of Atithigva, Kutsa, and Âyu,—bring to him the Soma.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यन्नरः कामयाध्वे श्रुष्टी वहन्तो नशथा तदिन्द्रे ।
गभस्तिपूतं भरत श्रुतायेन्द्राय सोमं यज्यवो जुहोत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yannaraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahanto naśathā tadindre gabhastipūtaṃ bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṃ yajyavo juhota
verses.en: Ministers, men, whatever thing ye long for obtain ye quickly bringing gifts to Indra. Bring to the Glorious One what hands have cleansèd; to Indra bring, ye pious ones, the Soma.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवः कर्तना श्रुष्टिमस्मै वने निपूतं वन उन्नयध्वम् ।
जुषाणो हस्त्यमभि वावशे व इन्द्राय सोमं मदिरं जुहोत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavaḥ kartanā śruṣṭimasmai vane nipūtaṃ vana unnayadhvam juṣāṇo hastyamabhi vāvaśe va indrāya somaṃ madiraṃ juhota
verses.en: Do ye, O ministers, obey his order: that, purified in wood, in wood uplift ye. Well pleased he longs for what your hands have tended: offer the gladdening Soma juice to Indra.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवः पयसोधर्यथा गोः सोमेभिरीं पृणता भोजमिन्द्रम् ।
वेदाहमस्य निभृतं म एतद् दित्सन्तं भूयो यजतश्चिकेत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavaḥ payasodharyathā goḥ somebhirīṃ pṛṇatā bhojamindram vedāhamasya nibhṛtaṃ ma etad ditsantaṃ bhūyo yajataściketa
verses.en: As the cow's udder teems with milk, Adhvaryus, so fill with Soma Indra, liberal giver. I know him: I am sure of this, the Holy knows that I fain would give to him more largely.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो यो दिव्यस्य वस्वो यः पार्थिवस्य क्षम्यस्य राजा ।
तमूर्दरं न पृणता यवेनेन्द्रं सोमेभिस्तदपो वो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo yo divyasya vasvo yaḥ pārthivasya kṣamyasya rājā tamūrdaraṃ na pṛṇatā yavenendraṃ somebhistadapo vo astu
verses.en: Him, ministers, the Lord of heavenly treasure and all terrestrial wealth that earth possesses, Him, Indra, fill with Soma as a garner is filled with barley full: be this your labour.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं तद् वसो दानाय राधः समर्थयस्व बहु ते वसव्यम् ।
इन्द्र यच्चित्रं श्रवस्या अनु द्यून्बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ tad vaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Prepare thyself to grant us that great booty, O Vasu, for abundant is thy treasure. Gather up wondrous wealth, O Indra, daily. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
प्र घा न्वस्य महतो महानि सत्या सत्यस्य करणानि वोचम् ।
त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत् सुतस्यास्य मदे अहिमिन्द्रो जघान॥
verses.tr: pra ghā nvasya mahato mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam trikadrukeṣvapibat sutasyāsya made ahimindro jaghāna
verses.en: Now, verily, will I declare the exploits, mighty and true, of him the True and Mighty. In the Trikadrukas he drank the Soma then in its rapture Indra slew the Dragon.

verses.sa:
अवंशे द्यामस्तभायद् बृहन्तमा रोदसी अपृणदन्तरिक्षम् ।
स धारयत् पृथिवीं पप्रथच्च सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: avaṃśe dyāmastabhāyad bṛhantamā rodasī apṛṇadantarikṣam sa dhārayat pṛthivīṃ paprathacca somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: High heaven unsupported in space he stablished: he filled the two worlds and the air's mid-region. Earth he upheld, and gave it wide expansion. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
सद्मेव प्राचो वि मिमाय मानैर्वज्रेण खान्यतृणन्नदीनाम् ।
वृथासृजत् पथिभिर्दीर्घयाथैः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: sadmeva prāco vi mimāya mānairvajreṇa khānyatṛṇannadīnām vṛthāsṛjat pathibhirdīrghayāthaiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: From front, as 'twere a house, he ruled and measured; pierced with his bolt the fountains of the rivers, And made them flow at ease by paths far-reaching, These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
स प्रवोळहृन् परिगत्या दभीतेर्विश्वमधागायुधमिद्धे अग्नौ ।
सं गोभिरश्वैरसृजद् रथेभिः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: sa pravoḻahṛn parigatyā dabhīterviśvamadhāgāyudhamiddhe agnau saṃ gobhiraśvairasṛjad rathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: Compassing those who bore away Dabhiti, in kindled fire he burnt up all their weapons. And made him rich with kine and cars and horses. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
स ईं महीं धुनिमेतोररम्णात् सो अस्नातॄनपारयत् स्वस्ति ।
त उत्स्नाय रयिमभि प्र तस्थुः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ mahīṃ dhunimetoraramṇāt so asnātṝnapārayat svasti ta utsnāya rayimabhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: The mighty roaring flood he stayed from flowing, and carried those who swam not safely over. They having crossed the stream attained to riches. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
सोदञ्चं सिन्धुमरिणान्महित्वा वज्रेणान उषसः सं पिपेष ।
अजवसो जविनीभिर्विवृश्चन् त्सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: sodañcaṃ sindhumariṇānmahitvā vajreṇāna uṣasaḥ saṃ pipeṣa ajavaso javinībhirvivṛścan tsomasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: With mighty power he made the stream flow upward, crushed with his thunderbolt the car of Usas, Rending her slow steeds with his rapid coursers. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
स विद्वाँ अपगोहं कनीनामाविर्भवन्नुदतिष्ठत् परावृक् ।
प्रति श्रोणः स्थाद्व्य१नगचष्ट सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: sa vidvāṃ apagohaṃ kanīnāmāvirbhavannudatiṣṭhat parāvṛk prati śroṇaḥ sthādvya1nagacaṣṭa somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: Knowing the place wherein the maids were hiding, the outcast showed himself and stood before them. The cripple stood erect, the blind beheld them. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
भिनद् वलमङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानो वि पर्वतस्य दृंहितान्यैरत् ।
रिणग्रोधांसि कृत्रिमाण्येषां सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: bhinad valamaṅgirobhirgṛṇāno vi parvatasya dṛṃhitānyairat riṇagrodhāṃsi kṛtrimāṇyeṣāṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: Praised by the Angirases he slaughtered Vala, and burst apart the bulwarks of the mountain. He tore away their deftly-built defences. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नेनाभ्युप्या चुमुरिं धुनिं च जघन्थ दस्युं प्र दभीतिमावः ।
रम्भी चिदत्र विविदे हिरण्यं सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार॥
verses.tr: svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca jaghantha dasyuṃ pra dabhītimāvaḥ rambhī cidatra vivide hiraṇyaṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra
verses.en: Thou, with sleep whelming Cumuri and Dhuni, slewest the Dasyu, keptest safe Dabhiti. There the staff-bearer found the golden treasure. These things did Indra in the Soma's rapture.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now let that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, yield in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with brave men, in assembly.

verses.sa:
प्र वः सतां ज्येष्ठतमाय सुष्टुतिमग्नाविव समिधाने हविर्भरे ।
इन्द्रमजुर्यं जरयन्तमुक्षितं सनाद् युवानमवसे हवामहे॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamāya suṣṭutimagnāviva samidhāne havirbhare indramajuryaṃ jarayantamukṣitaṃ sanād yuvānamavase havāmahe
verses.en: To him, your own, the best among the good, I bring eulogy, like oblation in the kindled fire. We invocate for help Indra untouched by eld, who maketh all decay, strengthened, for ever young.

verses.sa:
यस्मादिन्द्राद् बृहतः किं चनेमृते विश्वान्यस्मिन् त्संभृताधि वीर्या ।
जठरे सोमं तन्वी३ सहो महो हस्ते वज्रं भरति शीर्षणि क्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: yasmādindrād bṛhataḥ kiṃ canemṛte viśvānyasmin tsaṃbhṛtādhi vīryā jaṭhare somaṃ tanvī3 saho maho haste vajraṃ bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum
verses.en: Without whom naught exists, Indra the Lofty One; in whom alone all powers heroic are combined. The Soma is within him, in his frame vast strength, the thunder in his hand and wisdom in his head.

verses.sa:
न क्षोणीभ्यां परिभ्वे त इन्द्रियं न समुद्रैः पर्वतैरिन्द्र ते रथः ।
न ते वज्रमन्वश्नोति कश्चन यदाशुभिः पतसि योजना पुरु॥
verses.tr: na kṣoṇībhyāṃ paribhve ta indriyaṃ na samudraiḥ parvatairindra te rathaḥ na te vajramanvaśnoti kaścana yadāśubhiḥ patasi yojanā puru
verses.en: Not by both worlds is thine own power to be surpassed, nor may thy car be stayed by mountains or by seas. None cometh near, O Indra, to thy thunderbolt, when with swift steeds thou fliest over many a league.

verses.sa:
विश्वे ह्यस्मै यजताय धृष्णवे क्रतुं भरन्ति वृषभाय सश्चते ।
वृषा यजस्व हविषा विदुष्टरः पिबेन्द्र सोमं वृषभेण भानुना॥
verses.tr: viśve hyasmai yajatāya dhṛṣṇave kratuṃ bharanti vṛṣabhāya saścate vṛṣā yajasva haviṣā viduṣṭaraḥ pibendra somaṃ vṛṣabheṇa bhānunā
verses.en: For all men bring their will to him the Resolute, to him the Holy One, to him the Strong they cleave. Pay worship with oblation, strong and passing wise. Drink thou the Soma, Indra, through the mighty blaze.

verses.sa:
वृष्णः कोशः पवते मध्व ऊर्मिर्वृषभान्नाय वृषभाय पातवे ।
वृषणाध्वर्यू वृषभासो अद्रयो वृषणं सोमं वृषभाय सुष्वति॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṇaḥ kośaḥ pavate madhva ūrmirvṛṣabhānnāya vṛṣabhāya pātave vṛṣaṇādhvaryū vṛṣabhāso adrayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somaṃ vṛṣabhāya suṣvati
verses.en: The vessel of the strong flows forth, the flood of meath, unto the Strong who feeds upon the strong, for drink, Strong are the two Adhvaryus, strong are both the stones. They press the Soma that is strong for him the Strong.

verses.sa:
वृषा ते वज्र उत ते वृषा रथो वृषणा हरी वृषभाण्यायुधा ।
वृष्णो मदस्य वृषभ त्वमीशिष इन्द्र सोमस्य वृषभस्य तृप्णुहि॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā te vajra uta te vṛṣā ratho vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣabhāṇyāyudhā vṛṣṇo madasya vṛṣabha tvamīśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛpṇuhi
verses.en: Strong is thy thunderbolt, yea, and thy car is strong; strong are thy Bay Steeds and thy weapons powerful. Thou, Indra, Bull, art Lord of the strong gladdening drink. with the strong Soma, Indra, satisfy thyself.

verses.sa:
प्र ते नावं न समने वचस्युवं ब्रह्मणा यामि सवनेषु दाधृषिः ।
कुविन्नो अस्य वचसो निबोधिषदिन्द्रमुत्सं न वसुनः सिचामहे॥
verses.tr: pra te nāvaṃ na samane vacasyuvaṃ brahmaṇā yāmi savaneṣu dādhṛṣiḥ kuvinno asya vacaso nibodhiṣadindramutsaṃ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe
verses.en: I, bold by prayer, come near thee in thy sacred rites, thee like a saving ship, thee shouting in the war. Verily he will hear and mark this word of ours: we will pour Indra forth as 'twere a spring of wealth.

verses.sa:
पुरा सम्बाधादभ्या ववृत्स्व नो धेनुर्न वत्सं यवसस्य पिप्युषी ।
सकृत्सु ते सुमतिभिः शतक्रतो सं पत्नीभिर्न वृषणो नसीमहि॥
verses.tr: purā sambādhādabhyā vavṛtsva no dhenurna vatsaṃ yavasasya pipyuṣī sakṛtsu te sumatibhiḥ śatakrato saṃ patnībhirna vṛṣaṇo nasīmahi
verses.en: Turn thee unto us ere calamity come nigh, as a cow full of pasture turns her to her calf. Lord of a Hundred Powers, may we once firmly cling to thy fair favours even as husbands to their wives.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now let that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, yield in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
तदस्मै नव्यमङ्गिरस्वदर्चत शुष्मा यदस्य प्रत्नथोदीरते ।
विश्वा यद् गोत्रा सहसा परीवृता मदे सोमस्य दृंहितान्यैरयत्॥
verses.tr: tadasmai navyamaṅgirasvadarcata śuṣmā yadasya pratnathodīrate viśvā yad gotrā sahasā parīvṛtā made somasya dṛṃhitānyairayat
verses.en: Like the Angirases, sing this new song forth to him, for, as in ancient days, his mighty powers are shown, When in the rapture of the Soma he unclosed with strength the solid firm-shut stables of the kine.

verses.sa:
स भूतु यो ह प्रथमाय धायस ओजो मिमानो महिमानमातिरत् ।
शूरो यो युत्सु तन्वं परिव्यत शीर्षणि द्यां महिना प्रत्यमुञ्चत॥
verses.tr: sa bhūtu yo ha prathamāya dhāyasa ojo mimāno mahimānamātirat śūro yo yutsu tanvaṃ parivyata śīrṣaṇi dyāṃ mahinā pratyamuñcata
verses.en: Let him be even that God who, for the earliest draught measuring out his power, increased his majesty; Hero who fortified his body in the wars, and through his greatness set the heaven upon his head.

verses.sa:
अधाकृणोः प्रथमं वीर्यं महद् यदस्याग्रे ब्रह्मणा शुष्ममैरयः ।
रथेष्ठेन हर्यश्वेन विच्युताः प्र जीरयः सिस्रते सध्र्य१क्पृथक्॥
verses.tr: adhākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ vīryaṃ mahad yadasyāgre brahmaṇā śuṣmamairayaḥ ratheṣṭhena haryaśvena vicyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhrya1kpṛthak
verses.en: Thou didst perform thy first great deed of hero might what time thou showedst power, through prayer, before this folk. Hurled down by thee the car-borne Lord of Tawny Steeds, the congregated swift ones fled in sundry ways.

verses.sa:
अधा यो विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मनेशानकृत् प्रवया अभ्यवर्धत ।
आद् रोदसी ज्योतिषा वह्निरातनोत् सीव्यन् तमांसि दुधिता समव्ययत्॥
verses.tr: adhā yo viśvā bhuvanābhi majmaneśānakṛt pravayā abhyavardhata ād rodasī jyotiṣā vahnirātanot sīvyan tamāṃsi dudhitā samavyayat
verses.en: He made himself by might Lord of all living things, and strong in vital power waxed great above them all. He, borne on high, o'erspread with light the heaven and earth, and, sewing up the turbid darkness, closed it in.

verses.sa:
स प्राचीनान् पर्वतान् दृंहदोजसा ऽधराचीनमकृणोदपामपः ।
अधारयत् पृथिवीं विश्वधायसमस्तभ्नान्मायया द्यामवस्रसः॥
verses.tr: sa prācīnān parvatān dṛṃhadojasā 'dharācīnamakṛṇodapāmapaḥ adhārayat pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyasamastabhnānmāyayā dyāmavasrasaḥ
verses.en: He with his might made firm the forward-bending hills, the downward rushing of the waters he ordained. Fast he upheld the earth that nourisheth all life, and stayed the heaven from falling by his wondrous skill.

verses.sa:
सास्मा अरं बाहुभ्यां यं पिताकृणोद्विश्वस्मादा जनुषो वेदसस्परि ।
येना पृथिव्यां नि क्रिविं शयध्यै वज्रेण हत्व्यवृणक् तुविष्वणिः॥
verses.tr: sāsmā araṃ bāhubhyāṃ yaṃ pitākṛṇodviśvasmādā januṣo vedasaspari yenā pṛthivyāṃ ni kriviṃ śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvyavṛṇak tuviṣvaṇiḥ
verses.en: Fit for the grasping of his arms is what the Sire hath fabricated from all kind of precious wealth. The thunderbolt, wherewith, loud-roaring, he smote down, and striking him to death laid Krivi on the earth.

verses.sa:
अमाजूरिव पित्रोः सचा सती समानादा सदसस्त्वामिये भगम् ।
कृधि प्रकेतमुप मास्या भर दद्धि भागं तन्वो३ येन मामहः॥
verses.tr: amājūriva pitroḥ sacā satī samānādā sadasastvāmiye bhagam kṛdhi praketamupa māsyā bhara daddhi bhāgaṃ tanvo3 yena māmahaḥ
verses.en: As she who in her parents' house is growing old, I pray to thee as Bhaga from the seat of all. Grant knowledge, mete it out and bring it to us here: give us the share wherewith thou makest people glad.

verses.sa:
भोजं त्वामिन्द्र वयं हुवेम ददिष्ट्वमिन्द्रापांसि वाजान् ।
अविड्ढीन्द्र चित्रया न ऊती कृधि वृषन्निन्द्र वस्यसो नः॥
verses.tr: bhojaṃ tvāmindra vayaṃ huvema dadiṣṭvamindrāpāṃsi vājān aviḍḍhīndra citrayā na ūtī kṛdhi vṛṣannindra vasyaso naḥ
verses.en: May we invoke thee as a liberal giver thou givest us, O Indra, strength and labours. Help us with manifold assistance, Indra: Migthy One, Indra, make us yet more wealthy.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now may that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, give in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
प्राता रथो नवो योजि सस्निश्चतुर्युगस्त्रिकशः सप्तरश्मिः ।
दशारित्रो मनुष्यः स्वर्षाः स इष्टिभिर्मतिभी रंह्यो भूत्॥
verses.tr: prātā ratho navo yoji sasniścaturyugastrikaśaḥ saptaraśmiḥ daśāritro manuṣyaḥ svarṣāḥ sa iṣṭibhirmatibhī raṃhyo bhūt
verses.en: The rich new car hath been equipped at morning; four yokes it hath, three whips, seven reins to guide it: Ten-sided, friendly to mankind, light-winner, that must be urged to speed with prayers and wishes.

verses.sa:
सास्मा अरं प्रथमं स द्वितीयमुतो तृतीयं मनुषः स होता ।
अन्यस्या गर्भमन्य ऊ जनन्त सो अन्येभिः सचते जेन्यो वृषा॥
verses.tr: sāsmā araṃ prathamaṃ sa dvitīyamuto tṛtīyaṃ manuṣaḥ sa hotā anyasyā garbhamanya ū jananta so anyebhiḥ sacate jenyo vṛṣā
verses.en: This is prepared for him the first, the second, and the third time: he is man's Priest and Herald. Others get offspring of another parent he goeth, as a noble Bull, with others.

verses.sa:
हरी नु कं रथ इन्द्रस्य योजमायै सूक्तेन वचसा नवेन ।
मो षु त्वामत्र बहवो हि विप्रा नि रीरमन् यजमानासो अन्ये॥
verses.tr: harī nu kaṃ ratha indrasya yojamāyai sūktena vacasā navena mo ṣu tvāmatra bahavo hi viprā ni rīraman yajamānāso anye
verses.en: To Indra's car the Bay Steeds have I harnessed, that new well-spoken words may bring him hither. Here let not other worshippers detain thee, for among us are many holy singers.

verses.sa:
आ द्वाभ्यां हरिभ्यामिन्द्र याह्या चतुर्भिरा षड्भिर्हूयमानः ।
आष्टाभिर्दशभिः सोमपेयमयं सुतः सुमख मा मृधस्कः॥
verses.tr: ā dvābhyāṃ haribhyāmindra yāhyā caturbhirā ṣaḍbhirhūyamānaḥ āṣṭābhirdaśabhiḥ somapeyamayaṃ sutaḥ sumakha mā mṛdhaskaḥ
verses.en: Indra, come hitherward with two Bay Coursers, come thou with four, with six when invocated. Come thou with eight, with ten, to drink the Soma. Here is the juice, brave Warrior: do not scorn it.

verses.sa:
आ विंशत्या त्रिंशता याह्यर्वाङा चत्वारिंशता हरिभिर्युजानः ।
आ पञ्चाशता सुरथेभिरिन्द्रा ऽऽ षष्ट्या सप्तत्या सोमपेयम्॥
verses.tr: ā viṃśatyā triṃśatā yāhyarvāṅā catvāriṃśatā haribhiryujānaḥ ā pañcāśatā surathebhirindrā '' ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā somapeyam
verses.en: O Indra, come thou hither having harnessed thy car with twenty, thirty, forty horses. Come thou with fifty well trained coursers, Indra, sixty or seventy, to drink the Soma.

verses.sa:
आशीत्या नवत्या याह्यर्वाङा शतेन हरिभिरुह्यमानः ।
अयं हि ते शुनहोत्रेषु सोम इन्द्र त्वाया परिषिक्तो मदाय॥
verses.tr: āśītyā navatyā yāhyarvāṅā śatena haribhiruhyamānaḥ ayaṃ hi te śunahotreṣu soma indra tvāyā pariṣikto madāya
verses.en: Come to us hitherward, O Indra, carried by eighty, ninety, or an hundred horses. This Soma juice among the Sunahotras hath been poured out, in love, to glad thee, Indra.

verses.sa:
मम ब्रह्मेन्द्र याह्यच्छा विश्वा हरी धुरि धिष्वा रथस्य ।
पुरुत्रा हि विहव्यो बभूथास्मिञ्छूर सवने मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: mama brahmendra yāhyacchā viśvā harī dhuri dhiṣvā rathasya purutrā hi vihavyo babhūthāsmiñchūra savane mādayasva
verses.en: To this my prayer, O Indra, come thou hither: bind to thy car's pole all thy two Bay Coursers. Thou art to be invoked in many places Hero, rejoice thyself in this libation.

verses.sa:
न म इन्द्रेण सख्यं वि योषदस्मभ्यमस्य दक्षिणा दुहीत ।
उप ज्येष्ठे वरूथे गभस्तौ प्रायेप्राये जिगीवांसः स्याम॥
verses.tr: na ma indreṇa sakhyaṃ vi yoṣadasmabhyamasya dakṣiṇā duhīta upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāyeprāye jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma
verses.en: Ne'er be my love from Indra disunited still may his liberal Milch-cow yield us treasure. So may we under his supreme protection, safe in his arms, succeed in each forth-going.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now may that wealthy Cow Of thine, O Indra, give in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
अपाय्यस्यान्धसो मदाय मनीषिणः सुवानस्य प्रयसः ।
यस्मिन्निन्द्रः प्रदिवि वावृधान ओको दधे ब्रह्मण्यन्तश्च नरः॥
verses.tr: apāyyasyāndhaso madāya manīṣiṇaḥ suvānasya prayasaḥ yasminnindraḥ pradivi vāvṛdhāna oko dadhe brahmaṇyantaśca naraḥ
verses.en: Draughts of this sweet juice have been drunk for rapture, of the wise Soma-presser's offered dainty, Wherein, grown mighty in the days aforetime, Indra hath found delight, and men who worship.

verses.sa:
अस्य मन्दानो मध्वो वज्रहस्तो ऽहिमिन्द्रो अर्णोवृतं वि वृश्चत् ।
प्र यद् वयो न स्वसराण्यच्छा प्रयांसि च नदीनां चक्रमन्त॥
verses.tr: asya mandāno madhvo vajrahasto 'himindro arṇovṛtaṃ vi vṛścat pra yad vayo na svasarāṇyacchā prayāṃsi ca nadīnāṃ cakramanta
verses.en: Cheered by this meath Indra, whose hand wields thunder, rent piecemeal Ahi who barred up the waters, So that the quickening currents of the rivers flowed forth like birds unto their resting-places.

verses.sa:
स माहिन इन्द्रो अर्णो अपां प्रैरयदहिहाच्छा समुद्रम् ।
अजनयत् सूर्यं विदद्गा अक्तुनाह्नां वयुनानि साधत्॥
verses.tr: sa māhina indro arṇo apāṃ prairayadahihācchā samudram ajanayat sūryaṃ vidadgā aktunāhnāṃ vayunāni sādhat
verses.en: Indra, this Mighty One, the Dragon's slayer, sent forth the flood of waters to the ocean. He gave the Sun his life, he found the cattle, and with the night the works of days completed.

verses.sa:
सो अप्रतीनि मनवे पुरूणीन्द्रो दाशद् दाशुषे हन्ति वृत्रम् ।
सद्यो यो नृभ्यो अतसाय्यो भूत्पस्पृधानेभ्यः सूर्यस्य सातौ॥
verses.tr: so apratīni manave purūṇīndro dāśad dāśuṣe hanti vṛtram sadyo yo nṛbhyo atasāyyo bhūtpaspṛdhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau
verses.en: To him who worshippeth hath Indra given many and matchless gifts. He slayeth Vrtra. Straight was he to be sought with supplications by men who struggled to obtain the sunlight.

verses.sa:
स सुन्वत इन्द्रः सूर्यमा ऽऽ देवो रिणङ्मर्त्याय स्तवान् ।
आ यद् रयिं गुहदवद्यमस्मै भरदंशं नैतशो दशस्यन्॥
verses.tr: sa sunvata indraḥ sūryamā '' devo riṇaṅmartyāya stavān ā yad rayiṃ guhadavadyamasmai bharadaṃśaṃ naitaśo daśasyan
verses.en: To him who poured him gifts he gave up Surya,-Indra, the God, the Mighty, to the mortal; For Etasa with worship brought him riches that keep distress afar, as 'twere his portion.

verses.sa:
स रन्धयत्सदिवः सारथये शुष्णमशुषं कुयवं कुत्साय ।
दिवोदासाय नवतिं च नवेन्द्रः पुरो व्यैरच्छम्बरस्य॥
verses.tr: sa randhayatsadivaḥ sārathaye śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ kuyavaṃ kutsāya divodāsāya navatiṃ ca navendraḥ puro vyairacchambarasya
verses.en: Once to the driver of his chariot, Kutsa, he gave up greedy Surya, plague of harvest; And Indra, for the sake of Divodasa demolished Sambara's nine-and-ninety castles.

verses.sa:
एवा त इन्द्रोचथमहेम श्रवस्या न त्मना वाजयन्तः ।
अश्याम तत् साप्तमाशुषाणा ननमो वधरदेवस्य पीयोः॥
verses.tr: evā ta indrocathamahema śravasyā na tmanā vājayantaḥ aśyāma tat sāptamāśuṣāṇā nanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ
verses.en: So have we brought our hymn to thee, O Indra, strengthening thee and fain ourselves for glory. May we with best endeavours gain this friendship, and mayst thou bend the godless scorner's weapons.

verses.sa:
एवा ते गृत्समदाः शूर मन्मावस्यवो न वयुनानि तक्षुः ।
ब्रह्मण्यन्त इन्द्र ते नवीय इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं सुम्नमश्युः॥
verses.tr: evā te gṛtsamadāḥ śūra manmāvasyavo na vayunāni takṣuḥ brahmaṇyanta indra te navīya iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ sumnamaśyuḥ
verses.en: Thus the Grtsamadas for thee, O Hero, have wrought their hymn and task as seeking favour. May they who worship thee afresh, O Indra, gain food and strength, bliss, and a happy dwelling.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now may that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, give in return a boon to him who lauds thee, Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
वयं ते वय इन्द्र विद्धि षु णः प्र भरामहे वाजयुर्न रथम् ।
विपन्यवो दीध्यतो मनीषा सुम्नमियक्षन्तस्त्वावतो नॄन्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te vaya indra viddhi ṣu ṇaḥ pra bharāmahe vājayurna ratham vipanyavo dīdhyato manīṣā sumnamiyakṣantastvāvato nṝn
