verses.en: As one brings forth his car when fain for combat, so bring we power to thee- regard us, Indra- Well skilled in song, thoughtful in spirit, seeking great bliss from one like thee amid the Heroes.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र त्वाभिरूती त्वायतो अभिष्टिपासि जनान् ।
त्वमिनो दाशुषो वरूतेत्थाधीरभि यो नक्षति त्वा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra tvābhirūtī tvāyato abhiṣṭipāsi janān tvamino dāśuṣo varūtetthādhīrabhi yo nakṣati tvā
verses.en: Indra, thou art our own with thy protection, a guardian near to men who love thee truly, Active art thou, the liberal man's defender, his who draws near to thee with right devotion.

verses.sa:
स नो युवेन्द्रो जोहूत्रः सखा शिवो नरामस्तु पाता ।
यः शंसन्तं यः शशमानमूती पचन्तं च स्तुवन्तं च प्रणेषत्॥
verses.tr: sa no yuvendro johūtraḥ sakhā śivo narāmastu pātā yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī pacantaṃ ca stuvantaṃ ca praṇeṣat
verses.en: May Indra, called with solemn invocations. the young, the Friend, be men's auspicious keeper, One who will further with his aid the singer, the toiler, praiser, dresser of oblations.

verses.sa:
तमु स्तुष इन्द्रं तं गृणीषे यस्मिन्पुरा वावृधुः शाशदुश्च ।
स वस्वः कामं पीपरदियानो ब्रह्मण्यतो नूतनस्यायोः॥
verses.tr: tamu stuṣa indraṃ taṃ gṛṇīṣe yasminpurā vāvṛdhuḥ śāśaduśca sa vasvaḥ kāmaṃ pīparadiyāno brahmaṇyato nūtanasyāyoḥ
verses.en: With laud and song let me extol that Indra in whom of old men prospered and were mighty. May he, implored, fulfil the prayer for plenty of him who worships, of the living mortal.

verses.sa:
सो अङ्गिरसामुचथा जुजुष्वान् ब्रह्मा तूतोदिन्द्रो गातुमिष्णन् ।
मुष्णन्नुषसः सूर्येण स्तवानश्नस्य चिच्छिश्नथत् पूर्व्याणि॥
verses.tr: so aṅgirasāmucathā jujuṣvān brahmā tūtodindro gātumiṣṇan muṣṇannuṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavānaśnasya cicchiśnathat pūrvyāṇi
verses.en: He, Indra whom the Angirases' praise delighted, strengthened their prayer and made their goings prosper. Stealing away the mornings with the sunlight, he, lauded, crushed even Asna's ancient powers.

verses.sa:
स ह श्रुत इन्द्रो नाम देव ऊर्ध्वो भुवन्मनुषे दस्मतमः ।
अव प्रियमर्शसानस्य साह्वाञ्छिरो भरद् दासस्य स्वधावान्॥
verses.tr: sa ha śruta indro nāma deva ūrdhvo bhuvanmanuṣe dasmatamaḥ ava priyamarśasānasya sāhvāñchiro bharad dāsasya svadhāvān
verses.en: He verily, the God, the glorious Indra, hath raised him up for man, best Wonder-Worker. He, self-reliant, mighty and triumphant, brought low the dear head of the wicked Dasa.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहेन्द्रः कृष्णयोनीः पुरंदरो दासीरैरयद्वि ।
अजनयन्मनवे क्षामपश्च सत्रा शंसं यजमानस्य तूतोत्॥
verses.tr: sa vṛtrahendraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ puraṃdaro dāsīrairayadvi ajanayanmanave kṣāmapaśca satrā śaṃsaṃ yajamānasya tūtot
verses.en: Indra the Vrtra-slayer, Fort-destroyer, scattered the Dasa hosts who dwelt in darkness. For men hath he created earth and waters, and ever helped the prayer of him who worships.

verses.sa:
तस्मै तवस्य१मनु दायि सत्रेन्द्राय देवेभिरर्णसातौ ।
प्रति यदस्य वज्रं बाह्वोर्धुर्हत्वी दस्यून् पुर आयसीर्नि तारीत्॥
verses.tr: tasmai tavasya1manu dāyi satrendrāya devebhirarṇasātau prati yadasya vajraṃ bāhvordhurhatvī dasyūn pura āyasīrni tārīt
verses.en: To him in might the Gods have ever yielded, to Indra in the tumult of the battle. When in his arms they laid the bolt, he slaughtered the Dasyus and cast down their forts of iron.

verses.sa:
नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।
शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now may that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, give in return a boon to him who lauds thee. Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
विश्वजिते धनजिते स्वर्जिते सत्राजिते नृजित उर्वराजिते ।
अश्वजिते गोजिते अब्जिते भरेन्द्राय सोमं यजताय हर्यतम्॥
verses.tr: viśvajite dhanajite svarjite satrājite nṛjita urvarājite aśvajite gojite abjite bharendrāya somaṃ yajatāya haryatam
verses.en: To him the Lord of all, the Lord of wealth, of light; him who is Lord for ever, Lord of men and tilth, Him who is Lord of horses, Lord of kine,of floods, to Indra, to the Holy bring sweet Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अभिभुवेऽभिभङ्गाय वन्वते ऽषाळहाय सहमानाय वेधसे ।
तुविग्रये वह्नये दुष्टरीतवे सत्रासाहे नम इन्द्राय वोचत॥
verses.tr: abhibhuve'bhibhaṅgāya vanvate 'ṣāḻahāya sahamānāya vedhase tuvigraye vahnaye duṣṭarītave satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata
verses.en: To him the potent One, who conquers and breaks down, the Victor never vanquished who disposes all, The migbty-voiced, the rider, unassailable, to Indra everconquering speak your reverent prayer.

verses.sa:
सत्रासाहो जनभक्षो जनंसहश्च्यवनो युध्मो अनु जोषमुक्षितः ।
वृतंचयः सहुरिर्विक्ष्वारित इन्द्रस्य वोचं प्र कृतानि वीर्या॥
verses.tr: satrāsāho janabhakṣo janaṃsahaścyavano yudhmo anu joṣamukṣitaḥ vṛtaṃcayaḥ sahurirvikṣvārita indrasya vocaṃ pra kṛtāni vīryā
verses.en: Still Victor, loved by mortals, ruler over men, o'erthrower, warrior, he hath waxen as he would; Host-gatherer, triumphant, honoured mid the folk. Indra's heroic deeds will I tell forth to all.

verses.sa:
अनानुदो वृषभो दोधतो वधो गम्भीर ऋष्वो असमष्टकाव्यः ।
रध्रचोदः श्नथनो वीळितस्पृथुरिन्द्रः सुयज्ञ उषसः स्वर्जनत्॥
verses.tr: anānudo vṛṣabho dodhato vadho gambhīra ṛṣvo asamaṣṭakāvyaḥ radhracodaḥ śnathano vīḻitaspṛthurindraḥ suyajña uṣasaḥ svarjanat
verses.en: The strong who never yields, who slew the furious fiend, the deep, the vast, of wisdom unattainable; Who speeds the good, the breaker-down, the firm, the vast,-Indra whose rites bring joy hath made the light of Dawn.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन गातुमप्तुरो विविद्रिरे धियो हिन्वाना उशिजो मनीषिणः ।
अभिस्वरा निषदा गा अवस्यव इन्द्रे हिन्वाना द्रविणान्याशत॥
verses.tr: yajñena gātumapturo vividrire dhiyo hinvānā uśijo manīṣiṇaḥ abhisvarā niṣadā gā avasyava indre hinvānā draviṇānyāśata
verses.en: By sacrifice the yearning sages sending forth their songs found furtherance from him who speeds the flood. In Indra seeking help with worship and with hymn, they drew him to themselves and won them kine and wealth.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र श्रेष्ठानि द्रविणानि धेहि चित्तिं दक्षस्य सुभगत्वमस्मे ।
पोषं रयीणामरिष्टिं तनूनां स्वाद्मानं वाचः सुदिनत्वमह्नाम्॥
verses.tr: indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittiṃ dakṣasya subhagatvamasme poṣaṃ rayīṇāmariṣṭiṃ tanūnāṃ svādmānaṃ vācaḥ sudinatvamahnām
verses.en: Indra, bestow on us the best of treasures, the spirit of ability and fortune; Increase of riches, safety of our bodies, charm of sweet speech, and days of pleasant weather.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृपत् सोममपिबद् विष्णुना सुतं यथावशत् ।
स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुं सैनं सश्चद् देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛpat somamapibad viṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ
verses.en: At the Trikadrukas the Great and Strong hath drunk drink blent with meal. With Visnu hath he quaffed the poured out Soma juice, all that he would. That hath so heightened him the Great, the Wide, to do his mighty work. So may the God attain the God, true Indu Indra who is true.

verses.sa:
अध त्विषीमाँ अभ्योजसा क्रिविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे ।
अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत सैनं सश्चद् देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: adha tviṣīmāṃ abhyojasā kriviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ
verses.en: So he resplendent in the battle overcame Krivi by might. He with his majesty hath filled the earth and heaven, and waxen strong. One share of the libation hath he swallowed down: one share he left. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.

verses.sa:
साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः ।
दाता राधः स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सैनं सश्चद् देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ dātā rādhaḥ stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ
verses.en: Brought forth together with wisdom and mighty power thou grewest great; with hero deeds subduing the malevolent, most swift in act; Giving prosperity, and lovely wealth to him who praiseth thee. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.

verses.sa:
तव त्यन्नर्यं नृतोऽप इन्द्र प्रथमं पूर्व्यं दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतम् ।
यद् देवस्य शवसा प्रारिणा असुं रिणन्नपः ।
भुवद् विश्वमभ्यादेवमोजसा विदादूर्जं शतक्रतुर्विदादिषम्॥
verses.tr: tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam yad devasya śavasā prāriṇā asuṃ riṇannapaḥ bhuvad viśvamabhyādevamojasā vidādūrjaṃ śatakraturvidādiṣam
verses.en: This, Indra, was thy hero deed, Dancer, thy first and ancient work, worthy to be told forth in heaven, What time thou sentest down life with a God's own power, freeing the floods. All that is godless may he conquer with his might, and, Lord of Hundred Powers, find for us strength and food.

verses.sa:
गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनामुपमश्रवस्तमम् ।
ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्मणां ब्रह्मणस्पत आ नः शृण्वन्नूतिभिः सीद सादनम्॥
verses.tr: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnāmupamaśravastamam jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ śṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam
verses.en: We call thee, Lord and Leader of the heavenly hosts, the wise among the wise, the famousest of all, The King supreme of prayers, O Brahmanaspati: hear us with help; sit down in place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
देवाश्चित् ते असुर्य प्रचेतसो बृहस्पते यज्ञियं भागमानशुः ।
उस्रा इव सूर्यो ज्योतिषा महो विश्वेषामिज्जनिता ब्रह्मणामसि॥
verses.tr: devāścit te asurya pracetaso bṛhaspate yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśuḥ usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā maho viśveṣāmijjanitā brahmaṇāmasi
verses.en: Brhaspati, God immortal! verily the Gods have gained from thee, the wise, a share in holy rites. As with great light the Sun brings forth the rays of morn, so thou alone art Father of all sacred prayer.

verses.sa:
आ विबाध्या परिरापस्तमांसि च ज्योतिष्मन्तं रथमृतस्य तिष्ठसि ।
बृहस्पते भीमममित्रदम्भनं रक्षोहणं गोत्रभिदं स्वर्विदम्॥
verses.tr: ā vibādhyā parirāpastamāṃsi ca jyotiṣmantaṃ rathamṛtasya tiṣṭhasi bṛhaspate bhīmamamitradambhanaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ gotrabhidaṃ svarvidam
verses.en: When thou hast chased away revilers and the gloom, thou mountest the refulgent car of sacrifice; The awful car, Brhaspati, that quells the foe, slays demons, cleaves the stall of kine, and finds the light.

verses.sa:
सुनीतिभिर्नयसि त्रायसे जनं यस्तुभ्यं दाशान्न तमंहो अश्नवत् ।
ब्रह्मद्विषस्तपनो मन्युमीरसि बृहस्पते महि तत् ते महित्वनम्॥
verses.tr: sunītibhirnayasi trāyase janaṃ yastubhyaṃ dāśānna tamaṃho aśnavat brahmadviṣastapano manyumīrasi bṛhaspate mahi tat te mahitvanam
verses.en: Thou leadest with good guidance and preservest men; distress o'ertakes not him who offers gifts to thee. Him who hates prayer thou punishest, Brhaspati, quelling his wrath: herein is thy great mightiness.

verses.sa:
न तमंहो न दुरितं कुतश्चन नारातयस्तितिरुर्न द्वयाविनः ।
विश्वा इदस्माद् ध्वरसो वि बाधसे यं सुगोपा रक्षसि ब्रह्मणस्पते॥
verses.tr: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ kutaścana nārātayastitirurna dvayāvinaḥ viśvā idasmād dhvaraso vi bādhase yaṃ sugopā rakṣasi brahmaṇaspate
verses.en: No sorrow, no distress from any side, no foes, no creatures double-tongued have overcome the man,- Thou drivest all seductive fiends away from him whom, careful guard, thou keepest Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो गोपाः पथिकृद् विचक्षणस्तव व्रताय मतिभिर्जरामहे ।
बृहस्पते यो नो अभि ह्वरो दधे स्वा तं मर्मर्तु दुच्छुना हरस्वती॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no gopāḥ pathikṛd vicakṣaṇastava vratāya matibhirjarāmahe bṛhaspate yo no abhi hvaro dadhe svā taṃ marmartu ducchunā harasvatī
verses.en: Thou art our keeper, wise, preparer of our paths: we, for thy service, sing to thee with hymns of praise. Brhaspati, whoever lays a snare for us, him may his evil fate, precipitate, destroy.

verses.sa:
उत वा यो नो मर्चयादनागसो ऽरातीवा मर्तः सानुको वृकः ।
बृहस्पते अप तं वर्तया पथः सुगं नो अस्यै देववीतये कृधि॥
verses.tr: uta vā yo no marcayādanāgaso 'rātīvā martaḥ sānuko vṛkaḥ bṛhaspate apa taṃ vartayā pathaḥ sugaṃ no asyai devavītaye kṛdhi
verses.en: Him, too, who threatens us without offence of ours, the evil minded, arrogant, rapacious man,- Him turn thou from our path away, Brhaspati: give us fair access to this banquet of the Gods.

verses.sa:
त्रातारं त्वा तनूनां हवामहे ऽवस्पर्तरधिवक्तारमस्मयुम् ।
बृहस्पते देवनिदो नि बर्हय मा दुरेवा उत्तरं सुम्नमुन्नशन्॥
verses.tr: trātāraṃ tvā tanūnāṃ havāmahe 'vaspartaradhivaktāramasmayum bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṃ sumnamunnaśan
verses.en: Thee as protector of our bodies we invoke, thee, saviour, as the comforter who loveth us. Strike, O Brhaspati, the Gods' revilers down, and let not the unrighteous come to highest bliss.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं सुवृधा ब्रह्मणस्पते स्पार्हा वसु मनुष्या ददीमहि ।
या नो दूरे तळितो या अरातयो ऽभि सन्ति जम्भया ता अनप्नसः॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ suvṛdhā brahmaṇaspate spārhā vasu manuṣyā dadīmahi yā no dūre taḻito yā arātayo 'bhi santi jambhayā tā anapnasaḥ
verses.en: Through thee, kind -prosperer, O Brahmanaspati, may we obtain the wealth of Men which all desire: And all our enemies, who near or far away prevail against us, crush, and leave them destitute.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयमुत्तमं धीमहे वयो बृहस्पते पप्रिणा सस्निना युजा ।
मा नो दुःशंसो अभिदिप्सुरीशत प्र सुशंसा मतिभिस्तारिषीमहि॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayamuttamaṃ dhīmahe vayo bṛhaspate papriṇā sasninā yujā mā no duḥśaṃso abhidipsurīśata pra suśaṃsā matibhistāriṣīmahi
verses.en: With thee as our own rich and liberal ally may we, Brhaspati, gain highest power of life. Let not the guileful wicked man be lord of us:-still may we prosper, singing goodly hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
अनानुदो वृषभो जग्मिराहवं निष्टप्ता शत्रुं पृतनासु सासहिः ।
असि सत्य ऋणया ब्रह्मणस्पत उग्रस्य चिद् दमिता वीळुहर्षिणः॥
verses.tr: anānudo vṛṣabho jagmirāhavaṃ niṣṭaptā śatruṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspata ugrasya cid damitā vīḻuharṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: Strong, never yielding, hastening to the battle-cry, consumer of the foe, victorious in the strife, Thou art sin's true avenger, Brahmanaspati, who tamest e'en the fierce, the wildly passionate.

verses.sa:
अदेवेन मनसा यो रिषण्यति शासामुग्रो मन्यमानो जिघांसति ।
बृहस्पते मा प्रणक् तस्य नो वधो नि कर्म मन्युं दुरेवस्य शर्धतः॥
verses.tr: adevena manasā yo riṣaṇyati śāsāmugro manyamāno jighāṃsati bṛhaspate mā praṇak tasya no vadho ni karma manyuṃ durevasya śardhataḥ
verses.en: Whoso with mind ungodly seeks to do us harm, who, deeming him a man of might mid lords, would slay,- Let not his deadly blow reach us, Brhaspati; may we humiliate the strong ill-doer's wrath.

verses.sa:
भरेषु हव्यो नमसोपसद्यो गन्ता वाजेषु सनिता धनंधनम् ।
विश्वा इदर्यो अभिदिप्स्वो३ मृधो बृहस्पतिर्वि ववर्हा रथाँ इव॥
verses.tr: bhareṣu havyo namasopasadyo gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanaṃdhanam viśvā idaryo abhidipsvo3 mṛdho bṛhaspatirvi vavarhā rathāṃ iva
verses.en: The mover mid the spoil, the winner of all wealth, to be invoked in fight and reverently adored, Brhaspati hath overthrown like cars of war all wicked enemies who fain would injure us.

verses.sa:
तेजिष्ठया तपनी रक्षसस्तप ये त्वा निदे दधिरे दृष्टवीर्यम् ।
आविस्तत् कृष्व यदसत् त उक्थ्यं१बृहस्पते वि परिरापो अर्दय॥
verses.tr: tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasastapa ye tvā nide dadhire dṛṣṭavīryam āvistat kṛṣva yadasat ta ukthyaṃ1bṛhaspate vi parirāpo ardaya
verses.en: Burn up the demons with thy fiercest flaming brand, those who have scorned thee in thy manifested might. Show forth that power that shall deserve the hymn of praise: destroy the evil speakers, O Brhaspati.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते अति यदर्यो अर्हाद् द्युमद्विभाति क्रतुमज्जनेषु ।
यद् दीदयच्छवस ऋतप्रजात तदस्मासु द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhād dyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu yad dīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram
verses.en: Brhaspati, that which the foe deserves not which shines among the folk effectual, splendid, That, Son of Law I which is with might refulgent-that treasure wonderful bestow thou on us.

verses.sa:
मा नः स्तेनेभ्यो ये अभि द्रुहस्पदे निरामिणो रिपवोऽन्नेषु जागृधुः ।
आ देवानामोहते वि व्रयो हृदि बृहस्पते न परः साम्नो विदुः॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ stenebhyo ye abhi druhaspade nirāmiṇo ripavo'nneṣu jāgṛdhuḥ ā devānāmohate vi vrayo hṛdi bṛhaspate na paraḥ sāmno viduḥ
verses.en: Give us not up to those who, foes in ambuscade, are greedy for the wealth of him who sits at ease, Who cherish in their heart abandonment of Gods. Brhaspati, no further rest shall they obtain.

verses.sa:
विश्वेभ्यो हि त्वा भुवनेभ्यस्परि त्वष्टाजनत् साम्नःसाम्नः कविः ।
स ऋणचिदृणया ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्द्रुहो हन्ता मह ऋतस्य धर्तरि॥
verses.tr: viśvebhyo hi tvā bhuvanebhyaspari tvaṣṭājanat sāmnaḥsāmnaḥ kaviḥ sa ṛṇacidṛṇayā brahmaṇaspatirdruho hantā maha ṛtasya dhartari
verses.en: For Tvastar, he who knows each sacred song, brought thee to life, preeminent o'er all the things that be. Guilt-scourger, guilt-avenger is Brhaspati, who slays the spoiler and upholds the mighty Law.

verses.sa:
तव श्रिये व्यजिहीत पर्वतो गवां गोत्रमुदसृजो यदङ्गिरः ।
इन्द्रेण युजा तमसा परीवृतं बृहस्पते निरपामौब्जो अर्णवम्॥
verses.tr: tava śriye vyajihīta parvato gavāṃ gotramudasṛjo yadaṅgiraḥ indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtaṃ bṛhaspate nirapāmaubjo arṇavam
verses.en: The mountain, for thy glory, cleft itself apart when, Angiras! thou openedst the stall of kine. Thoul O Brhaspati, with Indra for ally didst hurl down water-floods which gloom had compassed round.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व ।
विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn and prosper thou our children. All that the Gods regard with love is blessed. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
सेमामविड्ढि प्रभृतिं य ईशिषे ऽया विधेम नवया महा गिरा ।
यथा नो मीढ्वान् त्स्तवते सखा तव बृहस्पते सीषधः सोत नो मतिम्॥
verses.tr: semāmaviḍḍhi prabhṛtiṃ ya īśiṣe 'yā vidhema navayā mahā girā yathā no mīḍhvān tstavate sakhā tava bṛhaspate sīṣadhaḥ sota no matim
verses.en: Be pleased with this our offering, thou who art the Lord; we will adore thee with this new and mighty song. As this thy friend, our liberal patron, praises thee, do thou, Brhaspati, fulfil our hearts' desire.

verses.sa:
यो नन्त्वान्यनमन्न्योजसोतादर्दर्मन्युना शम्बराणि वि ।
प्राच्यावयदच्युता ब्रह्मणस्पतिरा चाविशद् वसुमन्तं वि पर्वतम्॥
verses.tr: yo nantvānyanamannyojasotādardarmanyunā śambarāṇi vi prācyāvayadacyutā brahmaṇaspatirā cāviśad vasumantaṃ vi parvatam
verses.en: He who with might bowed down the things that should be bowed, and in his fury rent the holds of Sambara: Who overthrew what shook not, Brahmapaspati,-he made his way within the mountain stored with wealth.

verses.sa:
तद् देवानां देवतमाय कर्त्वमश्रथ्नन् दृळहाव्रदन्त वीळिता ।
उद्गा आजदभिनद् ब्रह्मणा वलमगूहत्तमो व्यचक्षयत् स्वः॥
verses.tr: tad devānāṃ devatamāya kartvamaśrathnan dṛḻahāvradanta vīḻitā udgā ājadabhinad brahmaṇā valamagūhattamo vyacakṣayat svaḥ
verses.en: That was a great deed for the Godliest of the Gods: strong things were loosened and the firmly fixed gave way. He drave the kine forth and cleft Vala through by prayer, dispelled the darkness and displayed the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
अश्मास्यमवतं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मधुधारमभि यमोजसातृणत् ।
तमेव विश्वे पपिरे स्वर्दृशो बहु साकं सिसिचुरुत्समुद्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: aśmāsyamavataṃ brahmaṇaspatirmadhudhāramabhi yamojasātṛṇat tameva viśve papire svardṛśo bahu sākaṃ sisicurutsamudriṇam
verses.en: The well with mouth of stone that poured a flood of meath, which Brahmapaspati hath opened with his might- All they who see the light have drunk their fill thereat: together they have made the watery fount flow forth.

verses.sa:
सना ता का चिद् भुवना भवीत्वा माद्भिः शरद्भिर्दुरो वरन्त वः ।
अयतन्ता चरतो अन्यदन्यदिद् या चकार वयुना ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: sanā tā kā cid bhuvanā bhavītvā mādbhiḥ śaradbhirduro varanta vaḥ ayatantā carato anyadanyadid yā cakāra vayunā brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: Ancient will be those creatures, whatsoe'er they be; with moons, with autumns, doors unclose themselves to you. Effortless they pass on to perfect this and that, appointed works which Brahmanaspati ordained.

verses.sa:
अभिनक्षन्तो अभि ये तमानशुर्निधिं पणीनां परमं गुहा हितम् ।
ते विद्वांसः प्रतिचक्ष्यानृता पुनर्यत उ आयन् तदुदीयुराविशम्॥
verses.tr: abhinakṣanto abhi ye tamānaśurnidhiṃ paṇīnāṃ paramaṃ guhā hitam te vidvāṃsaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punaryata u āyan tadudīyurāviśam
verses.en: They who with much endeavour searching round obtained the Panis' noblest treasure hidden in the cave,- Those sages, having marked the falsehoods, turned them back whence they had come, and sought again to enter in.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानः प्रतिचक्ष्यानृता पुनरात आ तस्थुः कवयो महस्पथः ।
ते बाहुभ्यां धमितमग्निमश्मनि नकिः षो अस्त्यरणो जहुर्हि तम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punarāta ā tasthuḥ kavayo mahaspathaḥ te bāhubhyāṃ dhamitamagnimaśmani nakiḥ ṣo astyaraṇo jahurhi tam
verses.en: The pious ones when they had seen the falsehoods turned them back, the sages stood again upon the lofty ways. Cast down with both their arms upon the rock they left the kindled fire, and said, No enemy is he.

verses.sa:
ऋतज्येन क्षिप्रेण ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्यत्र वष्टि प्र तदश्नोति धन्वना ।
तस्य साध्वीरिषवो याभिरस्यति नृचक्षसो दृशये कर्णयोनयः॥
verses.tr: ṛtajyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaspatiryatra vaṣṭi pra tadaśnoti dhanvanā tasya sādhvīriṣavo yābhirasyati nṛcakṣaso dṛśaye karṇayonayaḥ
verses.en: With his swift bow, strung truly, Brahmanaspati reaches the mark whate'er it be that he desires. Excellent are the arrows wherewithal he shoots, keen-eyed to look on men and springing from his ear.

verses.sa:
स संनयः स विनयः पुरोहितः स सुष्टुतः स युधि ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
चाक्ष्मो यद् वाजं भरते मती धना ऽऽदित् सूर्यस्तपति तप्यतुर्वृथा॥
verses.tr: sa saṃnayaḥ sa vinayaḥ purohitaḥ sa suṣṭutaḥ sa yudhi brahmaṇaspatiḥ cākṣmo yad vājaṃ bharate matī dhanā ''dit sūryastapati tapyaturvṛthā
verses.en: He brings together and he parts, the great High Priest; extolled is he, in battle Brahmapaspati. When, gracious, for the hymn he brings forth food and wealth, the glowing Sun untroubled sends forth fervent heat.

verses.sa:
विभु प्रभु प्रथमं मेहनावतो बृहस्पतेः सुविदत्राणि राध्या ।
इमा सातानि वेन्यस्य वाजिनो येन जना उभये भुञ्जते विशः॥
verses.tr: vibhu prabhu prathamaṃ mehanāvato bṛhaspateḥ suvidatrāṇi rādhyā imā sātāni venyasya vājino yena janā ubhaye bhuñjate viśaḥ
verses.en: First and preeminent, excelling all besides are the kind gifts of liberal Brhaspati. These are the boons of him the Strong who should be loved, whereby both classes and the people have delight.

verses.sa:
योऽवरे वृजने विश्वथा विभुर्महामु रण्वः शवसा ववक्षिथ ।
स देवो देवान् प्रति पप्रथे पृथु विश्वेदु ता परिभूर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yo'vare vṛjane viśvathā vibhurmahāmu raṇvaḥ śavasā vavakṣitha sa devo devān prati paprathe pṛthu viśvedu tā paribhūrbrahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: Thou who in every way supreme in earthly power, rejoicing, by thy mighty strength hast waxen great,- He is the God spread forth in breadth against the Gods: he, Brahmanaspati, encompasseth this All.

verses.sa:
विश्वं सत्यं मघवाना युवोरिदापश्चन प्र मिनन्ति व्रतं वाम् ।
अच्छेन्द्राब्रह्मणस्पती हविर्नो ऽन्नं युजेव वाजिना जिगातम्॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃ satyaṃ maghavānā yuvoridāpaścana pra minanti vrataṃ vām acchendrābrahmaṇaspatī havirno 'nnaṃ yujeva vājinā jigātam
verses.en: From you, twain Maghavans, all truth proceedeth: even the waters break not your commandment. Come to us, Brahmanaspati and Indra, to our oblation like yoked steeds to fodder.

verses.sa:
उताशिष्ठा अनु शृण्वन्ति वह्नयः सभेयो विप्रो भरते मती धना ।
वीळुद्वेषा अनु वश ऋणमाददिः स ह वाजी समिथे ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: utāśiṣṭhā anu śṛṇvanti vahnayaḥ sabheyo vipro bharate matī dhanā vīḻudveṣā anu vaśa ṛṇamādadiḥ sa ha vājī samithe brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: The sacrificial flames most swiftly hear the call: the priest of the assembly gaineth wealth for hymns. Hating the stern, remitting at his will the debt, strong in the shock of fight is Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणस्पतेरभवद् यथावशं सत्यो मन्युर्महि कर्मा करिष्यतः ।
यो गा उदाजत् स दिवे वि चाभजन् महीव रीतिः शवसासरत् पृथक्॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspaterabhavad yathāvaśaṃ satyo manyurmahi karmā kariṣyataḥ yo gā udājat sa dive vi cābhajan mahīva rītiḥ śavasāsarat pṛthak
verses.en: The wrath of Brahmanaspati according to his will had full effect when he would do a mighty deed. The kine he drave forth and distributed to heaven, even as a copious flood with strength flows sundry ways.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणस्पते सुयमस्य विश्वहा रायः स्याम रथ्यो३ वयस्वतः ।
वीरेषु वीराँ उप पृङ्धि नस्त्वं यदीशानो ब्रह्मणा वेषि मे हवम्॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspate suyamasya viśvahā rāyaḥ syāma rathyo3 vayasvataḥ vīreṣu vīrāṃ upa pṛṅdhi nastvaṃ yadīśāno brahmaṇā veṣi me havam
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, may we be evermore masters of wealth well-guided, full of vital strength. Heroes on heroes send abundantly to us, when thou omnipotent through prayer seekest my call.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व ।
विश्वं तद् भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn, and prosper thou our children. All that the Gods regard with love is blessed. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
इन्धानो अग्निं वनवद् वनुष्यतः कृतब्रह्मा शूशुवद् रातहव्य इत् ।
जातेन जातमति स प्र सर्सृते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: indhāno agniṃ vanavad vanuṣyataḥ kṛtabrahmā śūśuvad rātahavya it jātena jātamati sa pra sarsṛte yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: He lighting up the flame shall conquer enemies: strong shall he be who offers prayer and brings his gift. He with his seed spreads forth beyond another's seed, whomever Brahmanaspati takes for his friend.

verses.sa:
वीरेभिर्वीरान् वनवद् वनुष्यतो गोभी रयिं पप्रथद् बोधति त्मना ।
तोकं च तस्य तनयं च वर्धते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: vīrebhirvīrān vanavad vanuṣyato gobhī rayiṃ paprathad bodhati tmanā tokaṃ ca tasya tanayaṃ ca vardhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: With heroes he shall overcome his hero foes, and spread his wealth by kine wise by himself is be. His children and his children's children grow in strength, whomever Brahmanaspati takes for his friend.

verses.sa:
सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः शिमीवाँ ऋघायतो वृषेव वध्रीँरभि वष्ट्योजसा ।
अग्नेरिव प्रसितिर्नाह वर्तवे यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: sindhurna kṣodaḥ śimīvāṃ ṛghāyato vṛṣeva vadhrīṃrabhi vaṣṭyojasā agneriva prasitirnāha vartave yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: He, mighty like a raving river's billowy flood, as a bull conquers oxen, overcomes with strength. Like Agni's blazing rush he may not be restrained, whomever Brahmanaspati takes for his friend.

verses.sa:
तस्मा अर्षन्ति दिव्या असश्चतः स सत्वभिः प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति ।
अनिभृष्टतविषिर्हन्त्योजसा यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: tasmā arṣanti divyā asaścataḥ sa satvabhiḥ prathamo goṣu gacchati anibhṛṣṭataviṣirhantyojasā yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: For him the floods of heaven flow never failing down: first with the heroes he goes forth to war for kine. He slays in unabated vigour with great might, whomever Brahmanaspati takes for his friend.

verses.sa:
तस्मा इद् विश्वे धुनयन्त सिन्धवो ऽच्छिद्रा शर्म दधिरे पुरूणि ।
देवानां सुम्ने सुभगः स एधते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: tasmā id viśve dhunayanta sindhavo 'cchidrā śarma dadhire purūṇi devānāṃ sumne subhagaḥ sa edhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: All roaring rivers pour their waters down for him, and many a flawless shelter hath been granted him. Blest with the happiness of Gods he prospers well, whomever Brahmanaspati takes for his friend.

verses.sa:
ऋजुरिच्छंसो वनवद् वनुष्यतो देवयन्निददेवयन्तमभ्यसत् ।
सुप्रावीरिद् वनवत् पृत्सु दुष्टरं यज्वेदयज्योर्वि भजाति भोजनम्॥
verses.tr: ṛjuricchaṃso vanavad vanuṣyato devayannidadevayantamabhyasat suprāvīrid vanavat pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ yajvedayajyorvi bhajāti bhojanam
verses.en: The righteous singer shall o'ercome his enemies, and he who serves the Gods subdue the godless man. The zealous man shall vanquish the invincible, the worshipper share the food of him who worships not.

verses.sa:
यजस्व वीर प्र विहि मनायतो भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये ।
हविष्कृणुष्व सुभगो यथाससि ब्रह्मणस्पतेरव आ वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: yajasva vīra pra vihi manāyato bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye haviṣkṛṇuṣva subhago yathāsasi brahmaṇaspaterava ā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Worship, thou hero, chase the arrogant afar: put on auspicious courage for the fight with foes. Prepare oblation so that thou mayst have success. we crave the favouring help of Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
स इज्जनेन स विशा स जन्मना स पुत्रैर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिः ।
देवानां यः पितरमाविवासति श्रद्धामना हविषा ब्रह्मणस्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: sa ijjanena sa viśā sa janmanā sa putrairvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ devānāṃ yaḥ pitaramāvivāsati śraddhāmanā haviṣā brahmaṇaspatim
verses.en: He with his folk, his house, his family, his sons, gains booty for himself, and, with the heroes, wealth,believing Who with oblation and a true heart serves Brahmanaspati the Father of the Gods.

verses.sa:
यो अस्मै हव्यैर्घृतवद्भिरविधत् प्र तं प्राचा नयति ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
उरुष्यतीमंहसो रक्षती रिषों३ ऽहोश्चिदस्मा उरुचक्रिरद्भुतः॥
verses.tr: yo asmai havyairghṛtavadbhiravidhat pra taṃ prācā nayati brahmaṇaspatiḥ uruṣyatīmaṃhaso rakṣatī riṣoṃ3 'hościdasmā urucakriradbhutaḥ
verses.en: Whoso hath honoured him with offerings rich in oil, him Brahmanaspati leads forward on his way, Saves him from sorrow, frees him from his enemy, and is his wonderful deliverer from woe.

verses.sa:
इमा गिर आदित्येभ्यो घृतस्नूः सनाद् राजभ्यो जुह्वा जुहोमि ।
शृणोतु मित्रो अर्यमा भगो नस्तुविजातो वरुणो दक्षो अंशः॥
verses.tr: imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanād rājabhyo juhvā juhomi śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ
verses.en: These hymns that drop down fatness, with the ladle I ever offer to the Kings Adityas. May Mitra, Aryaman, and Bhaga hear us, the mighty Varuna Daksa, and Amsa.

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोमं सक्रतवो मे अद्य मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो जुषन्त ।
आदित्यासः शुचयो धारपूता अवृजिना अनवद्या अरिष्टाः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ stomaṃ sakratavo me adya mitro aryamā varuṇo juṣanta ādityāsaḥ śucayo dhārapūtā avṛjinā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ
verses.en: With one accord may Aryaman and Mitra and Varuna this day accept this praise-song- Adityas bright and pure as streams of water, free from all guile and falsehood, blameless, perfect.

verses.sa:
त आदित्यास उरवो गभीरा अदब्धासो दिप्सन्तो भूर्यक्षाः ।
अन्तः पश्यन्ति वृजिनोत साधु सर्वं राजभ्यः परमा चिदन्ति॥
verses.tr: ta ādityāsa uravo gabhīrā adabdhāso dipsanto bhūryakṣāḥ antaḥ paśyanti vṛjinota sādhu sarvaṃ rājabhyaḥ paramā cidanti
verses.en: These Gods, Adityas, vast, profound, and faithful, with many eyes, fain to deceive the wicked, Looking within behold the good and evil near to the Kings is even the thing most distant.

verses.sa:
धारयन्त आदित्यासो जगत् स्था देवा विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
दीर्घाधियो रक्षमाणा असुर्यमृतावानश्चयमाना ऋणानि॥
verses.tr: dhārayanta ādityāso jagat sthā devā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ dīrghādhiyo rakṣamāṇā asuryamṛtāvānaścayamānā ṛṇāni
verses.en: Upholding that which moves and that which moves not, Adityas, Gods, protectors of all being, Provident, guarding well the world of spirits, true to eternal Law, the debt-exactors.

verses.sa:
विद्यामादित्या अवसो वो अस्य यदर्यमन् भय आ चिन्मयोभु ।
युष्माकं मित्रावरुणा प्रणीतौ परि श्वभ्रेव दुरितानि वृज्याम्॥
verses.tr: vidyāmādityā avaso vo asya yadaryaman bhaya ā cinmayobhu yuṣmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇā praṇītau pari śvabhreva duritāni vṛjyām
verses.en: May I, Adityas, share me this your favour which, Aryaman, brings profit e'en in danger. Under your guidance, Varuna and Mitra, round troubles may I pass, like rugged places.

verses.sa:
सुगो हि वो अर्यमन्मित्र पन्था अनृक्षरो वरुण साधुरस्ति ।
तेनादित्या अधि वोचता नो यच्छता नो दुष्परिहन्तु शर्म॥
verses.tr: sugo hi vo aryamanmitra panthā anṛkṣaro varuṇa sādhurasti tenādityā adhi vocatā no yacchatā no duṣparihantu śarma
verses.en: Smooth is your path, O Aryaman and Mitra; excellent is it, Varuna, and thornless. Thereon, Adityas, send us down your blessing: grant us a shelter hard to be demolished.

verses.sa:
पिपर्तु नो अदिती राजपुत्रा ऽति द्वेषांस्यर्यमा सुगेभिः ।
बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य शर्मोप स्याम पुरुवीरा अरिष्टाः॥
verses.tr: pipartu no aditī rājaputrā 'ti dveṣāṃsyaryamā sugebhiḥ bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya śarmopa syāma puruvīrā ariṣṭāḥ
verses.en: Mother of Kings, may Aditi transport us, by fair paths Aryaman, beyond all hatred. May we uninjured, girt by many heroes, win Varuna's and Mitra's high protection.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो भूमीर्धारयन् त्रीँरुत द्यून् त्रीणि व्रता विदथे अन्तरेषाम् ।
ऋतेनादित्या महि वो महित्वं तदर्यमन् वरुण मित्र चारु॥
verses.tr: tisro bhūmīrdhārayan trīṃruta dyūn trīṇi vratā vidathe antareṣām ṛtenādityā mahi vo mahitvaṃ tadaryaman varuṇa mitra cāru
verses.en: With their support they stay three earths, three heavens; three are their functions in the Gods' assembly. Mighty through Law, Adityas, is your greatness; fair is it, Aryaman, Varuna, and Mitra.

verses.sa:
त्री रोचना दिव्या धारयन्त हिरण्ययाः शुचयो धारपूताः ।
अस्वप्नजो अनिमिषा अदब्धा उरुशंसा ऋजवे मर्त्याय॥
verses.tr: trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayo dhārapūtāḥ asvapnajo animiṣā adabdhā uruśaṃsā ṛjave martyāya
verses.en: Golden and splendid, pure like streams of water, they hold aloft the three bright heavenly regions. Ne'er do they slumber, never close their eyelids, faithful, far-ruling for the righteous mortal.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा ये च देवा असुर ये च मर्ताः ।
शतं नो रास्व शरदो विचक्षे ऽश्यामायूंषि सुधितानि पूर्वा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā ye ca devā asura ye ca martāḥ śataṃ no rāsva śarado vicakṣe 'śyāmāyūṃṣi sudhitāni pūrvā
verses.en: Thou over all, O Varuna, art Sovran, be they Gods, Asura! or be they mortals. Grant unto us to see a hundred autumns ours be the blest long lives of our forefathers.

verses.sa:
न दक्षिणा वि चिकिते न सव्या न प्राचीनमादित्या नोत पश्चा ।
पाक्या चिद् वसवो धीर्या चिद् युष्मानीतो अभयं ज्योतिरश्याम्॥
verses.tr: na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnamādityā nota paścā pākyā cid vasavo dhīryā cid yuṣmānīto abhayaṃ jyotiraśyām
verses.en: Neither the right nor left do I distinguish, neither the east nor yet the west, Adityas. Simple and guided by your wisdom, Vasus! may I attain the light that brings no danger.

verses.sa:
यो राजभ्य ऋतनिभ्यो ददाश यं वर्धयन्ति पुष्टयश्च नित्याः ।
स रेवान् याति प्रथमो रथेन वसुदावा विदथेषु प्रशस्तः॥
verses.tr: yo rājabhya ṛtanibhyo dadāśa yaṃ vardhayanti puṣṭayaśca nityāḥ sa revān yāti prathamo rathena vasudāvā vidatheṣu praśastaḥ
verses.en: He who bears gifts unto the Kings, true Leaders, he whom their everlasting blessings prosper, Moves with his chariot first in rank and wealthy, munificent and lauded in assemblies.

verses.sa:
शुचिरपः सूयवसा अदब्ध उप क्षेति वृद्धवयाः सुवीरः ।
नकिष्टं घ्नन्त्यन्तितो न दूराद् य आदित्यानां भवति प्रणीतौ॥
verses.tr: śucirapaḥ sūyavasā adabdha upa kṣeti vṛddhavayāḥ suvīraḥ nakiṣṭaṃ ghnantyantito na dūrād ya ādityānāṃ bhavati praṇītau
verses.en: Pure, faithful, very strong, with heroes round him, he dwells beside the waters rich with pasture. None slays, from near at hand or from a distance, him who is under the Adityas' guidance.

verses.sa:
अदिते मित्र वरुणोत मृळ यद्वो वयं चकृमा कच्चिदागः ।
उर्वश्यामभयं ज्योतिरिन्द्र मा नो दीर्घा अभि नशन्तमिस्राः॥
verses.tr: adite mitra varuṇota mṛḻa yadvo vayaṃ cakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ urvaśyāmabhayaṃ jyotirindra mā no dīrghā abhi naśantamisrāḥ
verses.en: Aditi, Mitra, Varuna, forgive us however we have erred and sinned against you. May I obtain the broad light free from peril: O Indra, let not during darkness seize us.

verses.sa:
उभे अस्मै पीपयतः समीची दिवो वृष्टिं सुभगो नाम पुष्यन् ।
उभा क्षयावाजयन् याति पृत्सूभावर्धौ भवतः साधू अस्मै॥
verses.tr: ubhe asmai pīpayataḥ samīcī divo vṛṣṭiṃ subhago nāma puṣyan ubhā kṣayāvājayan yāti pṛtsūbhāvardhau bhavataḥ sādhū asmai
verses.en: For him the Twain united pour their fulness, the rain from heaven: he thrives most highly favoured. He goes to war mastering both the mansions: to him both portions of the world are gracious.

verses.sa:
या वो माया अभिद्रुहे यजत्राः पाशा आदित्या रिपवे विचृत्ताः ।
अश्वीव ताँ अति येषं रथेनारिष्टा उरावा शर्मन्त्स्याम॥
verses.tr: yā vo māyā abhidruhe yajatrāḥ pāśā ādityā ripave vicṛttāḥ aśvīva tāṃ ati yeṣaṃ rathenāriṣṭā urāvā śarmantsyāma
verses.en: Your guiles, ye Holy Ones, to quell oppressors, your snares spread out against the foe, Adityas, May I car-borne pass like a skillful horseman: uninjured may we dwell in spacious shelter.

verses.sa:
माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः ।
मा रायो राजन्त् त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ mā rāyo rājant tsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May not live, O Varuna, to witness my wealthy, liberal, dear friend's destitution. King, may never lack well-ordered riches. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
इदं कवेरादित्यस्य स्वराजो विश्वानि सान्त्यभ्यस्तु मह्ना ।
अति यो मन्द्रो यजथाय देवः सुकीर्तिं भिक्षे वरुणस्य भूरेः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ kaverādityasya svarājo viśvāni sāntyabhyastu mahnā ati yo mandro yajathāya devaḥ sukīrtiṃ bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ
verses.en: This laud of the self-radiant wise Aditya shall be supreme o'er all that is in greatness. Beg renown of Varuna the Mighty, the God exceeding kind to him who worships.

verses.sa:
तव व्रते सुभगासः स्याम स्वाध्यो वरुण तुष्टुवांसः ।
उपायन उषसां गोमतीनामग्नयो न जरमाणा अनु द्यून्॥
verses.tr: tava vrate subhagāsaḥ syāma svādhyo varuṇa tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ upāyana uṣasāṃ gomatīnāmagnayo na jaramāṇā anu dyūn
verses.en: Having extolled thee. Varuna, with thoughtful care may we have high fortune in thy service, Sniffing thy praises like the fires at coming, day after day, of mornings rich in cattle.

verses.sa:
तव स्याम पुरुवीरस्य शर्मन्नुरुशंसस्य वरुण प्रणेतः ।
यूयं नः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धा अभि क्षमध्वं युज्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: tava syāma puruvīrasya śarmannuruśaṃsasya varuṇa praṇetaḥ yūyaṃ naḥ putrā aditeradabdhā abhi kṣamadhvaṃ yujyāya devāḥ
verses.en: May we be in thy keeping, O thou Leader wide-ruling Varuna, Lord of many heroes. O sons of Aditi, for ever faithful, pardon us, Gods, admit us to your friendship.

verses.sa:
प्र सीमादित्यो असृजद्विधर्ताँ ऋतं सिन्धवो वरुणस्य यन्ति ।
न श्राम्यन्ति न वि मुचन्त्येते वयो न पप्तू रघुया परिज्मन्॥
verses.tr: pra sīmādityo asṛjadvidhartāṃ ṛtaṃ sindhavo varuṇasya yanti na śrāmyanti na vi mucantyete vayo na paptū raghuyā parijman
verses.en: He made them flow, the Aditya, the Sustainer: the rivers run by Varuna's commandment. These feel no weariness, nor cease from flowing: swift have they flown like birds in air around us.

verses.sa:
वि मच्छ्रथाय रशनामिवाग ऋध्याम ते वरुण खामृतस्य ।
मा तन्तुश्छेदि वयतो धियं मे मा मात्रा शार्यपसः पुर ऋतोः॥
verses.tr: vi macchrathāya raśanāmivāga ṛdhyāma te varuṇa khāmṛtasya mā tantuśchedi vayato dhiyaṃ me mā mātrā śāryapasaḥ pura ṛtoḥ
verses.en: Loose me from sin as from a bond that binds me: may we swell, Varuna, thy spring of Order. Let not my thread, while I weave song, be severed, nor my work's sum, before the time, be shattered.

verses.sa:
अपो सु म्यक्ष वरुण भियसं मत्सम्राळृतावोऽनु मा गृभाय ।
दामेव वत्साद् वि मुमुग्ध्यंहो नहि त्वदारे निमिषश्चनेशे॥
verses.tr: apo su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasaṃ matsamrāḻṛtāvo'nu mā gṛbhāya dāmeva vatsād vi mumugdhyaṃho nahi tvadāre nimiṣaścaneśe
verses.en: Far from me, Varuna, remove all danger accept me graciously, thou Holy Sovran. Cast off, like cords that hold a calf, my troubles: I am not even mine eyelid's lord without thee.

verses.sa:
मा नो वधैर्वरुण ये त इष्टावेनः कृण्वन्तमसुर भ्रीणन्ति ।
मा ज्योतिषः प्रवसथानि गन्म वि षू मृधः शिश्रथो जीवसे नः॥
verses.tr: mā no vadhairvaruṇa ye ta iṣṭāvenaḥ kṛṇvantamasura bhrīṇanti mā jyotiṣaḥ pravasathāni ganma vi ṣū mṛdhaḥ śiśratho jīvase naḥ
verses.en: Strike us not, Varuna, with those dread weapons which, Asura, at thy bidding wound the sinner. Let us not pass away from light to exile. Scatter, that we may live, the men who hate us

verses.sa:
नमः पुरा ते वरुणोत नूनमुतापरं तुविजात ब्रवाम ।
त्वे हि कं पर्वते न श्रितान्यप्रच्युतानि दूळभ व्रतानि॥
verses.tr: namaḥ purā te varuṇota nūnamutāparaṃ tuvijāta bravāma tve hi kaṃ parvate na śritānyapracyutāni dūḻabha vratāni
verses.en: O mighty Varuna, now and hereafter, even as of old, will we speak forth our worship. For in thyself, invincible God, thy statutes never to be moved are fixed as on a mountain.

verses.sa:
पर ऋणा सावीरध मत्कृतानि माहं राजन्नन्यकृतेन भोजम् ।
अव्युष्टा इन्नु भूयसीरुषास आ नो जीवान् वरुण तासु शाधि॥
verses.tr: para ṛṇā sāvīradha matkṛtāni māhaṃ rājannanyakṛtena bhojam avyuṣṭā innu bhūyasīruṣāsa ā no jīvān varuṇa tāsu śādhi
verses.en: Move far from me what sins I have committed: let me not suffer, King, for guilt of others. Full many a morn remains to dawn upon us: in these, O Varuna, while we live direct us.

verses.sa:
यो मे राजन् युज्यो वा सखा वा स्वप्ने भयं भीरवे मह्यमाह ।
स्तेनो वा यो दिप्सति नो वृको वा त्वं तस्माद् वरुण पाह्यस्मान्॥
verses.tr: yo me rājan yujyo vā sakhā vā svapne bhayaṃ bhīrave mahyamāha steno vā yo dipsati no vṛko vā tvaṃ tasmād varuṇa pāhyasmān
verses.en: O King, whoever, be he friend or kinsman, hath threatened me affrighted in my slumber- If any wolf or robber fain would harm us, therefrom, O Varuna, give thou us protection.

verses.sa:
माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः ।
मा रायो राजन् त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ mā rāyo rājan tsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May I not live O Varuna, to witness my wealthy, liberal dear friend's destitution. King, may I never lack well-ordered riches. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
धृतव्रता आदित्या इषिरा आरे मत् कर्त रहसूरिवागः ।
शृण्वतो वो वरुण मित्र देवा भद्रस्य विद्वाँ अवसे हुवे वः॥
verses.tr: dhṛtavratā ādityā iṣirā āre mat karta rahasūrivāgaḥ śṛṇvato vo varuṇa mitra devā bhadrasya vidvāṃ avase huve vaḥ
verses.en: Upholders of the Law, ye strong Adityas, remove my sin like her who bears in secret. You, Varuna, Mitra and all Gods who listen, I call to help me, I who know your goodness.

verses.sa:
यूयं देवाः प्रमतिर्यूयमोजो यूयं द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत ।
अभिक्षत्तारो अभि च क्षमध्वमद्या च नो मृळयतापरं च॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ devāḥ pramatiryūyamojo yūyaṃ dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota abhikṣattāro abhi ca kṣamadhvamadyā ca no mṛḻayatāparaṃ ca
verses.en: Ye, Gods, are providence and ye are power: remove ye utterly all those who hate us. As givers of good things deal with us kindly: this day be gracious to us and hereafter.

verses.sa:
किमू नु वः कृणवामापरेण किं सनेन वसव आप्येन ।
यूयं नो मित्रावरुणादिते च स्वस्तिमिन्द्रामरुतो दधात॥
verses.tr: kimū nu vaḥ kṛṇavāmāpareṇa kiṃ sanena vasava āpyena yūyaṃ no mitrāvaruṇādite ca svastimindrāmaruto dadhāta
verses.en: What service may we do you with our future, what service, Vasus, with our ancient friendship? O Aditi, and VaruVa and Mitra, Indra and Maruts, make us well and happy.

verses.sa:
हये देवा यूयमिदापयः स्थ ते मृळत नाधमानाय मह्यम् ।
मा वो रथो मध्यमवाळृते भून्मा युष्मावत्स्वापिषु श्रमिष्म॥
verses.tr: haye devā yūyamidāpayaḥ stha te mṛḻata nādhamānāya mahyam mā vo ratho madhyamavāḻṛte bhūnmā yuṣmāvatsvāpiṣu śramiṣma
verses.en: Ye, O ye Gods, are verily our kinsmen as such be kind to me who now implore you. Let not your car come slowly to our worship: of kinsmen such as you ne'er let us weary.

verses.sa:
प्र व एको मिमय भूर्यागो यन्मा पितेव कितवं शशास ।
आरे पाशा आरे अघानि देवा मा माधि पुत्रे विमिव ग्रभीष्ट॥
verses.tr: pra va eko mimaya bhūryāgo yanmā piteva kitavaṃ śaśāsa āre pāśā āre aghāni devā mā mādhi putre vimiva grabhīṣṭa
verses.en: I singly have sinned many a sin against you, and ye chastised me as a sire the gambler. Far be your nets, far, Gods, be mine offences: seize me not like a bird upon her offspring.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चो अद्या भवता यजत्रा आ वो हार्दि भयमानो व्ययेयम् ।
त्राध्वं नो देवा निजुरो वृकस्य त्राध्वं कर्तादवपदो यजत्राः॥
verses.tr: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ
verses.en: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, God; let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.

verses.sa:
माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः ।
मा रायो राजन् त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ mā rāyo rājan tsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May I not live, O Varuna, to witness my wealthy, liberal, dear friend's destitution. King, may I never lack well-ordered riches. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
ऋतं देवाय कृण्वते सवित्र इन्द्रायाहिघ्ने न रमन्त आपः ।
अहरहर्यात्यक्तुरपां कियात्या प्रथमः सर्ग आसाम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitra indrāyāhighne na ramanta āpaḥ aharaharyātyakturapāṃ kiyātyā prathamaḥ sarga āsām
verses.en: The streams unceasing flow to Indra, slayer of Ahi, Savitar, God, Law's fulfiller, Day after day goes on the sheen of waters. What time hath past since they were first set flowing?

verses.sa:
यो वृत्राय सिनमत्राभरिष्यत् प्र तं जनित्री विदुष उवाच ।
पथो रदन्तीरनु जोषमस्मै दिवेदिवे धुनयो यन्त्यर्थम्॥
verses.tr: yo vṛtrāya sinamatrābhariṣyat pra taṃ janitrī viduṣa uvāca patho radantīranu joṣamasmai divedive dhunayo yantyartham
verses.en: His Mother-for she knew-spake and proclaimed him who was about to cast his bolt at Vrtra. Cutting their paths according to his pleasure day after day flow to their goal the rivers.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो ह्यस्थादध्यन्तरिक्षे ऽधा वृत्राय प्र वधं जभार ।
मिहं वसान उप हीमदुद्रोत् तिग्मायुधो अजयच्छत्रुमिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo hyasthādadhyantarikṣe 'dhā vṛtrāya pra vadhaṃ jabhāra mihaṃ vasāna upa hīmadudrot tigmāyudho ajayacchatrumindraḥ
verses.en: Aloft he stood above the airy region, and against Vrtra shot his deadly missile. Enveloped in a cloud he rushed upon him. Indra subdued the foe with sharpened weapons.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते तपुषाश्नेव विध्य वृकद्वरसो असुरस्य वीरान् ।
यथा जघन्थ धृषता पुरा चिदेवा जहि शत्रुमस्माकमिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate tapuṣāśneva vidhya vṛkadvaraso asurasya vīrān yathā jaghantha dhṛṣatā purā cidevā jahi śatrumasmākamindra
verses.en: As with a bolt, Brhaspati, fiercely flaming, pierce thou Vrkadvaras', the Asura's, heroes. Even as in time of old with might thou slewest, so slay even now our enemy, O Indra.

verses.sa:
अव क्षिप दिवो अश्मानमुच्चा येन शत्रुं मन्दसानो निजूर्वाः ।
तोकस्य सातौ तनयस्य भूरेरस्माँ अर्धं कृणुतादिन्द्र गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: ava kṣipa divo aśmānamuccā yena śatruṃ mandasāno nijūrvāḥ tokasya sātau tanayasya bhūrerasmāṃ ardhaṃ kṛṇutādindra gonām
verses.en: Cast down from heaven on high thy bolt of thunder wherewith in joy thou smitest dead the foeman. For gain of children make us thine, O Indra, of many children's children and of cattle.

verses.sa:
प्र हि क्रतुं वृहथो यं वनुथो रध्रस्य स्थो यजमानस्य चोदौ ।
इन्द्रासोमा युवमस्माँ अविष्टमस्मिन् भयस्थे कृणुतमु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: pra hi kratuṃ vṛhatho yaṃ vanutho radhrasya stho yajamānasya codau indrāsomā yuvamasmāṃ aviṣṭamasmin bhayasthe kṛṇutamu lokam
verses.en: Whomso ye love, his power ye aid and strengthen; ye Twain are the rich worshipper's advancers. Graciously favour us, Indra and Soma; give us firm standing in this time of danger.

verses.sa:
न मा तमन्न श्रमन्नोत तन्द्रन्न वोचाम मा सुनोतेति सोमम् ।
यो मे पृणाद् यो ददद्यो निबोधाद् यो मा सुन्वन्तमुप गोभिरायत्॥
verses.tr: na mā tamanna śramannota tandranna vocāma mā sunoteti somam yo me pṛṇād yo dadadyo nibodhād yo mā sunvantamupa gobhirāyat
verses.en: Let it not vex me, tire me, make me slothful, and never let us say, Press not the Soma; For him who cares for me, gives gifts, supports me, who comes with kine to me who pour libations.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति त्वमस्माँ अविड्ढि मरुत्वती धृषती जेषि शत्रून् ।
त्यं चिच्छर्धन्तं तविषीयमाणमिन्द्रो हन्ति वृषभं शण्डिकानाम्॥
verses.tr: sarasvati tvamasmāṃ aviḍḍhi marutvatī dhṛṣatī jeṣi śatrūn tyaṃ cicchardhantaṃ taviṣīyamāṇamindro hanti vṛṣabhaṃ śaṇḍikānām
verses.en: Sarasvati, protect us: with the Maruts allied thou boldly conquerest our foemen, While Indra does to death the daring chieftain of Sandikas exulting in his prowess.

verses.sa:
यो नः सनुत्य उत वा जिघत्नुरभिख्याय तं तिगितेन विध्य ।
बृहस्पत आयुधैर्जेषि शत्रून् द्रुहे रीषन्तं परि धेहि राजन्॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnurabhikhyāya taṃ tigitena vidhya bṛhaspata āyudhairjeṣi śatrūn druhe rīṣantaṃ pari dhehi rājan
verses.en: Him who waylays, yea, him who would destroy us,-aim at him, pierce him with thy sharpened weapon. Brhaspati, with arms thou slayest foemen O King, give up the spoiler to destruction.

verses.sa:
अस्माकेभिः सत्वभिः शूर शूरैर्वीर्या कृधि यानि ते कर्त्वानि ।
ज्योगभूवन्ननुधूपितासो हत्वी तेषामा भरा नो वसूनि॥
verses.tr: asmākebhiḥ satvabhiḥ śūra śūrairvīryā kṛdhi yāni te kartvāni jyogabhūvannanudhūpitāso hatvī teṣāmā bharā no vasūni
verses.en: Perform, O Hero, with our valiant heroes the deeds heroic which thou hast to finish. Long have they been inflated with presumption: slay them, and bring us hither their possessions.

verses.sa:
तं वः शर्धं मारुतं सुम्नयुर्गिरोप ब्रुवे नमसा दैव्यं जनम् ।
यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं नशामहा अपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ mārutaṃ sumnayurgiropa bruve namasā daivyaṃ janam yathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ naśāmahā apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ divedive
verses.en: I craving joy address with hymn and homage your heavenly host, the company of Maruts, That we may gain wealth with full store of heroes, each day more famous, and with troops of children.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं मित्रावरुणावतं रथमादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा ।
प्र यद् वयो न पप्तन्वस्मनस्परि श्रवस्यवो हृषीवन्तो वनर्षदः॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvataṃ rathamādityai rudrairvasubhiḥ sacābhuvā pra yad vayo na paptanvasmanaspari śravasyavo hṛṣīvanto vanarṣadaḥ
verses.en: Help, Varuna and Mitra, O ye Twain allied with Vasus, Rudras, and Adityas, help our car, That, as the wild birds of the forest from their home, our horses may fly forth, glad, eager for renown.

verses.sa:
अध स्मा न उदवता सजोषसो रथं देवासो अभि विक्षु वाजयुम् ।
यदाशवः पद्याभिस्तित्रतो रजः पृथिव्याः सानौ जङ्घनन्त पाणिभिः॥
verses.tr: adha smā na udavatā sajoṣaso rathaṃ devāso abhi vikṣu vājayum yadāśavaḥ padyābhistitrato rajaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sānau jaṅghananta pāṇibhiḥ
verses.en: Yea, now ye Gods of one accord speed on our car what time among the folk it seeks an act of might; When, hasting through the region with the stamp of hoofs, our swift steeds trample on the ridges of the earth.

verses.sa:
उत स्य न इन्द्रो विश्वचर्षणिर्दिवः शर्धेन मारुतेन सुक्रतुः ।
अनु नु स्थात्यवृकाभिरूतिभी रथं महे सनये वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: uta sya na indro viśvacarṣaṇirdivaḥ śardhena mārutena sukratuḥ anu nu sthātyavṛkābhirūtibhī rathaṃ mahe sanaye vājasātaye
verses.en: Or may our Indra here, the Friend of all mankind, coming from heaven, most wise, girt by the Marut host, Accompany, with aid untroubled by a foe, our car to mighty gain, to win the meed of strength.

verses.sa:
उत स्य देवो भुवनस्य सक्षणिस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिः सजोषा जूजुवद् रथम् ।
इळा भगो बृहद्दिवोत रोदसी पूषा पुरंधिरश्विनावधा पती॥
verses.tr: uta sya devo bhuvanasya sakṣaṇistvaṣṭā gnābhiḥ sajoṣā jūjuvad ratham iḻā bhago bṛhaddivota rodasī pūṣā puraṃdhiraśvināvadhā patī
verses.en: Or may this Tvastar, God who rules the world with power, one-minded with the Goddesses speed forth our car; Ila and Bhaga the celestial, Earth and Heaven, Pusan, Purandhi, and the Asvins, ruling Lords.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये देवी सुभगे मिथूदृशोषासानक्ता जगतामपीजुवा ।
स्तुषे यद् वां पृथिवि नव्यसा वचः स्थातुश्च वयस्त्रिवया उपस्तिरे॥
verses.tr: uta tye devī subhage mithūdṛśoṣāsānaktā jagatāmapījuvā stuṣe yad vāṃ pṛthivi navyasā vacaḥ sthātuśca vayastrivayā upastire
verses.en: Or, seen alternate, those two blessed Goddesses, Morning and Night who stir all living things to act: While with my newest song I praise you both, O Earth, that from what moves not ye may spread forth threefold food.

verses.sa:
उत वः शंसमुशिजामिव श्मस्यहिर्बुध्न्यो३ऽज एकपादुत ।
त्रित ऋभुक्षाः सविता चनो दधेऽपां नपादाशुहेमा धिया शमि॥
verses.tr: uta vaḥ śaṃsamuśijāmiva śmasyahirbudhnyo3'ja ekapāduta trita ṛbhukṣāḥ savitā cano dadhe'pāṃ napādāśuhemā dhiyā śami
verses.en: Your blessing as a boon for suppliants we desire: the Dragon of the Deep, and Aja-Ekapad, Trita, Rbhuksan, Savitar shall joy in us, and the Floods' swift Child in our worship and our prayer.

verses.sa:
एता वो वश्म्युद्यता यजत्रा अतक्षन्नायवो नव्यसे सम् ।
श्रवस्यवो वाजं चकानाः सप्तिर्न रथ्यो अह धीतिमश्याः॥
verses.tr: etā vo vaśmyudyatā yajatrā atakṣannāyavo navyase sam śravasyavo vājaṃ cakānāḥ saptirna rathyo aha dhītimaśyāḥ
verses.en: These earnest prayers I pray to you, ye Holy: to pay you honour, living men have formed them, Men fain to win the prize and glory. May they win, as a car-horse might the goal, your notice.

verses.sa:
अस्य मे द्यावापृथिवी ऋतायतो भूतमवित्री वचसः सिषासतः ।
ययोरायुः प्रतरं ते इदं पुर उपस्तुते वसूयुर्वां महो दधे॥
verses.tr: asya me dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāyato bhūtamavitrī vacasaḥ siṣāsataḥ yayorāyuḥ prataraṃ te idaṃ pura upastute vasūyurvāṃ maho dadhe
verses.en: Graciously further, O ye Heaven and Earth, this speech striving to win reward, of me your worshipper. First rank I give to you, Immortal, high extolled! I, fain to win me wealth, to you the migbty Pair.

verses.sa:
मा नो गुह्या रिप आयोरहन् दभन् मा न आभ्यो रीरधो दुच्छुनाभ्यः ।
मा नो वि यौः सख्या विद्धि तस्य नः सुम्नायता मनसा तत् त्वेमहे॥
verses.tr: mā no guhyā ripa āyorahan dabhan mā na ābhyo rīradho ducchunābhyaḥ mā no vi yauḥ sakhyā viddhi tasya naḥ sumnāyatā manasā tat tvemahe
verses.en: Let not man's guile annoy us, secret or by day: give not us up a prey to these calamities. Sever not thou our friendship: think thereon for us. This, with a heart that longs for bliss, we seek from thee.

verses.sa:
अहेळता मनसा श्रुष्टिमा वह दुहानां धेनुं पिप्युषीमसश्चतम् ।
पद्याभिराशुं वचसा च वाजिनं त्वां हिनोमि पुरुहूत विश्वहा॥
verses.tr: aheḻatā manasā śruṣṭimā vaha duhānāṃ dhenuṃ pipyuṣīmasaścatam padyābhirāśuṃ vacasā ca vājinaṃ tvāṃ hinomi puruhūta viśvahā
verses.en: Bring hither with benignant mind the willing Cow teeming with plenteous milk, full, inexhaustible. O thou invoked by many, day by day I urge thee with my word, a charger rapid in his tread.

verses.sa:
राकामहं सुहवां सुष्टुती हुवे शृणोतु नः सुभगा बोधतु त्मना ।
सीव्यत्वपः सूच्याच्छिद्यमानया ददातु वीरं शतदायमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: rākāmahaṃ suhavāṃ suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā sīvyatvapaḥ sūcyācchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthyam
verses.en: With eulogy I call on Raka swift to hear may she, auspicious, hear us, and herself observe. With never-breaking needle may she sew her work, and give a hero son most wealthy, meet for praise.

verses.sa:
यास्ते राके सुमतयः सुपेशसो याभिर्ददासि दाशुषे वसूनि ।
ताभिर्नो अद्य सुमना उपागहि सहस्रपोषं सुभगे रराणा॥
verses.tr: yāste rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni tābhirno adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā
verses.en: All thy kind thoughts, O Raka, lovely in their form, wherewith thou grantest wealth to him who offers gifts- With these come thou to us this day benevolent, O Blessed One, bestowing food of thousand sorts.

verses.sa:
सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके या देवानामसि स्वसा ।
जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः॥
verses.tr: sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
verses.en: O broad-tressed Sinivali, thou who art the Sister of the Gods, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.

verses.sa:
या सुबाहुः स्वङ्गुरिः सुषूमा बहुसूवरी ।
तस्यै विश्पत्न्यै हविः सिनीवाल्यै जुहोतन॥
verses.tr: yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana
verses.en: With lovely fingers, lovely arms, prolific Mother of many sons- Present the sacred gifts to her, to Sinivali Queen of men.

verses.sa:
या गुङ्गूर्या सिनीवाली या राका या सरस्वती ।
इन्द्राणीमह्व ऊतये वरुणानीं स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: yā guṅgūryā sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī indrāṇīmahva ūtaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye
verses.en: Her, Sinivali, her, Gungu, her, Raka, her, Sarasvati, Indrani to mine aid I call, and Varunani for my weal.

verses.sa:
आ ते पितर्मरुतां सुम्नमेतु मा नः सूर्यस्य संदृशो युयोथाः ।
अभि नो वीरो अर्वति क्षमेत प्र जायेमहि रुद्र प्रजाभिः॥
verses.tr: ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu mā naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśo yuyothāḥ abhi no vīro arvati kṣameta pra jāyemahi rudra prajābhiḥ
verses.en: Father of Maruts, let thy bliss approach us: exclude us not from looking on the sunlight. Gracious to our fleet courser be the Hero may we transplant us, Rudra, in our children.

verses.sa:
त्वादत्तेभी रुद्र शंतमेभिः शतं हिमा अशीय भेषजेभिः ।
व्य१स्मद्द्वेषो वितरं व्यंहो व्यमीवाश्चातयस्वा विषूचीः॥
verses.tr: tvādattebhī rudra śaṃtamebhiḥ śataṃ himā aśīya bheṣajebhiḥ vya1smaddveṣo vitaraṃ vyaṃho vyamīvāścātayasvā viṣūcīḥ
verses.en: With the most saving medicines which thou givest, Rudra, may I attain a hundred winters. Far from us banish enmity and hatred, and to all quarters maladies and trouble.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठो जातस्य रुद्र श्रियासि तवस्तमस्तवसां वज्रबाहो ।
पर्षि णः पारमंहसः स्वस्ति विश्वा अभीती रपसो युयोधि॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭho jātasya rudra śriyāsi tavastamastavasāṃ vajrabāho parṣi ṇaḥ pāramaṃhasaḥ svasti viśvā abhītī rapaso yuyodhi
verses.en: Chief of all born art thou in glory, Rudra, armed with the thunder, mightiest of the mighty. Transport us over trouble to well-being repel thou from us all assaults of mischief.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा रुद्र चुक्रुधामा नमोभिर्मा दुष्टुती वृषभ मा सहूती ।
उन्नो वीराँ अर्पय भेषजेभिर्भिषक्तमं त्वा भिषजां शृणोमि॥
verses.tr: mā tvā rudra cukrudhāmā namobhirmā duṣṭutī vṛṣabha mā sahūtī unno vīrāṃ arpaya bheṣajebhirbhiṣaktamaṃ tvā bhiṣajāṃ śṛṇomi
verses.en: Let us not anger thee with worship, Rudra, ill praise, Strong God! or mingled invocation. Do thou with strengthening balms incite our heroes: I hear thee famed as best of all physicians.

verses.sa:
हवीमभिर्हवते यो हविर्भिरव स्तोमेभी रुद्रं दिषीय ।
ऋदूदरः सुहवो मा नो अस्यै बभ्रुः सुशिप्रो रीरधन्मनायै॥
verses.tr: havīmabhirhavate yo havirbhirava stomebhī rudraṃ diṣīya ṛdūdaraḥ suhavo mā no asyai babhruḥ suśipro rīradhanmanāyai
verses.en: May I with praise-songs win that Rudra's favour who is adored with gifts and invocations. Ne'er may the tawny God, fair-checked, and gracious, swift hearing, yield us to this evil purpose.

verses.sa:
उन्मा ममन्द वृषभो मरुत्वान् त्वक्षीयसा वयसा नाधमानम् ।
घृणीव च्छायामरपा अशीयाऽऽ विवासेयं रुद्रस्य सुम्नम्॥
verses.tr: unmā mamanda vṛṣabho marutvān tvakṣīyasā vayasā nādhamānam ghṛṇīva cchāyāmarapā aśīyā'' vivāseyaṃ rudrasya sumnam
verses.en: The Strong, begirt by Maruts, hath refreshed me, with most invigorating food, imploring. As he who finds a shade in fervent sunlight may I, uninjured, win the bliss of Rudra.

verses.sa:
क्व१ स्य ते रुद्र मृळयाकुर्हस्तो यो अस्ति भेषजो जलाषः ।
अपभर्ता रपसो दैव्यस्याभी नु मा वृषभ चक्षमीथाः॥
verses.tr: kva1 sya te rudra mṛḻayākurhasto yo asti bheṣajo jalāṣaḥ apabhartā rapaso daivyasyābhī nu mā vṛṣabha cakṣamīthāḥ
verses.en: Where is that gracious hand of thine, O Rudra, the hand that giveth health and bringeth comfort, Remover of the woe that Gods have sent us? O Strong One, look thou on me with compassion.

verses.sa:
प्र बभ्रवे वृषभाय श्वितीचे महो महीं सुष्टुतिमीरयामि ।
नमस्या कल्मलीकिनं नमोभिर्गृणीमसि त्वेषं रुद्रस्य नाम॥
verses.tr: pra babhrave vṛṣabhāya śvitīce maho mahīṃ suṣṭutimīrayāmi namasyā kalmalīkinaṃ namobhirgṛṇīmasi tveṣaṃ rudrasya nāma
verses.en: To him the strong, great, tawny, fair-complexioned, I utter forth a mighty hymn of praises. We serve the brilliant God with adorations, we glorify, the splendid name of Rudra.

verses.sa:
स्थिरेभिरङ्गैः पुरुरूप उग्रो बभ्रुः शुक्रेभिः पिपिशे हिरण्यैः ।
ईशानादस्य भुवनस्य भूरेर्न वा उ योषद् रुद्रादसुर्यम्॥
verses.tr: sthirebhiraṅgaiḥ pururūpa ugro babhruḥ śukrebhiḥ pipiśe hiraṇyaiḥ īśānādasya bhuvanasya bhūrerna vā u yoṣad rudrādasuryam
verses.en: With firm limbs, multiform, the strong, the tawny adorns himself with bright gold decorations: The strength of Godhead ne'er departs from Rudra, him who is Sovran of this world, the mighty.

verses.sa:
अर्हन् बिभर्षि सायकानि धन्वार्हन् निष्कं यजतं विश्वरूपम् ।
अर्हन्निदं दयसे विश्वमभ्वं न वा ओजीयो रुद्र त्वदस्ति॥
verses.tr: arhan bibharṣi sāyakāni dhanvārhan niṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam arhannidaṃ dayase viśvamabhvaṃ na vā ojīyo rudra tvadasti
verses.en: Worthy, thou carriest thy bow and arrows, worthy, thy manyhued and honoured necklace. Worthy, thou cuttest here each fiend to pieces: a mightier than thou there is not, Rudra.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि श्रुतं गर्तसदं युवानं मृगं न भीममुपहत्नुमुग्रम् ।
मृळा जरित्रे रुद्र स्तवानो ऽन्यं ते अस्मन्नि वपन्तु सेनाः॥
verses.tr: stuhi śrutaṃ gartasadaṃ yuvānaṃ mṛgaṃ na bhīmamupahatnumugram mṛḻā jaritre rudra stavāno 'nyaṃ te asmanni vapantu senāḥ
verses.en: Praise him the chariot-borne, the young, the famous, fierce, slaying like a dread beast of the forest. O Rudra, praised, be gracious to the singer. let thy hosts spare us and smite down another.

verses.sa:
कुमारश्चित् पितरं वन्दमानं प्रति नानाम रुद्रोपयन्तम् ।
भूरेर्दातारं सत्पतिं गृणीषे स्तुतस्त्वं भेषजा रास्यस्मे॥
verses.tr: kumāraścit pitaraṃ vandamānaṃ prati nānāma rudropayantam bhūrerdātāraṃ satpatiṃ gṛṇīṣe stutastvaṃ bheṣajā rāsyasme
verses.en: I bend to thee as thou approachest, Rudra, even as a boy before the sire who greets him. I praise thee Bounteous Giver, Lord of heroes: give medicines to us as thou art lauded.

verses.sa:
या वो भेषजा मरुतः शुचीनि या शंतमा वृषणो या मयोभु ।
यानि मनुरवृणीता पिता नस्ता शं च योश्च रुद्रस्य वश्मि॥
verses.tr: yā vo bheṣajā marutaḥ śucīni yā śaṃtamā vṛṣaṇo yā mayobhu yāni manuravṛṇītā pitā nastā śaṃ ca yośca rudrasya vaśmi
verses.en: Of your pure medicines, O potent Martits, those that are wholesomest and health bestowing, Those which our father Manu hath selected, I crave from. Rudra for our gain and welfare.

verses.sa:
परि णो हेती रुद्रस्य वृज्याः परि त्वेषस्य दुर्मतिर्मही गात् ।
अव स्थिरा मघवद्भ्यस्तनुष्व मीढ्वस्तोकाय तनयाय मृळ॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ pari tveṣasya durmatirmahī gāt ava sthirā maghavadbhyastanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḻa
verses.en: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring.

verses.sa:
एवा बभ्रो वृषभ चेकितान यथा देव न हृणीषे न हंसि ।
हवनश्रुन्नो रुद्रेह बोधि बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: evā babhro vṛṣabha cekitāna yathā deva na hṛṇīṣe na haṃsi havanaśrunno rudreha bodhi bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: O tawny Bull, thus showing forth thy nature, as neither to be wroth, O God, nor slay us. Here, Rudra, listen to our invocation. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
धारावरा मरुतो धृष्ण्वोजसो मृगा न भीमास्तविषीभिरर्चिनः ।
अग्नयो न शुशुचाना ऋजीषिणो भृमिं धमन्तो अप गा अवृण्वत॥
verses.tr: dhārāvarā maruto dhṛṣṇvojaso mṛgā na bhīmāstaviṣībhirarcinaḥ agnayo na śuśucānā ṛjīṣiṇo bhṛmiṃ dhamanto apa gā avṛṇvata
verses.en: The Maruts of resistless might who love the rain, resplendent, terrible like wild beasts in their strength, Glowing like flames of fire, impetuous in career, blowing the wandering raincloud, have disclosed the kine.

verses.sa:
द्यावो न स्तृभिश्चितयन्त खादिनो व्य१भ्रिया न द्युतयन्त वृष्टयः ।
रुद्रो यद् वो मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसो वृषाजनि पृश्न्याः शुक्र ऊधनि॥
verses.tr: dyāvo na stṛbhiścitayanta khādino vya1bhriyā na dyutayanta vṛṣṭayaḥ rudro yad vo maruto rukmavakṣaso vṛṣājani pṛśnyāḥ śukra ūdhani
verses.en: They gleam with armlets as the heavens are decked with stars, like cloud-born lightnings shine the torrents of their rain. Since the strong Rudra, O Maruts with brilliant chests, sprang into life for you in Prsni's radiant lap.

verses.sa:
उक्षन्ते अश्वाँ अत्याँ इवाजिषु नदस्य कर्णैस्तुरयन्त आशुभिः ।
हिरण्यशिप्रा मरुतो दविध्वतः पृक्षं याथ पृषतीभिः समन्यवः॥
verses.tr: ukṣante aśvāṃ atyāṃ ivājiṣu nadasya karṇaisturayanta āśubhiḥ hiraṇyaśiprā maruto davidhvataḥ pṛkṣaṃ yātha pṛṣatībhiḥ samanyavaḥ
verses.en: They drip like horses in the racings of swift steeds; with the stream's rapid cars they hasten on their way. Maruts with helms of gold, ye who make all things shake, come with your spotted deer, one-minded, to our food.

verses.sa:
पृक्षे ता विश्वा भुवना ववक्षिरे मित्राय वा सदमा जीरदानवः ।
पृषदश्वासो अनवभ्रराधस ऋजिप्यासो न वयुनेषु धूर्षदः॥
verses.tr: pṛkṣe tā viśvā bhuvanā vavakṣire mitrāya vā sadamā jīradānavaḥ pṛṣadaśvāso anavabhrarādhasa ṛjipyāso na vayuneṣu dhūrṣadaḥ
verses.en: They have bestowed of Mitra all that live, to feed, they who for evermore cause their swift drops to flow; Whose steeds are spotted deer, whose riches never fail, like horses in full speed, bound to the pole in work.

verses.sa:
इन्धन्वभिर्धेनुभी रप्शदूधभिरध्वस्मभिः पथिभिर्भ्राजदृष्टयः ।
आ हंसासो न स्वसराणि गन्तन मधोर्मदाय मरुतः समन्यवः॥
verses.tr: indhanvabhirdhenubhī rapśadūdhabhiradhvasmabhiḥ pathibhirbhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ā haṃsāso na svasarāṇi gantana madhormadāya marutaḥ samanyavaḥ
verses.en: With brightly-flaming kine whose udders swell with milk, with glittering lances on your unobstructed paths, O Maruts, of one mind, like swans who seek their nests, come to the rapturous enjoyment of the meath.

verses.sa:
आ नो ब्रह्माणि मरुतः समन्यवो नरां न शंसः सवनानि गन्तन ।
अश्वामिव पिप्यत धेनुमूधनि कर्ता धियं जरित्रे वाजपेशसम्॥
verses.tr: ā no brahmāṇi marutaḥ samanyavo narāṃ na śaṃsaḥ savanāni gantana aśvāmiva pipyata dhenumūdhani kartā dhiyaṃ jaritre vājapeśasam
verses.en: To these our prayers, O Maruts, come unanimous, come ye to our libations like the praise of men. Make it swell like a mare, in udder like a cow, and for the singer grace the song with plenteous strength.

verses.sa:
तं नो दात मरुतो वाजिनं रथ आपानं ब्रह्म चितयद् दिवेदिवे ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्यो वृजनेषु कारवे सनिं मेधामरिष्टं दुष्टरं सहः॥
verses.tr: taṃ no dāta maruto vājinaṃ ratha āpānaṃ brahma citayad divedive iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo vṛjaneṣu kārave saniṃ medhāmariṣṭaṃ duṣṭaraṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: Give us a steed, O Maruts mighty in the car; prevailing prayer that brings remembrance day by day; Food to your praisers, to your bard in deeds of might give winning wisdom, power uninjured, unsurpassed.

verses.sa:
यद् युञ्जते मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसो ऽश्वान् रथेषु भग आ सुदानवः ।
धेनुर्न शिश्वे स्वसरेषु पिन्वते जनाय रातहविषे महीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: yad yuñjate maruto rukmavakṣaso 'śvān ratheṣu bhaga ā sudānavaḥ dhenurna śiśve svasareṣu pinvate janāya rātahaviṣe mahīmiṣam
verses.en: When the bright-chested Maruts, lavish of their gifts, bind at the time bliss their horses to the cars, Then, as the milch-cow feeds her calf within the stalls, they pour forth food for all oblation-bringing men.

verses.sa:
यो नो मरुतो वृकताति मर्त्यो रिपुर्दधे वसवो रक्षता रिषः ।
वर्तयत तपुषा चक्रियाभि तमव रुद्रा अशसो हन्तना वधः॥
verses.tr: yo no maruto vṛkatāti martyo ripurdadhe vasavo rakṣatā riṣaḥ vartayata tapuṣā cakriyābhi tamava rudrā aśaso hantanā vadhaḥ
verses.en: Save us, O Maruts, Vasus, from the injurer, the mortal foe who makes us looked upon as wolves. With chariot all aflame compass him round about: O Rudras, cast away the foeman's deadly bolt.

verses.sa:
चित्रं तद् वो मरुतो याम चेकिते पृश्न्या यदूधरप्यापयो दुहुः ।
यद् वा निदे नवमानस्य रुद्रियास्त्रितं जराय जुरतामदाभ्याः॥
verses.tr: citraṃ tad vo maruto yāma cekite pṛśnyā yadūdharapyāpayo duhuḥ yad vā nide navamānasya rudriyāstritaṃ jarāya juratāmadābhyāḥ
verses.en: Well-known, ye Maruts, is that wondrous course of yours, when they milked Prsni's udder, close akin to her. Or when to shame the bard who lauded, Rudra's Sons, ye O infallible brought Trita to decay.

verses.sa:
तान् वो महो मरुत एवयाव्नो विष्णोरेषस्य प्रभृथे हवामहे ।
हिरण्यवर्णान् ककुहान् यतस्रुचो ब्रह्मण्यन्तः शंस्यं राध ईमहे॥
verses.tr: tān vo maho maruta evayāvno viṣṇoreṣasya prabhṛthe havāmahe hiraṇyavarṇān kakuhān yatasruco brahmaṇyantaḥ śaṃsyaṃ rādha īmahe
verses.en: We call you such, great Maruts, following wonted ways, to the oblation paid to Visnu Speeder-on. With ladles lifted up, with prayer, we seek of them preeminent, golden-hued, the wealth which all extol.

verses.sa:
ते दशग्वाः प्रथमा यज्ञमूहिरे ते नो हिन्वन्तूषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
उषा न रामीररुणैरपोर्णुते महो ज्योतिषा शुचता गोअर्णसा॥
verses.tr: te daśagvāḥ prathamā yajñamūhire te no hinvantūṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu uṣā na rāmīraruṇairaporṇute maho jyotiṣā śucatā goarṇasā
verses.en: They, the Dasagvas, first of all brought sacrifice: they at the break of mornings shall inspirit us. Dawn with her purple beams uncovereth the nights, with great light glowing like a billowy sea of milk.

verses.sa:
ते क्षोणीभिररुणेभिर्नाञ्जिभी रुद्रा ऋतस्य सदनेषु वावृधुः ।
निमेघमाना अत्येन पाजसा सुश्चन्द्रं वर्णं दधिरे सुपेशसम्॥
verses.tr: te kṣoṇībhiraruṇebhirnāñjibhī rudrā ṛtasya sadaneṣu vāvṛdhuḥ nimeghamānā atyena pājasā suścandraṃ varṇaṃ dadhire supeśasam
verses.en: The Rudras have rejoiced there in the gathered bands at seats of worship as in purple ornaments. They with impetuous vigour sending down the rain have taken to themselves a bright and lovely hue.

verses.sa:
ताँ इयानो महि वरूथमूतय उप घेदेना नमसा गृणीमसि ।
त्रितो न यान् पञ्च होतॄनभिष्टय आववर्तदवराञ्चक्रियावसे॥
verses.tr: tāṃ iyāno mahi varūthamūtaya upa ghedenā namasā gṛṇīmasi trito na yān pañca hotṝnabhiṣṭaya āvavartadavarāñcakriyāvase
verses.en: Soliciting their high protection for our help, with this our adoration we sing praise to them, Whom, for assistance, like the five terrestrial priests. Trita hath brought to aid us hither on his car.

verses.sa:
यया रध्रं पारयथात्यंहो यया निदो मुञ्चथ वन्दितारम् ।
अर्वाची सा मरुतो या व ऊतिरो षु वाश्रेव सुमतिर्जिगातु॥
verses.tr: yayā radhraṃ pārayathātyaṃho yayā nido muñcatha vanditāram arvācī sā maruto yā va ūtiro ṣu vāśreva sumatirjigātu
verses.en: So may your favouring help be turned to us-ward, your kindness like a lowing cow approach us, Wherewith ye bear your servant over trouble, and free your worshipper from scoff and scorning.

sections.label: To Apam Napat, child of the waters
sections.name: Hymn 35

verses.sa:
उपेमसृक्षि वाजयुर्वचस्यां चनो दधीत नाद्यो गिरो मे ।
अपां नपादाशुहेमा कुवित् स सुपेशसस्करति जोषिषद्धि॥
verses.tr: upemasṛkṣi vājayurvacasyāṃ cano dadhīta nādyo giro me apāṃ napādāśuhemā kuvit sa supeśasaskarati joṣiṣaddhi
verses.en: Eager for spoil my flow of speech I utter: may the Floods' Child accept my songs with favour. Will not the rapid Son of Waters make them lovely, for he it is who shall enjoy them?

verses.sa:
इमं स्वस्मै हृद आ सुतष्टं मन्त्रं वोचेम कुविदस्य वेदत् ।
अपां नपादसुर्यस्य मह्ना विश्वान्यर्यो भुवना जजान॥
verses.tr: imaṃ svasmai hṛda ā sutaṣṭaṃ mantraṃ vocema kuvidasya vedat apāṃ napādasuryasya mahnā viśvānyaryo bhuvanā jajāna
verses.en: To him let us address the song well-fashioned, forth from the heart. Shall he not understand it' The friendly Son of Waters by the greatness of Godhead hath produced all things existing.

verses.sa:
समन्या यन्त्युप यन्त्यन्याः समानमूर्वं नद्यः पृणन्ति ।
तमू शुचिं शुचयो दीदिवांसमपां नपातं परि तस्थुरापः॥
verses.tr: samanyā yantyupa yantyanyāḥ samānamūrvaṃ nadyaḥ pṛṇanti tamū śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsamapāṃ napātaṃ pari tasthurāpaḥ
verses.en: Some floods unite themselves and others join them: die sounding rivers fill one common storehouse. On every side the bright Floods have encompassed the bright resplendent Offspring of the Waters.

verses.sa:
तमस्मेरा युवतयो युवानं मर्मृज्यमानाः परि यन्त्यापः ।
स शुक्रेभिः शिक्वभी रेवदस्मे दीदायानिध्मो घृतनिर्णिगप्सु॥
verses.tr: tamasmerā yuvatayo yuvānaṃ marmṛjyamānāḥ pari yantyāpaḥ sa śukrebhiḥ śikvabhī revadasme dīdāyānidhmo ghṛtanirṇigapsu
verses.en: The never-sullen waters, youthful Maidens, carefully decking, wait on him the youthful. He with bright rays shines forth in splendid beauty, unfed with wood. in waters, oil-enveloped.

verses.sa:
अस्मै तिस्रो अव्यथ्याय नारीर्देवाय देवीर्दिधिषन्त्यन्नम् ।
कृता इवोप हि प्रसर्स्रे अप्सु स पीयूषं धयति पूर्वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: asmai tisro avyathyāya nārīrdevāya devīrdidhiṣantyannam kṛtā ivopa hi prasarsre apsu sa pīyūṣaṃ dhayati pūrvasūnām
verses.en: To him three Dames are offering food to feed him, Goddesses to the God whom none may injure. Within the waters hath he pressed, as hollows, and drinks their milk who now are first made mothers.

verses.sa:
अश्वस्यात्र जनिमास्य च स्वर्द्रुहो रिषः सम्पृचः पाहि सूरीन् ।
आमासु पूर्षु परो अप्रमृष्यं नारातयो वि नशन्नानृतानि॥
verses.tr: aśvasyātra janimāsya ca svardruho riṣaḥ sampṛcaḥ pāhi sūrīn āmāsu pūrṣu paro apramṛṣyaṃ nārātayo vi naśannānṛtāni
verses.en: Here was the horse's birth; his was the sunlight. Save thou our princes from the oppressor's onslaught. Him, indestructible, dwelling at a distance in forts unwrought lies and ill spirits reach not.

verses.sa:
स्व आ दमे सुदुघा यस्य धेनुः स्वधां पीपाय सुभ्वन्नमत्ति ।
सो अपां नपादूर्जयन्नप्स्व१न्तर्वसुदेयाय विधते वि भाति॥
verses.tr: sva ā dame sudughā yasya dhenuḥ svadhāṃ pīpāya subhvannamatti so apāṃ napādūrjayannapsva1ntarvasudeyāya vidhate vi bhāti
verses.en: He, in whose mansion is the teeming Milch-cow, swells the Gods' nectar and cats noble viands. He Son of Waters, gathering strength in waters, shines for his worshipper to give him treasures.

verses.sa:
यो अप्स्वा शुचिना दैव्येन ऋतावाजस्र उर्विया विभाति ।
वया इदन्या भुवनान्यस्य प्र जायन्ते वीरुधश्च प्रजाभिः॥
verses.tr: yo apsvā śucinā daivyena ṛtāvājasra urviyā vibhāti vayā idanyā bhuvanānyasya pra jāyante vīrudhaśca prajābhiḥ
verses.en: He who in waters with his own pure Godhead shines widely, law-abiding, everlasting- The other worlds are verily his branches, and plants are born of him with all their offspring.

verses.sa:
अपां नपादा ह्यस्थादुपस्थं जिह्मानामूर्ध्वो विद्युतं वसानः ।
तस्य ज्येष्ठं महिमानं वहन्तीर्हिरण्यवर्णाः परि यन्ति यह्वीः॥
verses.tr: apāṃ napādā hyasthādupasthaṃ jihmānāmūrdhvo vidyutaṃ vasānaḥ tasya jyeṣṭhaṃ mahimānaṃ vahantīrhiraṇyavarṇāḥ pari yanti yahvīḥ
verses.en: The Waters' Son hath risen, and clothed in lightning ascended up unto the curled cloud's bosom; And bearing with them his supremest glory the Youthful Ones, gold-coloured, move around him.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यरूपः स हिरण्यसंदृगपां नपात् सेदु हिरण्यवर्णः ।
हिरण्ययात् परि योनेर्निषद्या हिरण्यदा ददत्यन्नमस्मै॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyarūpaḥ sa hiraṇyasaṃdṛgapāṃ napāt sedu hiraṇyavarṇaḥ hiraṇyayāt pari yonerniṣadyā hiraṇyadā dadatyannamasmai
verses.en: Golden in form is he, like gold to look on, his colour is like gold, the Son of Waters. When he is seated fresh from golden birthplace those who present their gold give food to feed him.

verses.sa:
तदस्यानीकमुत चारु नामापीच्यं वर्धते नप्तुरपाम् ।
यमिन्धते युवतयः समित्था हिरण्यवर्णं घृतमन्नमस्य॥
verses.tr: tadasyānīkamuta cāru nāmāpīcyaṃ vardhate napturapām yamindhate yuvatayaḥ samitthā hiraṇyavarṇaṃ ghṛtamannamasya
verses.en: This the fair name and this the lovely aspect of him the Waters' Son increase in secret. Whom here the youthful Maids together kindle, his food is sacred oil of golden colour.

verses.sa:
अस्मै बहूनामवमाय सख्ये यज्ञैर्विधेम नमसा हविर्भिः ।
सं सानु मार्ज्मि दिधिषामि बिल्मैर्दधाम्यन्नैः परि वन्द ऋग्भिः॥
verses.tr: asmai bahūnāmavamāya sakhye yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ saṃ sānu mārjmi didhiṣāmi bilmairdadhāmyannaiḥ pari vanda ṛgbhiḥ
verses.en: Him, nearest Friend of many, will we worship with sacrifice. and reverence and oblation. I make his back to shine, with chips provide him; to offer food and with my songs exalt him.

verses.sa:
स ईं वृषाजनयत् तासु गर्भं स ईं शिशुर्धयति तं रिहन्ति ।
सो अपां नपादनभिम्लातवर्णो ऽन्यस्येवेह तन्वा विवेष॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ vṛṣājanayat tāsu garbhaṃ sa īṃ śiśurdhayati taṃ rihanti so apāṃ napādanabhimlātavarṇo 'nyasyeveha tanvā viveṣa
verses.en: The Bull hath laid his own life-germ Within them. He sucks them as an infant, and they kiss him. He, Son of Waters, of unfading colour, had entered here as in another's body.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् पदे परमे तस्थिवांसमध्वस्मभिर्विश्वहा दीदिवांसम् ।
आपो नप्त्रे घृतमन्नं वहन्तीः स्वयमत्कैः परि दीयन्ति यह्वीः॥
verses.tr: asmin pade parame tasthivāṃsamadhvasmabhirviśvahā dīdivāṃsam āpo naptre ghṛtamannaṃ vahantīḥ svayamatkaiḥ pari dīyanti yahvīḥ
verses.en: While here he dwelleth in sublimest station, resplendent with the rays that never perish, The Waters, bearing oil to feed their offspring, flow, Youthful Ones, in wanderings about him.

verses.sa:
अयांसमग्ने सुक्षितिं जनायायांसमु मघवद्भ्यः सुवृक्तिम् ।
विश्वं तद् भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: ayāṃsamagne sukṣitiṃ janāyāyāṃsamu maghavadbhyaḥ suvṛktim viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Agni, I gave good shelter to the people, and to the princes goodly preparation. Blessed is all that Gods regard with favour. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं हिन्वानो वसिष्ट गा अपो ऽधुक्षन् त्सीमविभिरद्रिभिर्नरः ।
पिबेन्द्र स्वाहा प्रहुतं वषट्कृतं होत्रादा सोमं प्रथमो य ईशिषे॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ hinvāno vasiṣṭa gā apo 'dhukṣan tsīmavibhiradribhirnaraḥ pibendra svāhā prahutaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ hotrādā somaṃ prathamo ya īśiṣe
verses.en: Water and milk hath he endued, sent forth to thee: the men have drained him with the filters and the stones. Drink, Indra, from the Hotar's bowl first right is thine-Soma hallowed and poured with Vasat and Svaha.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैः सम्मिश्लाः पृषतीभिॠष्टिभिर्यामञ्छुभ्रासो अञ्जिषु प्रिया उत ।
आसद्या बर्हिर्भरतस्य सूनवः पोत्रादा सोमं पिबता दिवो नरः॥
verses.tr: yajñaiḥ sammiślāḥ pṛṣatībhiṝṣṭibhiryāmañchubhrāso añjiṣu priyā uta āsadyā barhirbharatasya sūnavaḥ potrādā somaṃ pibatā divo naraḥ
verses.en: Busied with sacrifice, with spotted deer and spears, gleaming upon your way with ornaments, yea, our Friends, Sitting on sacred grass, ye Sons of Bharata, drink Soma from the Potar's bowl, O Men of heaven.

verses.sa:
अमेव नः सुहवा आ हि गन्तन नि बर्हिषि सदतना रणिष्टन ।
अथा मन्दस्व जुजुषाणो अन्धसस्त्वष्टर्देवेभिर्जनिभिः सुमद्गणः॥
verses.tr: ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatanā raṇiṣṭana athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasastvaṣṭardevebhirjanibhiḥ sumadgaṇaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us, ye swift to listen: as at home upon the sacred grass sit and enjoy yourselves. And, Tvastar, well-content be joyful in the juice with Gods and Goddesses in gladsome company.

verses.sa:
आ वक्षि देवाँ इह विप्र यक्षि चोशन् होतर्नि षदा योनिषु त्रिषु ।
प्रति वीहि प्रस्थितं सोम्यं मधु पिबाग्नीध्रात् तव भागस्य तृप्णुहि॥
verses.tr: ā vakṣi devāṃ iha vipra yakṣi cośan hotarni ṣadā yoniṣu triṣu prati vīhi prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu pibāgnīdhrāt tava bhāgasya tṛpṇuhi
verses.en: Bring the Gods hither, Sage, and offer sacrifice: at the three altars seat thee willingly, O Priest. Accept for thy delight the proffered Soma meath: drink from the Kindler's bowl and fill thee with thy share.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते तन्वो नृम्णवर्धनः सह ओजः प्रदिवि बाह्वोर्हितः ।
तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन् तुभ्यमाभृतस्त्वमस्य ब्राह्मणादा तृपत् पिब॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya te tanvo nṛmṇavardhanaḥ saha ojaḥ pradivi bāhvorhitaḥ tubhyaṃ suto maghavan tubhyamābhṛtastvamasya brāhmaṇādā tṛpat piba
verses.en: This is the strengthener of thy body's manly might: strength, victory for all time are placed within thine arms. Pressed for thee, Maghavan, it is offered unto thee: drink from the chalice of this Brahman, drink thy fill.

verses.sa:
जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे सत्तो होता निविदः पूर्व्या अनु ।
अच्छा राजाना नम एत्यावृतं प्रशास्त्रादा पिबतं सोम्यं मधु॥
