verses.tr: juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me satto hotā nividaḥ pūrvyā anu acchā rājānā nama etyāvṛtaṃ praśāstrādā pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Accept the sacrifice; mark both of you, my call: the Priest hath seated him after the ancient texts. My prayer that bids them come goes forth to both the Kings: drink ye the Soma meath from the Director's bowl.

verses.sa:
मन्दस्व होत्रादनु जोषमन्धसो ऽध्वर्यवः स पूर्णां वष्ट्यासिचम् ।
तस्मा एतं भरत तद्वशो ददिर्होत्रात् सोमं द्रविणोदः पिब ऋतुभिः॥
verses.tr: mandasva hotrādanu joṣamandhaso 'dhvaryavaḥ sa pūrṇāṃ vaṣṭyāsicam tasmā etaṃ bharata tadvaśo dadirhotrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ
verses.en: Enjoy thy fill of meath out of the Hotar's cup: Adhvaryus he desires a full draught poured for him. Bring it him: seeking this he gives. Granter of Wealth, drink Soma with the Rtus from the Hotar's cup.

verses.sa:
यमु पूर्वमहुवे तमिदं हुवे सेदु हव्यो ददिर्यो नाम पत्यते ।
अध्वर्युभिः प्रस्थितं सोम्यं मधु पोत्रात् सोमं द्रविणोदः पिब ऋतुभिः॥
verses.tr: yamu pūrvamahuve tamidaṃ huve sedu havyo dadiryo nāma patyate adhvaryubhiḥ prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu potrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ
verses.en: He whom of old I called on, him I call on now. He is to be invoked; his name is He who Gives, Here brought by priests is Soma meath. Granter of Wealth, drink Soma with the Rtus from the Potar's cup.

verses.sa:
मेद्यन्तु ते वह्नयो येभिरीयसे ऽरिषण्यन् वीळयस्वा वनस्पते ।
आयूया धृष्णो अभिगूर्या त्वं नेष्ट्रात् सोमं द्रविणोदः पिब ऋतुभिः॥
verses.tr: medyantu te vahnayo yebhirīyase 'riṣaṇyan vīḻayasvā vanaspate āyūyā dhṛṣṇo abhigūryā tvaṃ neṣṭrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ
verses.en: Fat may the horses be wherewith thou speedest on: Lord of the Wood, unharming, strengthen thou thyself. Drawing and seizing, Bold One, thou who grantest wealth, drink Soma with the Rtus from the Nestar's cup.

verses.sa:
अपाद्धोत्रादुत पोत्रादमत्तोत नेष्ट्रादजुषत प्रयो हितम् ।
तुरीयं पात्रममृक्तममर्त्यं द्रविणोदाः पिबतु द्राविणोदसः॥
verses.tr: apāddhotrāduta potrādamattota neṣṭrādajuṣata prayo hitam turīyaṃ pātramamṛktamamartyaṃ draviṇodāḥ pibatu drāviṇodasaḥ
verses.en: From Hotar's cup and Potar's he hath drunk and joyed: the proffered food hath pleased him from the Nestar's bowl. The fourth cup undisturbed, immortal, let him drink who giveth wealth, the cup of the wealth-giving God.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चमद्य यय्यं नृवाहणं रथं युञ्जाथामिह वां विमोचनम् ।
पृङ्क्तं हवींषि मधुना हि कं गतमथा सोमं पिबतं वाजिनीवसू॥
verses.tr: arvāñcamadya yayyaṃ nṛvāhaṇaṃ rathaṃ yuñjāthāmiha vāṃ vimocanam pṛṅktaṃ havīṃṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gatamathā somaṃ pibataṃ vājinīvasū
verses.en: Yoke, O ye Twain, to-day your hero-bearing car, swift-moving hitherward: your loosing-place is here. Mix the oblations, then come hither with the meath, and drink the Soma, ye rich in abundant strength.

verses.sa:
जोष्यग्ने समिधं जोष्याहुतिं जोषि ब्रह्म जन्यं जोषि सुष्टुतिम् ।
विश्वेभिर्विश्वाँ ऋतुना वसो मह उशन् देवाँ उशतः पायया हविः॥
verses.tr: joṣyagne samidhaṃ joṣyāhutiṃ joṣi brahma janyaṃ joṣi suṣṭutim viśvebhirviśvāṃ ṛtunā vaso maha uśan devāṃ uśataḥ pāyayā haviḥ
verses.en: Agni, accept the fuel and our offered gift: accept the prayer of man, accept our eulogy, Do thou with all, with Rtu, O thou Excellent, fain, make the great Gods all fain taste the gift we bring.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य देवः सविता सवाय शश्वत्तमं तदपा वह्निरस्थात् ।
नूनं देवेभ्यो वि हि धाति रत्नमथाभजद् वीतिहोत्रं स्वस्तौ॥
verses.tr: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā savāya śaśvattamaṃ tadapā vahnirasthāt nūnaṃ devebhyo vi hi dhāti ratnamathābhajad vītihotraṃ svastau
verses.en: Uprisen is Savitar, this God, to quicken, Priest who neglects not this most constant duty. To the Gods, verily, he gives rich treasure, and blesses him who calls them to the banquet.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि श्रुष्टये देव ऊर्ध्वः प्र बाहवा पृथुपाणिः सिसर्ति ।
आपश्चिदस्य व्रत आ निमृग्रा अयं चिद् वातो रमते परिज्मन्॥
verses.tr: viśvasya hi śruṣṭaye deva ūrdhvaḥ pra bāhavā pṛthupāṇiḥ sisarti āpaścidasya vrata ā nimṛgrā ayaṃ cid vāto ramate parijman
verses.en: Having gone up on high, the God broadhanded spreads his arms widely forth that all may mark him. Even the waters bend them to his service: even this wind rests in the circling region.

verses.sa:
आशुभिश्चिद्यान् वि मुचाति नूनमरीरमदतमानं चिदेतोः ।
अह्यर्षूणां चिन्न्ययाँ अविष्यामनु व्रतं सवितुर्मोक्यागात्॥
verses.tr: āśubhiścidyān vi mucāti nūnamarīramadatamānaṃ cidetoḥ ahyarṣūṇāṃ cinnyayāṃ aviṣyāmanu vrataṃ saviturmokyāgāt
verses.en: Though borne by swift steeds he will yet unyoke them: e'en the fleet chariot hath he stayed from going. He hath checked e'en their haste who glide like serpents. Night closely followed Savitar's dominion.

verses.sa:
पुनः समव्यद् विततं वयन्ती मध्या कर्तोर्न्यधाच्छक्म धीरः ।
उत् संहायास्थाद् व्यृ१तूँरदर्धररमतिः सविता देव आगात्॥
verses.tr: punaḥ samavyad vitataṃ vayantī madhyā kartornyadhācchakma dhīraḥ ut saṃhāyāsthād vyṛ1tūṃradardhararamatiḥ savitā deva āgāt
verses.en: What was spread out she weaves afresh, re-weaving: the skillful leaves his labour half-completed. He hath arisen from rest, and parted seasons: Savitar hath approached, God, holy-minded.

verses.sa:
नानौकांसि दुर्यो विश्वमायुर्वि तिष्ठते प्रभवः शोको अग्नेः ।
ज्येष्ठं माता सूनवे भागमाधादन्वस्य केतमिषितं सवित्रा॥
verses.tr: nānaukāṃsi duryo viśvamāyurvi tiṣṭhate prabhavaḥ śoko agneḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ mātā sūnave bhāgamādhādanvasya ketamiṣitaṃ savitrā
verses.en: Through various dwellings, through entire existence, spreads, manifest, the household light of Agni. The Mother gives her Son the goodliest portion, and Savitar hath sped to meet his summons.

verses.sa:
समाववर्ति विष्ठितो जिगीषुर्विश्वेषां कामश्चरताममाभूत् ।
शश्वाँ अपो विकृतं हित्व्यागादनु व्रतं सवितुर्दैव्यस्य॥
verses.tr: samāvavarti viṣṭhito jigīṣurviśveṣāṃ kāmaścaratāmamābhūt śaśvāṃ apo vikṛtaṃ hitvyāgādanu vrataṃ saviturdaivyasya
verses.en: He comes again, unfolded, fain for conquest: at home was he, the love of all things moving. Each man hath come leaving his evil doings, after the Godlike Savitar's commandment.

verses.sa:
त्वया हितमप्यमप्सु भागं धन्वान्वा मृगयसो वि तस्थुः ।
वनानि विभ्यो नकिरस्य तानि व्रता देवस्य सवितुर्मिनन्ति॥
verses.tr: tvayā hitamapyamapsu bhāgaṃ dhanvānvā mṛgayaso vi tasthuḥ vanāni vibhyo nakirasya tāni vratā devasya saviturminanti
verses.en: The wild beasts spread through desert places seeking their watery share which thou hast set in waters. The woods are given to the birds. These statutes of the God Savitar none disobeyeth.

verses.sa:
याद्राध्यं१ वरुणो योनिमप्यमनिशितं निमिषि जर्भुराणः ।
विश्वो मार्ताण्डो व्रजमा पशुर्गात्स्थ स्थशो जन्मानि सविता व्याकः॥
verses.tr: yādrādhyaṃ1 varuṇo yonimapyamaniśitaṃ nimiṣi jarbhurāṇaḥ viśvo mārtāṇḍo vrajamā paśurgātstha sthaśo janmāni savitā vyākaḥ
verses.en: With utmost speed, in restless haste at sunset Varuna seeks his watery habitation. Then seeks each bird his nest, each beast his lodging. In due place Savitar hath set each creature.

verses.sa:
न यस्येन्द्रो वरुणो न मित्रो व्रतमर्यमा न मिनन्ति रुद्रः ।
नारातयस्तमिदं स्वस्ति हुवे देवं सवितारं नमोभिः॥
verses.tr: na yasyendro varuṇo na mitro vratamaryamā na minanti rudraḥ nārātayastamidaṃ svasti huve devaṃ savitāraṃ namobhiḥ
verses.en: Him whose high law not Varuna nor Indra, not Mitra, Aryaman, nor Rudra breaketh, Nor evil-hearted fiends, here for my welfare him I invoke, God Savitar, with worship.

verses.sa:
भगं धियं वाजयन्तः पुरंधिं नराशंसो ग्नास्पतिर्नो अव्याः ।
आये वामस्य संगथे रयीणां प्रिया देवस्य सवितुः स्याम॥
verses.tr: bhagaṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantaḥ puraṃdhiṃ narāśaṃso gnāspatirno avyāḥ āye vāmasya saṃgathe rayīṇāṃ priyā devasya savituḥ syāma
verses.en: May they who strengthen bliss, and thought and wisdom, and the Dames' Lord and Narasamsa aid us. That good may come to us and wealth be gathered, may we be Savitar the God's beloved.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं तद् दिवो अद्भ्यः पृथिव्यास्त्वया दत्तं काम्यं राध आ गात् ।
शं यत् स्तोतृभ्य आपये भवात्युरुशंसाय सवितर्जरित्रे॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ tad divo adbhyaḥ pṛthivyāstvayā dattaṃ kāmyaṃ rādha ā gāt śaṃ yat stotṛbhya āpaye bhavātyuruśaṃsāya savitarjaritre
verses.en: So come to us our hearts' desire, the bounty bestowed by thee, from heaven and earth and waters, That it be well with friends and those who praise thee, and, Savitar, with the loud-lauding singer.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाणेव तदिदर्थं जरेथे गृध्रेव वृक्षं निधिमन्तमच्छ ।
ब्रह्माणेव विदथ उक्थशासा दूतेव हव्या जन्या पुरुत्रा॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇeva tadidarthaṃ jarethe gṛdhreva vṛkṣaṃ nidhimantamaccha brahmāṇeva vidatha ukthaśāsā dūteva havyā janyā purutrā
verses.en: Sing like the two press-stones for this same purpose; come like two misers to the tree of treasure; Like two laud-singing Brahmans in the assembly, like the folk's envoys called in many places.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यावाणा रथ्येव वीरा ऽजेव यमा वरमा सचेथे ।
मेने इव तन्वा३ शुम्भमाने दम्पतीव क्रतुविदा जनेषु॥
verses.tr: prātaryāvāṇā rathyeva vīrā 'jeva yamā varamā sacethe mene iva tanvā3 śumbhamāne dampatīva kratuvidā janeṣu
verses.en: Moving at morning like two chr-borne heroes, like to a pair of goats ye come electing; Like two fair dames embellishing their bodies, like a wise married pair among the people.

verses.sa:
शृङ्गेव नः प्रथमा गन्तमर्वाक् छफाविव जर्भुराणा तरोभिः ।
चक्रवाकेव प्रति वस्तोरुस्रा ऽर्वाञ्चा यातं रथ्येव शक्रा॥
verses.tr: śṛṅgeva naḥ prathamā gantamarvāk chaphāviva jarbhurāṇā tarobhiḥ cakravākeva prati vastorusrā 'rvāñcā yātaṃ rathyeva śakrā
verses.en: Like to a pair of horns come first to usward, like to a pair of hoofs with rapid motion; Come like two Cakavas in the grey of morning, come like two chariot wheels at dawn, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
नावेव नः पारयतं युगेव नभ्येव न उपधीव प्रधीव ।
श्वानेव नो अरिषण्या तनूनां खृगलेव विस्रसः पातमस्मान्॥
verses.tr: nāveva naḥ pārayataṃ yugeva nabhyeva na upadhīva pradhīva śvāneva no ariṣaṇyā tanūnāṃ khṛgaleva visrasaḥ pātamasmān
verses.en: Bear us across the rivers like two vessels, save us as ye were yokes, naves, spokes and fellies. Be like two dogs that injure not our bodies; preserve us, like two crutches, that we fall not.

verses.sa:
वातेवाजुर्या नद्येव रीतिरक्षी इव चक्षुषा यातमर्वाक् ।
हस्ताविव तन्वे३ शम्भविष्ठा पादेव नो नयतं वस्यो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: vātevājuryā nadyeva rītirakṣī iva cakṣuṣā yātamarvāk hastāviva tanve3 śambhaviṣṭhā pādeva no nayataṃ vasyo accha
verses.en: Like two winds ageing not, two confluent rivers, come with quick vision like two eyes before us. Come like two hands most helpful to the body, and guide us like two feet to what is precious.

verses.sa:
ओष्ठाविव मध्वास्ने वदन्ता स्तनाविव पिप्यतं जीवसे नः ।
नासेव नस्तन्वो रक्षितारा कर्णाविव सुश्रुता भूतमस्मे॥
verses.tr: oṣṭhāviva madhvāsne vadantā stanāviva pipyataṃ jīvase naḥ nāseva nastanvo rakṣitārā karṇāviva suśrutā bhūtamasme
verses.en: Even as two lips that with the mouth speak honey, even as two breasts that nourish our existence, Like the two nostrils that protect our being, be to us as our ears that hear distinctly.

verses.sa:
हस्तेव शक्तिमभि संददी नः क्षामेव नः समजतं रजांसि ।
इमा गिरो अश्विना युष्मयन्तीः क्ष्णोत्रेणेव स्वधितिं सं शिशीतम्॥
verses.tr: hasteva śaktimabhi saṃdadī naḥ kṣāmeva naḥ samajataṃ rajāṃsi imā giro aśvinā yuṣmayantīḥ kṣṇotreṇeva svadhitiṃ saṃ śiśītam
verses.en: Like two hands give ye us increasing vigour; like heaven and earth constrain the airy regions. Asvins, these hymns that struggle to approach you, sharpen ye like an axe upon a whetstone.

verses.sa:
एतानि वामश्विना वर्धनानि ब्रह्म स्तोमं गृत्समदासो अक्रन् ।
तानि नरा जुजुषाणोप यातं बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: etāni vāmaśvinā vardhanāni brahma stomaṃ gṛtsamadāso akran tāni narā jujuṣāṇopa yātaṃ bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: These prayers of ours exalting you, O Asvins, have the GrtSamadas, for a laud, made ready. Welcome them, O ye Heroes, and come bither. Loud may we speak. with brave men, in assembly.

verses.sa:
सोमापूषणा जनना रयीणां जनना दिवो जनना पृथिव्याः ।
जातौ विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपौ देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिम्॥
verses.tr: somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇāṃ jananā divo jananā pṛthivyāḥ jātau viśvasya bhuvanasya gopau devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim
verses.en: Soma and Pusan, Parents of all riches, Parents of earth and Parents of high heaven, You Twain, brought forth as the whole world's protectors, the Gods have made centre of life eternal.

verses.sa:
इमौ देवौ जायमानौ जुषन्तेमौ तमांसि गूहतामजुष्टा ।
आभ्यामिन्द्रः पक्वमामास्वन्तः सोमापूषभ्यां जनदुस्रियासु॥
verses.tr: imau devau jāyamānau juṣantemau tamāṃsi gūhatāmajuṣṭā ābhyāmindraḥ pakvamāmāsvantaḥ somāpūṣabhyāṃ janadusriyāsu
verses.en: At birth of these two Gods all Gods are joyful: they have caused darkness, which we hate, to vanish. With these, with Soma and with Pusan, India generates ripe warm milk in the raw milch-cows.

verses.sa:
सोमापूषणा रजसो विमानं सप्तचक्रं रथमविश्वमिन्वम् ।
विषूवृतं मनसा युज्यमानं तं जिन्वथो वृषणा पञ्चरश्मिम्॥
verses.tr: somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānaṃ saptacakraṃ rathamaviśvaminvam viṣūvṛtaṃ manasā yujyamānaṃ taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim
verses.en: Soma and Pusan, urge your chariot hither, the seven-wheeled car that measures out the region, That stirs not all, that moves to every quarter, five-reined and harnessed by the thought, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
दिव्य१न्यः सदनं चक्र उच्चा पृथिव्यामन्यो अध्यन्तरिक्षे ।
तावस्मभ्यं पुरुवारं पुरुक्षुं रायस्पोषं वि ष्यतां नाभिमस्मे॥
verses.tr: divya1nyaḥ sadanaṃ cakra uccā pṛthivyāmanyo adhyantarikṣe tāvasmabhyaṃ puruvāraṃ purukṣuṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ vi ṣyatāṃ nābhimasme
verses.en: One in the heaven on high hath made his dwelling, on earth and in the firmament the other. May they disclose to us great store of treasure, much-longed for, rich in food, source of enjoyment.

verses.sa:
विश्वान्यन्यो भुवना जजान विश्वमन्यो अभिचक्षाण एति ।
सोमापूषणाववतं धियं मे युवाभ्यां विश्वाः पृतना जयेम॥
verses.tr: viśvānyanyo bhuvanā jajāna viśvamanyo abhicakṣāṇa eti somāpūṣaṇāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me yuvābhyāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayema
verses.en: One of you Twain is Parent of all creatures, the other journeys onward all-beholding. Soma and Pusan, aid my thought with favour: with you may we o'ercome in all encounters.

verses.sa:
धियं पूषा जिन्वतु विश्वमिन्वो रयिं सोमो रयिपतिर्दधातु ।
अवतु देव्यदितिरनर्वा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: dhiyaṃ pūṣā jinvatu viśvaminvo rayiṃ somo rayipatirdadhātu avatu devyaditiranarvā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May Pusan stir our thought, the all-impelling, may Soma Lord of riches grant us riches. May Aditi the perfect Goddess aid us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa: वायो ये ते सहस्रिणो रथासस्तेभिरा गहि । नियुत्वान्त्सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirā gahi niyutvāntsomapītaye
verses.en: O VAYU, come to us with all the thousand chariots that are thine, Team-borne, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: नियुत्वान् वायवा गह्ययं शुक्रो अयामि ते । गन्तासि सुन्वतो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: niyutvān vāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te gantāsi sunvato gṛham
verses.en: Drawn by thy team, O Vayu, come; to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.

verses.sa: शुक्रस्याद्य गवाशिर इन्द्रवायू नियुत्वतः । आ यातं पिबतं नरा॥
verses.tr: śukrasyādya gavāśira indravāyū niyutvataḥ ā yātaṃ pibataṃ narā
verses.en: Indra and Vayu, drawn by teams, ye Heroes, come today and drink. Of the bright juice when blent with milk.

verses.sa: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ।ममेदिह श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā mamediha śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: This Soma hath been shed for you, Lawstrengtheners, Mitra-Varuna! Listen ye here to this my call.

verses.sa: राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे । सहस्रस्थूण आसाते॥
verses.tr: rājānāvanabhidruhā dhruve sadasyuttame sahasrasthūṇa āsāte
verses.en: Both Kings who never injure aught seat them in their supremest home, The thousand-pillared, firmly-based.

verses.sa: ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती ।सचेते अनवह्वरम्॥
verses.tr: tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī ādityā dānunaspatī sacete anavahvaram
verses.en: Fed with oblation, Sovran Kings, Adityas, Lords of liberal gifts. They wait on him whose life is true.

verses.sa: गोमदू षु नासत्याश्वावद्यातमश्विना । वर्ती रुद्रा नृपाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: gomadū ṣu nāsatyāśvāvadyātamaśvinā vartī rudrā nṛpāyyam
verses.en: With kine, Nasatyas, and with steeds, come, Asvins, Rudras, to the house That will protect its heroes well;

verses.sa: न यत् परो नान्तर आदधर्षद् वृषण्वसू । दुःशंसो मर्त्यो रिपुः॥
verses.tr: na yat paro nāntara ādadharṣad vṛṣaṇvasū duḥśaṃso martyo ripuḥ
verses.en: Such, wealthy Gods! as none afar nor standing nigh to us may harm, Yea, no malicious mortal foe.

verses.sa: ता न आ वोळहमश्विना रयिं पिशङ्गसंदृशम् । धिष्ण्या वरिवोविदम्॥
verses.tr: tā na ā voḻahamaśvinā rayiṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam dhiṣṇyā varivovidam
verses.en: As such, O longed-far Asvins, lead us on to wealth of varied sort, Wealth that shall bring us room and rest.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद् भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत् । स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indro aṅga mahad bhayamabhī ṣadapa cucyavat sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth e'en mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च मृळयाति नो न नः पश्चादघं नशत् । भद्रं भवाति नः पुरः॥
verses.tr: indraśca mṛḻayāti no na naḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat bhadraṃ bhavāti naḥ puraḥ
verses.en: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward, And good shall be before us still.

verses.sa: इन्द्र आशाभ्यस्परि सर्वाभ्यो अभयं करत् । जेता शत्रून् विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indra āśābhyaspari sarvābhyo abhayaṃ karat jetā śatrūn vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security, The foe-subduer, swift to act.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवम् । एदं बर्हिर्नि षीदत॥
verses.tr: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam edaṃ barhirni ṣīdata
verses.en: O all ye Gods, come hitherward: hear this mine invocation, seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass.

verses.sa: तीव्रो वो मधुमाँ अयं शुनहोत्रेषु मत्सरः । एतं पिबत काम्यम्॥
verses.tr: tīvro vo madhumāṃ ayaṃ śunahotreṣu matsaraḥ etaṃ pibata kāmyam
verses.en: Among the gunahotras strong for you is this sweet gladdening draught. Drink ye of this delightsome juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः । विश्वे मम श्रुता हवम्॥
verses.tr: indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ viśve mama śrutā havam
verses.en: Ye Martus led by Indra, Gods with Pusan for your bounteousest, Hear all of you this call of mine.

verses.sa:
अम्बितमे नदीतमे देवितमे सरस्वति ।
अप्रशस्ता इव स्मसि प्रशस्तिमम्ब नस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: ambitame nadītame devitame sarasvati apraśastā iva smasi praśastimamba naskṛdhi
verses.en: Best Mother, best of Rivers, best of Goddesses, Sarasvati, We are, as 'twere, of no repute and dear Mother, give thou us renown.

verses.sa:
त्वे विश्वा सरस्वति श्रितायूंषि देव्याम् ।
शुनहोत्रेषु मत्स्व प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः॥
verses.tr: tve viśvā sarasvati śritāyūṃṣi devyām śunahotreṣu matsva prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
verses.en: In thee, Sarasvati, divine, all generations have their stay. Be, glad with Sunahotra's sons: O Goddess grant us progeny.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म सरस्वति जुषस्व वाजिनीवति ।
या ते मन्म गृत्समदा ऋतावरि प्रिया देवेषु जुह्वति॥
verses.tr: imā brahma sarasvati juṣasva vājinīvati yā te manma gṛtsamadā ṛtāvari priyā deveṣu juhvati
verses.en: Enriched with sacrifice, accept Sarasvati, these prayers of ours, Thoughts which GrtSamadas beloved of Gods bring, Holy One to thee.

verses.sa: प्रेतां यज्ञस्य शम्भुवा युवामिदा वृणीमहे । अग्निं च हव्यवाहनम्॥
verses.tr: pretāṃ yajñasya śambhuvā yuvāmidā vṛṇīmahe agniṃ ca havyavāhanam
verses.en: Ye who bless sacrifice, go forth, for verily we choose you both, And Agni who conveys our gifts.

verses.sa: द्यावा नः पृथिवी इमं सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशम् । यज्ञं देवेषु यच्छताम्॥
verses.tr: dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī imaṃ sidhramadya divispṛśam yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchatām
verses.en: This our effectual sacrifice, reaching the sky, shall Heaven and Earth Present unto the Gods to-day.

verses.sa: आ वामुपस्थमद्रुहा देवाः सीदन्तु यज्ञियाः । इहाद्य सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā vāmupasthamadruhā devāḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ ihādya somapītaye
verses.en: In both your laps, ye guileless Ones, the Holy Gods shall sit them down To-day to drink the Soma here.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रदज्जनुषं प्रब्रुवाण इयर्ति वाचमरितेव नावम् ।
सुमङ्गलश्च शकुने भवासि मा त्वा का चिदभिभा विश्व्या विदत्॥
verses.tr: kanikradajjanuṣaṃ prabruvāṇa iyarti vācamariteva nāvam sumaṅgalaśca śakune bhavāsi mā tvā kā cidabhibhā viśvyā vidat
verses.en: Telling his race aloud with cries repeated, he sends his voice out as his boat a steersman. O Bird, be ominous of happy fortune from no side may calamity befall thee.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा श्येन उद् वधीन्मा सुपर्णो मा त्वा विददिषुमान् वीरो अस्ता ।
पित्र्यामनु प्रदिशं कनिक्रदत् सुमङ्गलो भद्रवादी वदेह॥
verses.tr: mā tvā śyena ud vadhīnmā suparṇo mā tvā vidadiṣumān vīro astā pitryāmanu pradiśaṃ kanikradat sumaṅgalo bhadravādī vadeha
verses.en: Let not the falcon kill thee, nor the eagle let not the arrow-bearing archer reach thee. Still crying in the region of the Fathers, speak here auspicious, bearing joyful tidings.

verses.sa:
अव क्रन्द दक्षिणतो गृहाणां सुमङ्गलो भद्रवादी शकुन्ते ।
मा नः स्तेन ईशत माघशंसो बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: ava kranda dakṣiṇato gṛhāṇāṃ sumaṅgalo bhadravādī śakunte mā naḥ stena īśata māghaśaṃso bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Bringing good tidings, Bird of happy omen, call thou out loudly southward of our dwellings, So that no thief, no sinner may oppress us. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sa:
प्रदक्षिणिदभि गृणन्ति कारवो वयो वदन्त ऋतुथा शकुन्तयः ।
उभे वाचौ वदति सामगा इव गायत्रं च त्रैष्टुभं चानु राजति॥
verses.tr: pradakṣiṇidabhi gṛṇanti kāravo vayo vadanta ṛtuthā śakuntayaḥ ubhe vācau vadati sāmagā iva gāyatraṃ ca traiṣṭubhaṃ cānu rājati
verses.en: Here on the right sing forth chanters of hymns of praise, even the winged birds that in due season speak. He, like: a Sama-chanter utters both the notes, skilled in the mode of Trstup and of Gayatri.

verses.sa:
उद्गातेव शकुने साम गायसि ब्रह्मपुत्र इव सवनेषु शंससि ।
वृषेव वाजी शिशुमतीरपीत्या सर्वतो नः शकुने भद्रमा वद
विश्वतो नः शकुने पुण्यमा वद॥
verses.tr: udgāteva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputra iva savaneṣu śaṃsasi vṛṣeva vājī śiśumatīrapītyā sarvato naḥ śakune bhadramā vada viśvato naḥ śakune puṇyamā vada
verses.en: Thou like the chanter-priest chantest the Sama, Bird; thou singest at libations like a Brahman's son. Even as a vigorous horse when he comes near the mare, announce to us good fortune, Bird, on every side, proclaim in all directions happy luck, O Bird.

verses.sa:
आवदंस्त्वं शकुने भद्रमा वद तूष्णीमासीनः सुमतिं चिकिद्धि नः ।
यदुत्पतन् वदसि कर्करिर्यथा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: āvadaṃstvaṃ śakune bhadramā vada tūṣṇīmāsīnaḥ sumatiṃ cikiddhi naḥ yadutpatan vadasi karkariryathā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: When singing here, O Bird. announce good luck to us, and when thou sittest still think on us with kind thoughts.
